articleTitle: Towards the Improvement of Credit Card Approval Process Using Classification Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: For financial institutions, such as banks, one of the major sources to earn includes the issuance of credit cards. Over time, there has been a significant growth of applicants that opt to take advantage of the convenience and staggered payments provided by credit cards. As such, financial institutions are faced with the tedious and daunting task of reviewing and approving applications on a periodic basis. In order to handle fatigue-induced errors as well as increase reliability and efficiency in the review and approval process, financial institutions employ digitalization as a support system mainly in the form of machine learning algorithms. Among the set of alternative algorithms available for use, financial institutions are still prompted with the task of evaluating these algorithms based on performance metrics Such a way tends to ensure that the credit card approval process can be improved further. Therefore, this paper uses a classification algorithm run through WEKA to explore the different algorithms' performance and their impact on the process improvement of credit card applications. It is found that financial institutions consider the following attributes important in the process of approval: default history, credit score status, income status, employment history, and banking history. Under such attributes, the algorithm was also able to present a sound and accurate classification task.

articleTitle: Personalized Recommendation System for Online Learning: An Opportunity
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: In the world of education, learning management systems are currently widely used. The massively open online courses are accessible either via the web or mobile. The Learning Management System (LMS) is one of the learning media that is widely used today in online learning. An LMS with the use of a personalized recommendation system can provide items tailored to the interests and behavior of its users. Items in the recommendation system can be in the form of recommendations for learning models, ways of learning, learning patterns, or learning stages according to the characteristics and profile of the user. The purpose of this study is to identify opportunities for better online learning by utilizing a customized recommendation system based on the history of user interaction with the system, using several factors as determinants or variables. The method used is a review conducted from several stages. The result of this is knowing the factors that influence the user, and the opportunities that exist in the system recommendations on personalized development.

articleTitle: Data Scraping using Python for Information Retrieval on E-Commerce with Brand Keyword
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: A marketplace is a place for buying and selling online which is currently widely used by people, especially in Indonesia. The ease of registration when people want to open an online store and sell their products through e-commerce causes problems such as selling branded products by the public where individuals or companies should only sell the product with a license. However, some sellers of several companies lose money because their products are sold illegally and do not meet the resale price standards. In this research, a scraping web application will be built using the Python programming language with the help of the BeautifulSoap library for data extraction. Apps can help companies find products that are being sold illegally. The application has a report feature that makes it easier for companies to report violations committed by unauthorized sellers. Based on testing, the application can search for 33 products within 14.8 seconds. The application interface design is evaluated using eight golden rules and tested for accuracy, 83% precision, and 93% recall value.

articleTitle: How Do Influencers Create Value for SMEs? A TikTok Review in the Philippines
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Social media has continuously grown globally through the years. One of the emerging social media platforms that becomes relevant today is TikTok. The prevalence of TikTok opens opportunities as it has also given birth to the rise of influencer marketing. Many SMEs are now embracing influencer marketing as it has transformed the relationship between retailers and consumers through social media. Although influencer marketing through TikTok may deem beneficial, studies on how influencers create value for SMEs specifically in the context of a developing country like the Philippines are still scarce. This quantitative content analysis investigated the top influencers in the country whose content contributes to the value creation of SMEs. Results show that influencer marketing creates value for SMEs by expanding brand awareness and influencing consumers' purchasing decisions through sponsored content delivered by influencers to SMEs while enhancing the brand reputation of SMEs and maintaining customer lifetime value through brand ambassadorships of products and services. To ensure the value creation of influencer marketing on SMEs' market performance, this study also proposes an influencer marketing framework for SMEs.

articleTitle: How Digital Marketing Through IMC influences Brand Retail and Brand Loyalty
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The development of digital technology that encourages the growth of digital marketing has made many businesses start using an integrated marketing communication system as a tool to carry out promotions because they are able to reach large market segments. Coffee Shop business is one of the businesses that need to reach large segment. This research aims to determine the influence of digital marketing through integrated marketing communication on retail brands and brand loyalty in the coffee shop business. This research uses quantitative research methods with data collection techniques in the form of distributing questionnaires online. The sampling technique used is a probability sampling technique with a total sample of 120 people. The data analysis technique used to answer the hypothesis of this study is SEM-PLS. The results of data analysis found that digital marketing through integrated marketing communication has an influence on retail brand and brand loyalty, and indirectly influences brand loyalty, through retail brands as a mediation variable.

articleTitle: Prospect Theory-Based Formulation of Portfolio Optimization Problem using Loan and Its Solution by Multi-Start Local Search
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Portfolio optimization is the process of determining the best proportion of investment in different assets according to some objective. The objective is usually to maximize profits such as expected return and minimize costs such as financial risk. In the portfolio optimization problem using loan, the borrowed money can be invested in risk assets. In this paper, in order to reflect investor preferences in the solution, or the portfolio, prospect theory is used to extend the conventional formulation of the portfolio optimization problem using loan. In the new problem formulation, both the value and probability weighting functions of prospect theory are used to modify the profit from the investment. Since the new portfolio optimization problem is usually non-convex, a multi-start local search algorithm with a set of feasible initial solutions generated by the convex-hull mapping is proposed. Besides, the characteristics of the optimal solution for the new portfolio optimization problem are clarified.

articleTitle: Digital Quotient as Mediator in the Link of Leadership Agility to Employee Engagement of Digital Generation
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Because they have lower levels of employee engagement than previous generations, digital generation at workplace requires different leadership approaches. This article is interested to elaborate employee engagement of digital generation in the digital organization as well as to assess the effect of digital quotient as personal resources and leadership agility as organizational resources toward employee engagement. This article has conducted a quantitative study with a survey approach to support the elaboration. There are 147 employees from a mainstream platform company for B2C e-commerce in Indonesia who are involved as the respondents. Variance-based structural equation modelling by using SmartPLS version 4.0 was applied to prove the three hypotheses empirically. The results confirm that leadership and agility has dual relationship -direct and indirect relationship. Digital quotient plays a mediator role in the effect of leadership agility on employee engagement. For engaging digital generation at workplace more effectively, supervisor and/or manager at workplace is recommended to apply leadership agility approach as well as strengthening digital quotient of his/her team members.

articleTitle: Stock Price Prediction Using Modified Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory and Deep Learning Models: A Case Study of Bhutan Tourism Corporation Limited Stock Data
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Stock price prediction has attracted a huge attention for its potential in growing of both the company and shareholders. Many different researches have done with various methods and approaches in the recent years. In this research, stock data of Bhutan Tourism Corporation Limited (BTCL) is predicted using four different and strong models; Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), Bidirectional LSTM (Bi-LSTM), Convolutional LSTM (ConvLSTM), and Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU). The four models are compared based on popular performance evaluation metrics; R-squared (R2), Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE), and Mean Absolute Error (MAE). After the simulations of results and the model's comparison, Bi-LSTM is seen to be outperforming other models with R2 value of 95.93%. Bi-LSTM being the best model in this paper, it is tuned with three different optimizers; adam, Adamax, and Nadam and three different activations; elu, relu, and selu. Bi-LSTM with relu activation and Nadam optimizer gives slight improvement after the tuning with R2 of 95.63% and therefore chosen as the best model of the paper.

articleTitle: Acceptance Analysis of Customer Info Application PDAM Indramayu Using Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) Method
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The customer info application is an application created by PERUMDAM so that customers can receive information and communicate with PERUMDAM. Since its release in 2019, this application has been downloaded by more than 5 thousand people as of May 25, 2022, this is only 3.3% of existing customers. One of the things that can be the cause is the lack of user comfort so this application is not accepted by the public. The purpose of this study is to determine the acceptance of the application in terms of user experience and provide recommendations for new user interface designs based on the results of the analysis. This study uses the TAM model as a reference for preparing the questionnaire by taking 5 variables, namely the perceived usefulness, perceived ease of use, attitude toward using, intention to use, and actual system use. The results obtained were analyzed with the help of Smart-PLS. The results of the analysis showed that the R Square value had moderate values on actual system usage and behavioral intention of 53.6% and 51.6%, and small values on attitude toward using and perceived usefulness of 24.7% and 19.4%, respectively. The F-square test shows that perceived usefulness and perceived ease of use have a small effect on attitude toward using with a vulnerable value of 0.02 - 0.15. Proposed improvements are the new user interface design in the “Homepage” display and the “Complaint Info” display and a new display recommendation, namely “payment info” and “transaction history” display.

articleTitle: Application of Image Recognition Technology in Lychee Downy Mildew
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: In today's world, where the number of people is increasing, the importance of agriculture has always been the focus of every country's attention. The application of image recognition technology in agricultural production has been paid more and more attention. At present, image recognition technology has been widely used in disease control of various crops, environmental supervision during the growth process, quality inspection of semi-finished agricultural products and deeply processed products, and has produced huge economic benefits. Based on the research of crop disease identification and detection at home and abroad, this paper establishes the classification model of crop disease. In this paper, the model established by PP-PicoDet algorithm can be used to identify phytophthora infestus of litchi trees, as well as to identify sickly leaves of litchi trees under complex background. Finally, it is hoped that the research method of lychee pests and diseases can be extended to other fruit trees to realize the identification of pests and diseases.

articleTitle: A Supporting System for Personalizing Learning Program for Elderly People
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Currently, Japanese society faces the hyper-aging society problem, and social participation of elderly people is required. In order to support social involvements of elderly people, importance of lifelong learning is increasing. However, designing learning programs for elderly people is not easy because they have various physical and mental conditions. As a result, elderly people who have physical disorders or physical and mental decline can find few opportunities to join learning programs. In this paper, a mechanism of supporting system for personalizing learning programs for elderly people, who have physical and mental problems, is proposed to solve the problem. The basic idea of the personalization mechanism are: (1) Eliminating optional steps in a learning program, and (2) proposing collaboration with others in a learning program. Experimental results, which are conducted for investigating the usefulness of the proposed mechanism, are shown. The results show that the proposed system can help coordinators of learning programs for elderly people.

articleTitle: Student's Awareness of Privacy and Security During Online Classes
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: As educational organizations started to handle COVID-19 issues, e-learning/online education emerged as one of the safest options for the world. There is a lack of security and privacy while attending virtual learning. This paper focused on types of vulnerabilities and how to overcome them by introducing Virtual Private Networks (VPN). We proposed a framework to be used during virtual learning. The framework will mainly work as a security tool that will disable access to all unrelated websites, social media, or online games. Students and lecturers can focus more on online classes without any disturbance. The proposed scheme is validated through a survey question. At the same time, using VPN can redesign the current online education system to be more systematic. Using a VPN for increased protection should be a regular practice, especially when attending online classes using communication technology. The results showed that almost 91.2% agreed to use a VPN during online education. Therefore, the proposed scheme is acceptable and needs to implement throughout all virtual learning institutes

articleTitle: Effect of Risk Perception and Anxiety on Travel Abroad during COVID-19: The Case of Bali
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The huge negative impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on the tourism industry around the world has been undeniable. Study regarding intention to behavior abroad among international tourists after COVID-19 is still limited. This research develops a conceptual framework that integrates risk perceptions and anxiety on travel intention of inbound tourists to Indonesia during COVID-19. A quantitative approach was selected and self-administrated questionnaires consisting of seven segments (physiological risk, psychological risk, financial risk, time risk, anxiety, intention to travel, and sociodemographic factors) were distributed to respondents in Bali, Indonesia. 487 valid questionnaires were collected from international tourists during their holiday in Bali. The data were analyzed by partial least squares–structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM). Most of the hypotheses were accepted. Furthermore, no significant effects of psychological and physiological risk on tourists’ intention to travel abroad were found. Several practical and theoretical implications for DMOs and marketers are discussed based on the findings.

articleTitle: Creation of Juices with Interactive Genetic Algorithm via Taste Communication between Users in Remote Locations
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Creating media content suited to many users is crucial from the viewpoint of business and a situation with multiple users' participation. Interactive Evolutionary Computation (IEC) is known as a search method that finds good solutions; however, it is originally for each user. This study proposes an IEC that gathers evaluations of multiple users in remote locations and utilizes them in the search, and the search target is good blended juices. Each user's good solution is exchanged between the users as a taste-communication. We had the experiment to investigate the proposed IEC's effectiveness with ten participants in five pairs: two participants of the pair located in different locations. The experimental results showed the effectiveness with a significant increase in fitness values and a significant convergence in the search space. Furthermore, details of the exchange of the GA individuals were investigated by observing the pair's exchange and comparing the fitness values of the exchanged GA individuals.

articleTitle: Digital Token: Token-Based Degree Certificates with Credit Transfer System
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The fake degree, diploma, or certificate is a global issue that affects many organizations, companies, and industries. With a rapid increase in the numbers of websites and social platforms, the fake degree certificate can be sold online by diploma mills or individuals. For falsifying academic transcripts and fake diploma are illegal in many countries. The using of the fake degree certificate can deceive educational universities, institutions or employers that they have obtained the legitimate degree. This issue may have the severe consequences for employers, universities, individuals, and public safety. There are companies have hired specialists to specifically review applicants' degrees. The traditional way of proving documents is difficult, time-consuming, and involves many intermediates that make the process more complicated. To counter this issue, this paper propose a solution by applying a blockchain technology. It can store degree certificates in a decentralized system that is immutable and traceable, reduce the need for intermediaries, and take a quick time for verification. This research develops the application using digital token to create genuine certificate. The results of this research provide a software prototype for issuing and verifying degree certificate.

articleTitle: User Experience Analysis on the My Indihome For Technician Application Using the Heuristic Evaluation Method
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: MyIndiHome for Technician application is a mobile application owned by PT. Telkom Access which functions to be used by technicians at work. However, the problem faced is how to find out the results of the user experience evaluation on the MyIndiHome for Technician application using the heuristic evaluation method. The heuristic indicators that will be tested in this study are visibility of system status, the match between the system and the real world, user control and freedom, consis,tency and standards, error prevention, recognition rather than recall, flexibility and efficiency of use, aesthetic and minimalist design, help users recognize, diagnose, recover from errors, and help and documentation. From the results of the research that has been carried out, it is found that the average MyIndiHome for Technician application user has a very good rating level category on each heuristic indicator tested. In addition, researchers will make improvements to the application design on the indicators that have the lowest scores in the questionnaire to be used as suggestions for improvement for developers for the convenience of MyIndiHome for Technician application users.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Autonomous Drone to Detect and Alert Intruders in Surveillance Areas
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The design and development of Autonomous Drone to detect and alert intruders in the surveillance area is a technology to support law enforcement personnel involved. To assess the situation, and to detect persons entering the surveillance area to alert relevant authorities. The structure is made of plastic and carbon fiber in the shape of a hexagon Autonomous Drone. The control unit is divided into flight controller and intruder detection camera control unit. The flight controller uses the Pixhawk board with: GPS module, Telemetry module, Receiver module and ESC module through Mission Planner control program. The intruder detection camera uses the Roboflow platform for object detection to detect people. Aviation is divided into 2 operation types. Manual is using: Stabilizer mode and Loiter mode. Automatic operation uses Auto mode to fly by waypoint working for human detection. In testing an Autonomous Drone to detect and alert intruders in the surveillance area, the test was divided into 3 parts: manual flight, automatic flight, and automatic flight with detection of people in the surveillance area. It was found that the manual flight has the highest accuracy of 97.50%. The automatic flight at 100 meters has the highest accuracy of 98.50%. Lastly, the automatic flight with human detection, in detecting and alerting at a height of 3 meters, has the highest accuracy of 97.00%. In the design and development of Autonomous Drone, there were problems in the structure designed with a 3D Printer to support the weight so that fastening of the parts could not be achieved as intended, resulting in the design of a new structure. The camera detection of the Autonomous Drone had problem in that the range of the active camera and the speed of the Autonomous Drone must be appropriate for the detection to work properly.

articleTitle: Private Permission Blockchain for Optimized Invoice Management System
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Blockchain technology has become popular in the recent years due to Bitcoin and Ethereum which are potential in terms of security, transparency and sharing in the same network by Peer-To-Peer network. Though this technology has high costing, it is worth to use in the businesses to reduce fraudulences from inside and outside of organization. Invoice system is a technology that all companies invest to protect the data of invoice management because it is important for analysis by the trends of business each year. In this paper the use of blockchain technology to protect the data of invoice by developing the invoice management system with smart contract for invoice rules to approve, reject, and to protect the data is proposed to find out changes of invoice in blockchain network system by a web application in intranet to manage the limitation of small business. The conceptual framework and the output obtained by the developed system shows the feasibility to develop a private blockchain system for invoice management.

articleTitle: Improving Data Transfer Efficiency for AIs in the DareFightingICE using gRPC
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This paper presents a new communication interface for the DareFightingICE platform, a Java-based fighting game focused on implementing AI for controlling a non-player character. The interface uses an open-source remote procedure call, gRPC to improve the efficiency of data transfer between the game and the AI, reducing the time spent on receiving information from the game server. This is important because the main challenge of implementing AI in a fighting game is the need for the AI to select an action to perform within a short response time. The DareFightingICE platform has been integrated with Py4J, allowing developers to create AIs using Python. However, Py4J is less efficient at handling large amounts of data, resulting in excessive latency. In contrast, gRPC is wellsuited for transmitting large amounts of data. To evaluate the effectiveness of the new communication interface, we conducted an experiment comparing the latency of gRPC and Py4J, using a rule-based AI that sends a kick command regardless of the information received from the game server. The experiment results showed not only a 65% reduction in latency but also improved stability and eliminated missed frames compared to the current interface.

articleTitle: Development of ANFIS-Based Controller for Spray Drying Machine
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence has significantly and drastically changed how people live and have assisted in finding innovative solutions to 21st-century issues in food production systems. In this situation, these technologies can aid in the preservation of valuable food items using spray-drying equipment. However, current control techniques, such as the PID algorithm included in these spray-drying machines, raise several concerns about how to retain high accuracy when manufacturing new native products that produce high-quality powders. These issues served as the impetus for this study on adopting an ANFIS machine learning algorithm with an aim to improve the accuracy of the current spray drying control system. Results show that the developed model did well in evaluations and that its deployment within the adaptive controller was effective. These accuracy improvements led to the development of a said adaptive controller for spray-drying machines to have an improved thermal efficiency ratio and more consistent product quality.

articleTitle: Improvement of Task Pattern Generation in Multi-task Call Centers
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Staff scheduling problem in call centers is very important, since effective staffing can improve work efficiency, reduce costs, and provide sufficient service for customers. In this research, we deal with the daily shift scheduling (rostering) problem in call centers with multiple tasks. It is known that the set covering model can be applied to obtain the optimal solution for this kind of problems. However, the size of the model increases explosively as the numbers of staff, shifts, and tasks increase, because it requires to enumerate all combinations (patterns) of shifts and tasks. Hence we need some methods to reduce the patterns. In a previous study, we proposed a heuristic algorithm to obtain sub-optimal solution by automatically generating necessary task patterns. But there are still some timeslots where understaffing and overstaffing occur simultaneously. Therefore in this study we aim to investigate whether task patterns can be further improved and to reduce the under-staffing through analysis of understaffing and overstaffing performance.

articleTitle: Multi-surface Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Temperature Estimation based on Automate Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor (PMSM) is a high-performance motor that is primarily utilized to power the motor of an electric vehicle, a new generation of transportation. Since temperature affects PMSM, monitoring real-time temperature using direct temperature detection via sensors complicates and increases the cost. As a consequence, the objective of this research aimed to use artificial intelligence with an automated machine learning technique to estimate three PMSM component temperature values, including stator winding, stator teeth, and the permanent magnet, using the same nine input features: ambient temperature, coolant temperature, direct-axis voltage, quadrature-axis voltage, motor speed, torque, direct-axis current, quadrature-axis current, and stator yoke temperature. As a result of this research, stator winding and stator tooth have prediction values and waveforms that are close to validation values, with Mean Absolute Errors of 4.651 and 1.902, respectively. On the other hand, permanent magnet prediction has a remarkably different value and waveform with validation on 8.054 Mean Absolute Error.

articleTitle: Analysis of Green Marketing for Sustainability: Evidence from select Social Enterprises in the Philippines
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Social enterprises are challenged not only to conduct business but also to accomplish social goals with communities, the economy, and the environment. More recently, green marketing is introduced by social enterprises in digital platforms and technologies. However, there is a handful of evidence of green marketing in social enterprises in developing countries. This study explores the use of TikTok videos to determine green marketing content, green marketing strategies, engagement, and potential benefits to social enterprises. Results show evident practices in the 4Ps: green product, green promotion, green price, and green place. Moreso, potential benefits gained from green marketing in TikTok videos cover attracting volunteers, appealing to investors for green investment, awareness building, and creating a target market. This study confirms that green marketing has its way in social enterprises to reach their desired target market and sustainability. This study presents some practice implications and future studies on green marketing.

articleTitle: Data and Sentiment Analysis of Monkeypox Tweets using Natural Language Toolkit (NLTK)
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: In this study, the researchers aimed to gain insights into how people perceive and react to monkeypox by performing sentiment analysis on Twitter data related to the disease using natural language processing techniques, specifically the Natural Language Toolkit (NLTK). This study analyzed 95000 tweets about monkeypox that were collected using Tweepy between August 19, 2022, and September 3, 2022. The preprocessing of the tweets included formatting date columns, using regular expressions to fix the structure of the text, and removing unnecessary symbols. Feature extraction was also utilized to find typos and errors using NLTK SpellChecker() as well as word count and sentence length. NLTK SentimentIntensityAnalyzer (SIA) was used to determine the user sentiments for every tweet. Visualization libraries such as Plotly, Seaborne, and Matplotlib were used to display the analysis. Pearson Correlation was used to see correlations between the tweets and feature-engineered columns. The sentiment distribution was most neutral, then negative, and least positive. The sentence length distribution per day and the overall sentence length by language were analyzed. A word cloud was also generated. The results showed that the sentiment distribution was neutral and the sentence length was around 50 words. The word cloud revealed that the most frequently occurring words were related to the symptoms and transmission of monkeypox, as well as the measures being taken to control the disease.

articleTitle: Real Time Map Matching for Low Frequency GPS Data Based on Machine Learning Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: GPS cannot perform well in urban area because of multipath problems that make GPS location contain low accuracy. So, the map matching method is the method to adjust GPS location to reduce GPS location error. However, the current map matching method requires GPS high frequency data for adjustment and it does not perform well in GPS low frequency data. So, the study explores the idea to improve the map matching method based on a kind of machine learning technology by using the classification method to adjust the low frequency GPS location. This research uses features such as speed, heading and location of the previous GPS point for a training machine learning the model and adjust points of the GPS location. The objective of this study is to develop accuracy of the map matching method and the speed of map matching method for low frequency GPS data. After processing data, we found that Random Forest is the machine learning model that contains highest precision, recall and F1-Score. Moreover, this model is a low sensitivity model when frequency of data changes, but Decision Tree is the fastest model in prediction time and it takes lower time for training than Random Forest model.

articleTitle: Is Customer Experience Important to Recommend the Use of Digital Bank Services?
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Digital banking services are self-service innovations for customers in getting information and completing banking transactions through electronic media while still paying attention to security aspects. Therefore, this study aims to analyze the behavior of customers who use digital bank services, focusing on security aspects and the perceived service experience. This study targets 210 customers in Indonesia with a purposive sampling technique. Data was collected using a questionnaire distributed online through social media. Data analysis used Partial Least Square-Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM). As a result, all hypotheses are accepted, namely customer experience and perceived technology security affect continuance usage and finally impact the intention to recommend digital banking services. Banking management must focus on security systems and services to create the best customer experience.

articleTitle: Applying Artificial Intelligence Technology in China's Intelligent Manufacturing Industry
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The use of artificial intelligence (AI) extends from consumer intelligence to enterprise intelligence, leading to a strong increase in productivity. Manufacturing sector has become a blue ocean market for AI due to its massive data accumulation. In 2019, AI met industrial Internet of Things at the edge layer, realizing the first year of AI in industrial flooring. The Asia-pacific region has emerged as a potential market for the industrial applications of AI. However, to what extent the use of AI will contribute to manufacturing sector in China remains largely unknown. In this study, qualitative data were collected using a questionnaire survey method. Twenty respondents from 5 different manufacturing enterprises in China were interviewed, and a set of questionnaires were issued to them. The measurement of time and budget commitments indicated that most of the respondents believed that AI projects did not meet enterprise expectations. This may be attributed to different influential factors such as research and development costs, technology monopoly, security issues and management factors. The present study aimed to understand the application status and development prospects of AI in Chinese manufacturing enterprises, fill in the gap between the ideal and reality of AI projects, and promote the economic growth of manufacturing industry.

articleTitle: Optimization of Blockchain Based E-voting
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Modern technology has created the need for information flow to be fast and effective. we have been able to reach this through the internet; the medium, that is, the internet has expedited every folks, by creating the communication cheap and quick. One such innovative technology is blockchain. Having the properties such as immutability, integrity and decentralized architecture, one of the prospective application of blockchain is e-voting. The objective of e-voting system using blockchain is to facilitate transparent, fair and verifiable approach. But the existing e-voting systems using blockchain take more time to reflect the vote casted by the voters as the number of voters increases and make the system slow. In this paper we propose a system which uses a consensus algorithm called PoA to minimize the time for authentication, mining and verification of casted votes. The Proposed system which replaces the PoW consensus algorithm, in existing system, with PoA consensus algorithm, proved to be faster than existing system by more than 9 seconds. Thus this paper highlights how the existing e-voting system using blockchain is slow and how the proposed system optimizes the time required and makes the system faster.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Use of Social Media Marketing towards Tourist's Trust and Purchase Intention
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The commercial influence of the travel and tourism industry is important to travel and tourism business development. The enlargement of social media as a means of delivering information delivers accessibility in various ways with the support of technology. This study focused on the importance of social media marketing that aims to discuss how social media marketing can affect trust and how trust influences purchase intentions. This article illustrates the variable factors that may be related to social media marketing. Based on these factors, this research created a quantitative survey of the 210 respondents who completed the questionnaires which were analysed through SPSS software. The result proves the relationship between social media marketing, trust, and purchase intention. This article also discusses how they are related. Finally, this study puts the research hypotheses to the test to provide a recommendation for being aware of the phenomenon of advertising that has changed from traditional marketing to digital marketing which allows tourist's use interactive communication and is active on social media applications.

articleTitle: Sequence-Labeling RoBERTa Model for Dependency-Parsing in Classical Chinese and Its Application to Vietnamese and Thai
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The author and his colleagues have been developing classical Chinese treebank using Universal Dependencies. We also developed RoBERTa-Classical-Chinese model pre-trained with classical Chinese texts of 1.7 billion characters. In this paper we describe how to finetune sequence-labeling RoBERTa model for dependency-parsing in classical Chinese. We introduce “goeswith”-labeled edges into the directed acyclic graphs of Universal Dependencies in order to resolve the mismatch between the token length of RoBERTa-Classical-Chinese and the word length in classical Chinese. We utilize [MASK]token of RoBERTa model to handle outgoing edges and to produce the adjacency-matrices for the graphs of Universal Dependencies. Our RoBERTa-UDgoeswith model outperforms other dependency-parsers in classical Chinese on LAS / MLAS / BLEX benchmark scores. Then we apply our methods to other isolating languages. For Vietnamese we introduce “goeswith”-labeled edges to separate words into space-separated syllables, and finetune RoBERTa and PhoBERT models. For Thai we try three kinds of tokenizers, character-wise tokenizer, quasi-syllable tokenizer, and SentencePiece, to produce RoBERTa models.

articleTitle: Habits and Satisfaction as a Driven for Customers to Repeat Use Cash on Delivery Payment Method
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Buyers use the COD payment method because they are familiar with traditional payment systems and feel comfortable because it provides various conveniences. Therefore, it is essential to investigate the role of habits and beliefs in shaping buyer intentions and behavior using the COD payment method in e-commerce. Data collection uses a questionnaire distributed online through social media to 300 COD users. Then, the data were analyzed using the partial least square-structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM) method. It is statistically proven that satisfaction, perceived payment alternatives, and habits positively affect the intention to use the COD payment method. Lastly, intention to use significantly affects repeat use of the COD payment methods.

articleTitle: Motivation and Satisfaction Affecting the Selection of Accounting Services Firm from The Perspective of Thai-Nichi Institute of Technology's Accountancy Students
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Nowadays, accounting firms are important in providing accounting services, financial reports, and tax planning for organizations doing business in Thailand. Choosing a quality accounting firm is therefore very important. Because financial reports are needed in accordance with the accounting standards and preparing taxes correctly according to the Revenue Code. The researcher is therefore interested in studying motivation and satisfaction affecting the selection of accounting firm services from the point of view of accounting students, at the Thai-Nichi Institute of Technology. The study found that the motivation in focusing on quality and service standards accounted for 43.40 percent of males' opinions. While females pay attention to quality, certified by the department of business development under the ministry of commerce accounting for 60.80 percent. And when comparing the satisfaction, classified by personal status in terms of gender in choosing services, it was found that the location of the accounting firm and the quality of the accounting firms were significantly different at the .05 level. In the comparison of the differences in the average satisfaction by year of the study, it was found that there were statistically significant differences at the .05 level in all aspects, namely the location of the accounting firm, quality, price of services, services, personnel, and physical environment.

articleTitle: A study on the Potential of a Hybrid Curriculum Combining a Structual Approach and a Task-based Approach in Japanese Language Learning: Based on a Survey of Students' Opinion
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Responding to the arguments that only structural teaching cannot improve students' speaking ability, Thai-Nichi Institute of Technology applied the hybrid curriculum (the combination of structural and task-based curriculum) in its Japanese language classes. The purpose of this research was to investigate the correlation between students' oral performance and the hybrid curriculum among the first and second year students in 2022. The survey was conducted with a sample of students studying Japanese Language and Business Administration course. Data were collected through a questionnaire consisting of three sections: students' self-evaluation for the interview test, students' reflection on the conversation class, and opinion on the conversation class and interview test. The results showed that there is a need to revise the way the structural curriculum is combined with task-based learning to improve students' speaking skills. It is necessary to reconsider the content and learning progress goals to improve the teaching method and positively influence the learning outcome.

articleTitle: Effects of note-taking on online lectures in terms of gaze allocation and amount of note-taking
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This study aimed to clarify the relationship between note-taking behavior among students and their understanding of online lectures. The relationship between note taking in class and comprehension has been investigated in various ways. However, the role of note-taking in online lectures, which have become as important as in-person lectures, is not yet fully understood. In this study, we investigated the relationship between lecture comprehension and note-taking, especially in online lectures consisting of short videos, from the viewpoint of where students' gazes are allocated in the lecture video and amount of notes. It was revealed that the participants who scored high on the test spent less time watching the lecture video and more time taking notes. Analysis of the eye tracking records suggested that there was no clear relationship between where in the lecture video the students focused their attention and their test performance. In terms of the amount of time spent on the notes, there was a relationship between greater quantity and better test performance. However, when the amount of notes was measured by the number of characters, the relation between the quantity and the test score was not observed. These results suggest that it is better to examine the note-taking time to characterize online lecture comprehension.

articleTitle: Applications of Cut, Paste, Learn Synthetic Image Generation, and Convolutional Neural Networks in Marine Animals Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Marine animal classification using computer vision is an important task for various applications, including monitoring biodiversity, conservation efforts, and fishing management. However, obtaining and labeling real-world images and videos of these marine animals can be challenging due to the difficulty of accessing and observing these animals in their natural environments. This study explored the use of synthetic images as a training dataset for marine animal classification through Cut, Paste, Learn (CPL) as one approach to generating synthetic images. This study investigates the use of different convolutional neural network (CNN) models for classifying marine animals including Lobster, Squid, Crabs, and Sea Urchins. The Cut Paste Learn image generation method was utilized to augment the training data, which combines image manipulation techniques by pasting foreground images of the classes randomly to a background image to generate synthetic images. Further, the performance of the different CNN models on a dataset of real-world images of marine animals were evaluated and compared the results to determine the most effective model for this task. The findings in this study may be employed for the use of CNN models in marine biology and the application of the Cut Paste Learn image generation method in other domains.

articleTitle: Behaviour and Marketing Mix That Affects the Selection Suki Teenoi Buffet Restaurant Service of Consumers in Bangkok and Perimeter
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This research has objectives to study consumer behavior, and marketing mix factors that are affecting the decision to choose the buffet restaurant. The population is consumers in Bangkok and perimeter. The size of the sample is 100 people. Using questionnaires as a tool for data collection Analyze descriptive data such as frequency distribution, percentage, mean, and standard deviation and inferential data that are including Chi-Square statistics. The results on the study showed that most of the samples were women aged 20–30 years. Have a bachelor's degree with a monthly income less than or equal to 15,000 baht and most of them are students. About Suki Teenoi buffet eating habits, most consumers have a frequency of using the Tee Noi Suki buffet restaurant 1–2 times per month, preferring to use the Tee Noi Suki buffet restaurant during 19.01-21.00 hrs. On weekdays (Monday-Friday), people mostly eat at Tee Noi Suki Buffet Restaurant with friends. The purpose of eating at Tee Noi Suki Buffet Restaurant is when they want to, and most of the consumers have data sources/media to use Helping to decide to eating at Tee Noi Suki buffet is a friend. The reasons for choosing to eat are all about personal factors, such as gender, age, income, education, and occupation, which result in different behaviours in choosing to choose the Suki Teenoi buffet restaurant were different and the marketing mix factors that are affecting to the decision to choose the Suki Teenoi buffet restaurant as a whole is at the most important level, the price is the consumer's highest priority, process, product, personnel, promotion, place is inferior and for the consumers' least importance is the channels of distribution with statistical significance at the level of 0.05

articleTitle: The Students' Perspective on “Gather Town” Virtual Meeting in Online Language Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Since COVID-19 emerged and became a pandemic in Indonesia, the pattern of learning has also changed. Various efforts were made to make learning more effective. One of them is by using learning applications and learning websites. The applications used can be developed independently or using applications that have been developed and are free to use. This study discusses the use of the Gather Town Virtual Meeting (GTVM) Website in learning Mandarin speaking skills. GTVM is a virtual meeting platform that combines video calls with 2D maps. The appearance and content of Gather Town itself is similar to Video Game with 8 Bit video quality. The students of this study were 26 students. Two things that will become the research objectives in this research after learning by using the Gather Town Website are: 1. How to design online learning with GTVM as supporting tools in language learning; 2. How the students' perspectives about GTVM using in language online learning. The method in this research is the class action method. Students are asked to study Mandarin videos on GTVM. Then the students re-write the new vocabulary learned from each video and retell the contents of the story heard in Mandarin in their own language. The conclusion of this study is that students feel that learning through GTVM can encourage them to be more active in learning, increase new vocabulary knowledge and improve their speaking ability in Mandarin.

articleTitle: The Necessity and Strategy for Stability-Constrained Recursive Variable Digital Filters
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Digital filters are the basic signal processing systems required in widespread fields such as speech processing, image processing, and digital communications. The digital filters possessing tunable frequency properties are named as variable filters. Such filters can be regarded as reconfigurable signal processing systems, which are able to perform online characteristic tuning. When a new characteristic is needed, one can change the coefficients in real time to achieve the required updates. In dealing with variable recursive filters, stability-guarantee is a central and unavoidable issue because the change of the filter's coefficients may incur instability. Basically, designing a variable recursive filter necessitates nonlinear programming, and such a design formulation without stability constraints is most likely to produce an unstable recursive filter. Up to the present, the author has proposed an effective strategy to ensure the stability, which is based on parameter-transformations. This paper aims to reconfirm the rationale for the stability-constrained design formulation via computer simulations. Computer simulations are performed to verify that it is most unlikely to get a stable variable recursive filter if the design is carried out without imposing any stability constraints. This indicates that the results from computer simulations are highly consistent with the stability theory, and the simulation results also reconfirm the necessity of stability-constrained strategy for getting a stability-guaranteed variable filter in recursive structure.

articleTitle: Students’ Opinions of On-Demand Materials on Japanese Language and Culture
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The purposes of this study were 1) to investigate the intention first-year students at Thai-Nichi Institute of Technology who want to go to Japan after graduation; 2) to compile students' opinions about On-Demand teaching materials of Japanese language and culture. The sample includes 240 first-year students in the second semester of 2022 academic year. We collected the data using 9 items online questionnaire about On-Demand teaching materials of Japanese language and culture distributed through first-year students' Google Classroom during November 7 - 22, 2022. The data were statistically analyzed using a computer program and the data analyses were based on frequency, percentage, mean, standard deviation, and ANOVA. The findings revealed that; 1) Majority of the students want to work in Japan after graduation while the others want to further their study. 2) The students recognize the value of On-Demand teaching materials, but when it comes to actual usage; it is unclear whether they are suitable for On-Demand classes. The students are aware that On-Demand materials are more suitable for disciplined learners with self-control and time management. Therefore, it would be better to have a teacher conducting face-to-face sessions for half of the class hours.

articleTitle: The Effect of Learning Facilities and the Role of Lecturers on Interest in Hybrid Learning: A Case Study at Binus University
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Covid-19 has brought many changes in all fields, including the world of education. Since the Indonesian government banned face-to-face learning (Onsite learning), Universities held online learning. At the beginning of the change, there were so many obstacles experienced. Bina Nusantara University also held online learning. In the even semester of the 2022 academic year, hybrid classes begin. This research aims to determine the effect of learning facilities and the role of lecturers on interest in learning in a hybrid student of the Japanese study program at Binus University. This study used the quantitative method by distributing questionnaires to students in semesters 1 and 3 in odd semesters in 2022. This research is categorized as ex post facto research by conducting systematic empirical investigations. From the results of simultaneous testing of the associative hypothesis as the elaboration of the problem formulation, learning facilities and the role of the lecturer simultaneously influence the interest in learning in a hybrid variable by 80%.

articleTitle: UX Evaluation of Application Learning Management System Taspen Company (Persero) Using the Pacmad Model (People at the Center of Mobile Application)
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: PT TASPEN (Persero) has an e-learning application as an internet-based learning system. Along with its use, continuous development is needed, and it requires user participation to provide an assessment of the use of e-learning applications in terms of user experience. The purpose of this study is to evaluate the e-learning application, determine the level of usability, and measure user satisfaction with the features of the e-learning application which will be used as recommendations for improvement. The research method used is the PACMAD model with SEM PLS testing with respondents from employees of PT TASPEN (Persero) whole work units using survey tools using Google Form. The results of the R-Square test are known that the efficiency variable value is 0.471, memorability is 0.666 and the Satisfaction value is 0.533 which indicates the level of influence between variables with moderate results, then the F-Square test shows that the efficiency variable has an influence on the satisfaction variable with the same effect value. the smallest compared to the other variables, namely 0.041. Therefore, the proposed improvement focused on the new user interface design effective and efficient for users, and that is the “Main Page” display adding the types of learning topics and changing the position of the latest learning to scrolling sideways, and separating menu between user and admin status on the display. Moreover, in the “Learning Menu” a preview link and download are suggested to be added to the learning material module.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Web-Based Market Place Using Dynamic Programming Algorithm with Data Analytics for Agricultural Products
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: A web-based market place is developed to oblige sellers to increase their income and sales. Several approaches are utilized using the internet product markets, but none are legitimate or inaccurate. This study analyzes agricultural entities using a dynamic programming procedure to build a system application called “Online Agricultural Marketplace System (DEMETER),” which supports farmers and increases harvest deals and earnings. Incorporating information and communication technology into the agriculture has been studied. A DPA can be utilized to answer complicated questions that computer programmers face. Instead of explaining why a specific phenomenon occurred, researchers used descriptive research to describe the features of the area in which the primary interest in this study. interested. Moreover, the researchers used data visualization to provide a visual representation of the acquired data during the data analysis process. This enables researchers to construct a visual environment for gaining insights and identifying patterns and trends in the acquired data.

articleTitle: Knowledge Management and Sustainable Competitive Advantage in the Kingdom of Bahrain
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Knowledge management (KM) has become one of the most exciting topics in today's fast-paced and changing business world. More and more business organizations see KM as a sustainable competitive advantage (SCA) source. This paper looks at how business organizations in the Kingdom of Bahrain use KM and SCA together. The paper adopts a cross-sectional survey design. The KM initiatives are categorized into knowledge creation, knowledge storage, knowledge transfer, and knowledge application. Employees' attitudes towards workplace knowledge resources are derived from their perceptions of their importance, usefulness, and ease of use. Organizations sustain competitiveness by improving product or service quality, performing efficiently, or innovating. Data is collected via an electronic questionnaire developed using Google Forms. Purposive sampling used a list of 122 subjects from randomly selected business organizations. Ninety responses were received and taken into consideration for data analysis. Spearman correlation analysis and Partial Least Square Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM) revealed a positive association between KM adoption and SCA. The study reflected a positive association between employees' attitudes toward knowledge resources and sustaining organizations' competitive advantages. The study recommends the effective launch and adoption of KM to achieve SCA. Also, the study suggests organizations and academics explore the factors that improve employees' attitudes towards knowledge resources at their workplace to realize the potential gains on firms' SCA.

articleTitle: Interviewing Young Adults about Cryptocurrency Literacy and Investment Intention
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: As the world becomes more digitalized, decentralized financial transactions using digital currency known as cryptocurrency may become more accepted and used by the general public. 16 young adults were interviewed in a qualitative research about their basic cryptocurrency literacy and investment intention. The interviewees were asked open-ended questions about their knowledge on how to make cryptocurrency transactions, willingness to invest in cryptocurrency, barriers to cryptocurrency investment intention, and their future vision of cryptocurrency. The results showed a lack of basic cryptocurrency literacy amongst young adults, high unwillingness or reluctance to invest in cryptocurrency due to its poor reputation, and uncertainty about the future of cryptocurrency. Numerous barriers that must be overcome to make cryptocurrency more acceptable to general public use include addressing their issues of untrustworthiness, riskiness, and volatility, as well as improving certain conditions of the cryptocurrency market with increased stability, security, and more regulation to discourage criminal activities. If the issues with using cryptocurrency are addressed, digital marketing and banking will be revolutionized.

articleTitle: Color Selection of Multimedia Arts Students at LPU-MNL in Building a Brand Identity: A Quantitative Study
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This research study aims to determine how future graphic designers specifically; junior & senior year Multimedia Arts students of Lyceum of the Philippines University Manila (LPU-MNL) utilize colors in strategizing and designing a brand's visual identity. The purpose of this study is to gain an in-depth understanding on the usage of colors by future graphic designers and to analyze their thought process within their design strategy. Utilizing the census method, the researchers conducted survey questionnaires that made use of the Likert scale which were disseminated online. Through collecting the data, descriptive research analysis and an inferential statistical test has been employed quantitatively to scrutinize sixty-three (63) respondents and their design strategy for color selection in building a visual identity of a brand. This study determined which colors are effective for a brand identity according to graphic design students, as well as the implications of the findings being consistent with other studies related to colors and their attributions in categories such as corporate brand, personal brand, product brand, and service brand. Furthermore, the color selection of graphic design students at LPU-MNL in building a brand identity has demonstrated a significant relationship between color attributions (color psychology) and their design strategy in color selection.

articleTitle: Development of Augmented Reality in Online Learning Education
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: ABC University is one of the largest private universities in Indonesia that has implemented online learning. Many teaching materials have been provided, including presentation materials, lecturer notes, videos, and practicum modules. The purpose of this research is to develop AR as a new technology in online learning. In addition, Augmented Reality (AR) is used as additional material to support success in online learning. This research took one of the courses in the three study programs used for research, namely management, computer science, and accounting with a total participation of seventy-nine people. This application is designed using the UML (Unified Modeling Language) model and is built using open-source applications, namely Unity, Blender, and Android Studio. The development of this learning system uses the ADDIE model design instructor framework. The assessment of this application was obtained for measurements using N-gain in the “moderate” and “quite effective” categories, while for measurements using usability testing the learnability value was 3.88, the memory value was 4.11, the efficiency value was 4.04, the error value of 4.10, and a satisfaction value of 3.91.

articleTitle: An Image Measurement System for Detecting Dents and Scratches on the Surface of Used Car Body Parts
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: As abandoned cars have become a huge social problem, procedures to reuse them are urgently required. Before reusing used car body parts, it is necessary to inspect them for defects such as dents and scratches. Currently, most companies around the world perform manual inspections. Manually detection of these used cars is time consuming and over-relies on individual judgement. In this paper, an automatic used car body parts detection system is proposed based on image measurement. A two-times shooting technique is taken by this system to distinguish the dent and scratch on the car body surface, and at the same time, a neural network-based target detection method is proposed to locate the position of dent. Furthermore, a scratch extraction method is also involved. The experiment result shows that the proposed method can be used to detect car body parts with reflective surfaces. And the two-times shooting technique reduces the time used to take images.

articleTitle: Non-GPS-based ETA Models Constructed from Historical GPS Data and Traffic Contexts
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Without GPS data, ETA can be estimated with good precision from historical GPS data and the context of the traffic environment. In this paper, the estimated travel duration between bus stops was computed based on historical GPS data with time stamps. Three approaches were employed to compute the duration between bus stops: (i) statistical central tendencies, (ii) nonlinear regression techniques i.e., decision tree regressor, random forest regressor and k-nearest neighbors regressor, and (iii) an ANN predictive model. These three approaches capture different characteristics of the traffic environment. Statistical central tendencies give the overall view of the ETA information while nonlinear regressors can capture context from the time stamps (e.g., weekdays vs holidays). Finally, predicting the duration required to reach the next bus stop based on previous timespans on the same route implicitly captures temporal dynamics of the traffic environment from previous time steps and the ANN predictive model exploits this temporal information. The feasibility of ETA estimation using these three approaches was explained, evaluated and discussed.

articleTitle: Wavelet based Contour Extraction for Person Identification in Dental Images
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Forensic Odontology is a specialised field of victim identification that includes the identification of salvaged humans as well as the proof of identity including whole or scrappy bodies. Contour information of dental x ray images provides better matching for person identification. In this paper, we propose an automatic Wavelet Sliding Neighborhood (WSN) method for human forensic identification which comprises of preprocessing, integral intensity projection, contour extraction and shape matching. The first step preprocessing is used to remove the noise present in the dental x ray or radiographic images. The second step entangles integral intensity projection for untying the lower jaw, upper jaw and individual teeth. Third stage uses wavelet based sliding neighborhood to extract the shape of the dental image without any discontinuities in the edges of an image. The final stage, shape matching is used for estimating the distance measure for matching ante-mortem (AM) and post-mortem (PM) dental records. The experimental results demonstrate that our proposed WSN method outperforms and achieves a highest similarity than the existing approaches with a computation time of 1.25s.

articleTitle: Brain Exercise System Assistant for Elder People
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The aging of societies worldwide has led to an increase in the prevalence of dementia, a progressive and debilitating brain disorder that affects memory, cognition, and behavior. To address the challenge of dementia in an aging society, efforts are underway to promote healthy lifestyles and prevent or delay the onset of dementia through education, physical activity, and brain exercise. The feather of the system tries to have a big screen output with an LCD monitor to make things easier to see for elder people and increase the difficulty by one level after each play. The result shows participants tended to use it better, as evidenced by the time of use decrease and the score increase by collecting data for using the system from 50 elder people who used it once a day for a total of 5 days, then recording the time of use and scores obtained from using it each time and analyzing the data by looking for trends. In addition, the elderly are satisfied with the system by asking for satisfaction through a questionnaire about the user interface, user experience, the calculating game, and the Thai word memory game. The results of this research are likely to improve the computational and memory of the elderly. Moreover, they were satisfied with the system at the highest level.

Author Keywords: satisfaction of the brain exercise system

articleTitle: Factors Impacting Positive WOM of Online Shopping of Gen Z Customers in Thailand
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The authors investigated factors influencing positive Word-of-Mouth (WOM) of Thai Generation Z online buyers. The population of this study was the online buyers who were Gen Z. They studied at a large private university which is located in the province of Pathum Thani. The samples of 309 participants were gathered with survey method using the questionnaires. Most respondents were females at the age of around 20 years of age. They mostly spent around 10,001 to 20,000 baht each month for their spending. The products that they purchased online the most were fashion and healthcare products respectively. Most purchased online items from social networking sites such as Facebook. Multiple regression analysis was implemented. The researchers revealed that only security, perceived usefulness, and brand affiliation motivation had positively influencing positive WOM of online Gen Z shoppers in Thailand. The results of this research could be useful for online business owners especially the ones who wanted positive WOM by Gen Z consumers.

articleTitle: The Delphi Approach for Benchmarking Student Learning Behaviour in Ubiquitous Learning Context
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Within the realm of education, the idea of ubiquitous learning has emerged as a significant topic and a significant advancement in the discipline. In this respect, this study tries to investigate and benchmark the ubiquitous learning behavior of the students at University Teknologi MARA, Perlis Branch in the new context of the proposed ubiquitous learning model. The study adopts a qualitative research design as it aims to obtain multifaceted information through in-depth interview sessions with the participants selected for the study. The Delphi method was used in this study for data collection. Two rounds of data collection from a group of experts were employed in this approach. The input for the study was gathered from twelve participants who had experience with ubiquitous learning. The findings of this study highlighted some variations between the identified learning behaviour of the students and the suitable behaviour of the learners. The implications of the study were discussed.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Approach to Predict E-commerce Customer Satisfaction Score
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the performance of machine learning (ML) to predict customers' satisfaction score from the sales dataset collected by Olist, the Brazilian e-commerce company. Customer satisfaction score is categorized into 4 classes: Low, Average, Good and Excellent where majority of sales orders receive Excellent score. Inspired by the fact that delivery duration and product rating score obtained from other customers' purchase are one of the main factors that influence customer's satisfaction score, we propose a feature engineering method that creates delivery duration and the average product rating score which are used as the main features in the ML model. We employ Random Forest (RF), Logistic Regression (LR), and K-Nearest Neighbor (K-NN) to predict customers' satisfaction score and their performance are compared with the baseline model which predicts the customer satisfaction score using the average product rating score. Results show that RF model yields the best performance with the average precision, recall, and macro F1 equal to 0.34, 0.36, and 0.32, respectively. In addition, RF achieves the best recall equal to 0.43, 0.33 and 0.33 for Low, Average and Good classes. The mean and SD of the product rating are two features with the highest feature importance equal to 0.313 and 0.087, respectively.

articleTitle: Applying Self-Assessment Manikin (SAM) to Evaluate the Emotional Responses to the Service Robot Feature
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This study aims to examine the valence, arousal, and dominance associated with a participant's affective response to different waiter robots. We used a Self-Assessment Manikin (SAM) to assess emotional responses to these issues. SAM consists of a set of three pictorial scales, each representing a different affective dimension: valence, arousal, and dominance. In this study, SAM uses a pictorial representation of a human to evaluate the four types of waiter robots. The experiments were carried out through a questionnaire using Google Forms. Participants were shown video clips of four different types of waiter robots and then assessed to rate them using the SAM scale. The type 3 waiter robots were found that have the highest emotional responses across all three dimensions because they sounded interactive and user-friendly. Waiter robots can provide a sense of novelty and excitement for customers, which can create a positive emotional response. They can provide a unique and memorable customer experience, enhancing the overall dining experience. The results of this experiment will be helpful in the development of robots for service applications.

articleTitle: Metalized Polymer-Film Capacitors Health Estimation for Three-Phase DC to AC Converters with Artificial Intelligences
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Metalized polymer-film capacitors have attained a unique role amongst numerous types of capacitors due to their self-healing ability. However, owing to the increasing usage of converters for transmissions in networks, it is necessary to enhance stability to certify the safety of system operations. Thus, a monitoring process that enables predictive maintenance is essential for evaluating the health status to ensure the stability of electrical systems. This study presents a condition monitoring strategy that utilizes frequency signal analysis to identify capacitor health in a three-phase AC-DC converter. Capacitor current is analyzed using the discrete wavelet transform and normalized by indexes, which is used as input of learning algorithms. A number of indexes, such as root-mean-squared value, variance, average, and median, are behaved as the inputs of artificial intelligent models to examine the film capacitor's factors. The estimated parameters verify that applying the discrete wavelet transform conjoined with indexes for capacitor current provides an excellent accuracy of about 99.85%. This study provides comprehensive insights into film capacitor monitoring using advanced techniques and is expected to be informative for monitoring film capacitors in practical applications.

articleTitle: Development of Smart Sport Tourism Model Based on Smart City Integrated with Sport Tourism Principles
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This research aimed to develop the smarts sport tourism model according to the sport tourism supply chain and smart tourism concepts. The model was developed based on the 6 key dimensions of smart city including 1) smart economy, 2) smart mobility, 3) smart environment, 4) smart governance, 5) smart people and 6) smart living [1].
