The researcher conducted a systematic literature review and found out that the factors of the development of smart sport tourism consisted 11 indicators including 1) demand estimation, 2) product development, 3) information technology system management, 4) transportation system management, 5) infrastructure, 6) safety, hygienic and environmental operations, 7) executive commitment and smart city development plan, 8) human resource management, 9) community-based tourism managed by local committee, 10) collaborations of stakeholders, and 11) building relationship with travelers which would be implemented in the development plan for smart sport tourism.

articleTitle: An Exploratory Study on the Design of Emergency First Aid Privacy Protection Computing System Based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The COVID-19 epidemic at the end of 2019 is a typical global public health event. It has spread to more than 200 countries around the world. In the face of sudden illness, the emergency department is the first choice for most patients, and it is often the first to grasp the basic situation of patients. In the process of processing the data of the emergency big data center, how to ensure the privacy of patients while using medical data reasonably. This paper mainly takes the data of the emergency big data center as the research object. Put important health data on the block chain to ensure that important data remains traceable throughout the process, cannot be tampered with, multi-point maintenance, unified standards, and realize the formation of emergency block chains, and use important health data based on privacy applications, Realize the historical traceability of data usage. At the same time, the calculation process of privacy calculation can also be uploaded to the chain, which can be used for data storage, auxiliary calculation, etc.

articleTitle: Fresh Weight Estimation of Lettuce Using 3D Stereoscopic Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The fresh weight gain of lettuce is an indication of growth. Therefore, fresh weighing is used in the growth monitoring process in order to analyze health and predict the optimal harvesting time. The study found that the current fresh weight estimation could be done by a digital image processing method that did not disturb the plant and was fast. In this paper, a new method for the fresh weight estimation of lettuce using a 3D stereoscopic technique was proposed by creating a 3D spatial domain from stereo images. The fresh weight of lettuce was estimated by the sum of the area in each surface layer. The estimated fresh weight (grams) of lettuce was consistent with the actual weight (grams), with a correlation coefficient of 0.98 and an RMSE of 2.42. The result showed that a 3D stereoscopic technique could be used as a tool to estimate the fresh weight of lettuce for monitor the plant growth, analyze the plant health, and predict the optimal harvesting time.

articleTitle: A Transfer Learning Approach for Tyre Wear Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Automobiles have become an indispensable mode of transportation and travel as the economy has grown. Tires are vital components of automobiles, and their wear contributes to a huge number of road accidents. As a result, anticipating tyre life has become one of the most important criteria to avoid accidents. The proposed work classifies the tire wear condition such as No wear, Light Wear, Moderate Wear, High Wear, and Extreme Wear using a pre-trained deep learning model. The first tyre dataset was created with 1403 total images in 5 classes. Then the tyre dataset was used to classify the tire wear condition by the pre-trained model ResNet50. When compared to other pre-trained models such as SqueezNet, ResNet18, ResNet101, and InceptionResNet, the ResNet50 provided better recognition accuracy of 95.1%. The performance of the proposed method was compared with state of art methods.

articleTitle: Predicting Licensure Examination Performance Using Data Mining Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Data mining is the process of identifying anomalies, trends, and correlations in massive historical data sets in order to predict future events. The aim of this paper is to use data mining techniques to compare various classification algorithms such as J48, Random Forest, Naïve Bayes, and Logistic Regression to develop a model that can reliably predict a student's performance on the Licensure Examination for Teachers (LET). This model will be used by the institution as a decision-making tool to increase the percentage of students who will pass the board examination. The datasets were extracted from student records between the years of 2017 and 2019 from the registrar's office, Bachelor in Business Teacher Education (BBTE) program, and Professional Regulation Commission (PRC) website using various attributes namely; students' General Weighted Average (GWA), General and Professional Education subjects, honors they had received, their scholarship information, records from review centers, and LET results. WEKA, a data mining tool was used to analyze the dataset. According to the study's findings, J48 had the highest accuracy percentage, compared to the other three classification algorithms. Therefore, J48 provides the most accurate results in predicting the student board examination performance. The results were validated using a number of metrics, such as precision, recall, f-measure, and Cohen's kappa.

articleTitle: Adaptation in Game: Consumer Rating Result for Remade and Remastered Games (1997-2022)
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Old school games which gained their fame in the era of Sony PlayStation (PS) and PlayStation 2 (PS2) have made a comeback in different style. This adaptation work is known as remaking and remastering. The research objects are remade and remastered games in the latter consoles such as PS4, PS5, Nintendo Switch, and alikes; without taking Personal Computer (PC) and mobile games into account. Qualitative method is used in the discussion of user rating and its effects on the research objects. The research aims to seek pros and cons of remade and remastered games by looking at ratings given by consumers from those adapted works. The result of this research showed how remade and remastered games rated low in comparison to original games. It is found from questionnaires and literature review that pricing and technical factors played role in the decrement of remade and remastered games rating as they cost more expensive while having little updates or bug fixes.

articleTitle: Evaluation of User Acceptance on the Lemihealth Digital Platform Using the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) Method
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Lemihealth is a web-based and mobile-based digital service. Some of the services in it are vaccination services, child immunization, and health registration at several hospitals or clinics that have become Lemihealth partners. The purpose of the study was to evaluate user acceptance and assess the level of user experience with the Lemihealth application. This study uses the TAM method with the external variables of Motivation and Content Quality. From the results of the analysis in the Fornell Larcker table, there is a correlation between Motivation and Motivation which is 0.746 against Motivation with Perceived Ease of Use which is 0.800 so that discriminant validity is not met. In addition, in the HTMT table there is a relationship between the variables Content Quality with Motivation and Motivation with Perceived Ease of Use which has an HTMT value of more than 0.9. To ensure the discriminant between the two reflective constructs, the value of the variable must be less than 0.9. From this figure, three focus recommendations for improvement in the user interface are generated, namely on information on health facilities, payment information and payment methods.

articleTitle: Improvement of Spare parts Warehouse Management in Selected Garage
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Effective warehouse management impacts the financial resources of the businesses. It reduces unnecessary costs as the inventory level is accurately identified. The goal of this study was to optimize the operation time of the spare parts warehouse management. The research investigated the operational process, the time required for each operation in the warehouse, and the cost of all spare parts at the selected Garage. Prior warehouse management processes overlooked a consistent standard that warehouse staff could comply with during the order-picking process, resulting in time-consuming product searches and high inventory costs. This study optimizes warehouse management using multiple criteria, including ABC analysis based on the frequency of use, incorporated with distance and spare part characteristics consideration, in which products in category A were located closest to the door, and characteristics of each spare part are considered to identify a specific location for each spare part. This improvement results in a 48.49% reduction in total operation time for searching for spare parts. This study demonstrates the significance of ABC analysis in optimizing warehouse management.

articleTitle: Analysis on Remote Global Co-Creative Design Process with Evaluation Grid Method
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The International Summer Design Workshop (ISDW) is an annual workshop aiming to increase intercultural awareness and promote design skills. In it, participants from South-East Asia gather and, working in intercultural groups using English as a lingua franca, participate in a co-creative design process to develop a product proposal. In 2020, due to international travel issues resulting from the COVID-19 pandemic, the organizers utilized online communication and design tools (Zoom, Miro, LINE and FielCam) to hold the ISDW remotely. This paper examines participants' reflections to understand how their groups collaborated during this event. Interview data from three participants was analyzed using the Evaluation Grid Method. Results indicate that when students were able to create group cohesion quickly, they were able to effectively use the various online collaboration tools. Otherwise, communication issues tended to deteriorate during the process. While there were positive aspects such as the flexibility of working from their homes, participants also said that socializing opportunities and inter-group communication were insufficient. Written reflections from eight Japanese participants corroborated interview findings that developing empathy and effective communication were important. Results will be used further to develop the remote co-creative process for future ISDWs.

articleTitle: Medicine Recommendation for Pharmacists at Drug Stores based on Data Analysis of Conditional Knowledge
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The purpose of this research was to support pharmacists in giving information to patients with medication recommender systems using the Rule-based and Gradient boosting tree methods. The cases of the system consist of the patients taking medication independently without doctors' diagnosis with household medicines to relieve basic symptoms and the symptoms of patients that should receive real treatment at the hospital. In addition, technology solutions such as machine learning have been valuable for application in health care. Accordingly, this research starts with getting a patient's information such as symptoms, chronic diseases, drug allergies, and medicine a pharmacist asks some general questions for understanding the patient's health condition and constructing databases by processing the medication knowledge. Rules were extracted from pharmacy guidelines for filtering the Hospital Cases that are out of the scope of the drugstore and the patient should receive medical care from a specialist. Then the system would analyze the data for recommendations the medicine and display it on the user interface. Lastly, we tested the performance of the system by evaluating with accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score.

articleTitle: User Experience Analysis on the Edlink Mobile Application using Usability Testing Method
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: In the era of digitalization, it is necessary to make adjustments or adaptations to several activities, one of which is in the field of education, namely the use of E-Learning. E-learning (electronic learning) is a distance learning model that utilizes information technology. PT Sevima develops an application called Edlink which can be used as a distance learning medium, however based on the reviews from the Play Store and App Store on the Edlink mobile application, there have been negative reviews given by the users such as the user interface of the application's homepage which is considered less informative and the application's inability to copy and paste in the chat message. This research is expected to increase the use value of the Edlink mobile application; therefore, it can be accepted and can be used as a solution for the Edlink mobile application development. The method used in this research was Usability Testing. This was done by distributing questionnaires to 116 students using the Edlink mobile application as the respondents. The data from the questionnaires were processed and examined using Kuesio.id. Based on the results of the questionnaires, it is revealed that the Edlink mobile application actually has fulfilled the users' satisfaction in terms of its available features and menus. However, there are still several features that need to be improved and added, so the application can accommodate the needs of many users to create a friendlier user interface and better user experience.

articleTitle: “Panen Raya” Game Entrepreneurship Learning Media Development: Indonesian Context
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The learning process can greatly benefit from the latest technological advancements in the realm of educational media. For this reason, the study aims to create multimedia products that are both interactive and appropriate for usage in instructional settings. An R&D strategy based on the ADDIE model was used to compile the results of this investigation (Analysis, Design, Development, Implementation, Evaluation). There is no testing involved in the data collection process, and the tools used at each stage are different. We used observation sheets, questionnaires for needs analysis, a document study for design, and a multimedia feasibility survey with input from media experts, educators, and fifty students for analysis, design, development, and implementation, respectively. Teachers are not using ICT-based media to their full potential throughout the learning process, according to the study's findings; nonetheless, students enthusiastically endorse the creation of high-quality interactive multimedia, which is followed by suggestions for improving product quality. When taken as a whole, the category of “interactive multimedia” is a perfect fit for what it does: educating. Someday, researchers from many disciplines will perhaps examine the efficacy of various forms of media used for education.

Index Terms: Information And Communication Technology In Education

articleTitle: Energy Efficiency and Environmental Sustainability of Insulated Roofs for Stand-Alone Convenience Store in Hot-Humid Climate
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The increasing number of convenience stores in Thailand impacts both national energy consumption and greenhouse gas emission levels. The typical convenience store in Thailand consists of polyethylene as insulation material which indicates that the possibility of improvements in these stores is high. This paper presents the energy, economic and environmental analysis of the insulated roof of the stand-alone convenience store. The goal of this study is to analyze the three aspects of insulated roofs with the help of a simple resistance-capacitance model which is validated by the experimental study as well as in-situ measurements. The results show a significant difference in the energy, economic and environmental performance of the roof when two different insulation materials were used (polyethylene and polyurethane). With a longer payback period and lower life cycle cost, the PU roof demonstrated reduced energy consumption and cradle-to-use phase carbon dioxide emissions when compared to the PE roof.

articleTitle: Application of Planned Behavior Theory for Analysis of Customer's Revisit Intention to a Small Business Coffee Shop in Malang City
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This study examines how specific factors in the theory of planned behavior and additional perceived authenticity impact the revisit intention of SME-based coffee shops in Malang. Using purposive sampling, the sample was 239 respondents in Malang. Analyzed using Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) and tested empirically using Partial Least Square (PLS). This study added perceived authenticity as a novelty by focusing on the specific attributes that comply with the theory of planned behavior. This study will encourage SME-based coffee shop to gain consumer interest in making revisit intentions. Product quality, price fairness, and store atmosphere significantly affected attitudes. Service quality does not affect attitudes. Attitude and perceived authenticity had significant affect to revisit intention. Subjective norms and perceived behavioral control do not affect revisit intention.

articleTitle: UX Analysis of Legal Analytics Applications at Internal Telkom South Jakarta Using the TAM
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Legal Analytics is a new application that was released on January 27, 2022, so this application can be said to be only a little over a year old. This app focuses on the process of drafting laws and regulations digitally. This research aims to measuring user interest in the Legal Analytics application to facilitate users in carrying out their daily work and implementing the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) theory so that the Legal Analytics application can be accepted by users. The method used in this study is the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) by explaining factors such as Perceived Usefulness, Attitude Toward Use, Actual System Usage, Behavioral Intention of Use and Perceived Ease of Use that influence the acceptance of the Legal Analytics application with the SmartPLS application to process test result. The results obtained from this study are Fornell Larcker which is valid, but there are two aspects of the HTMT that are invalid because they are above 0.9, namely Perceived Ease of Use on Attitude Toward Use which is worth 0.920 and Perceived Ease of Use on Behavioral Intention of Use which has a value of 0.915, so improvements are needed in the application. Another result is the R Square value which indicates that the majority of respondents have a positive attitude towards using the Legal Analytics application and have a high intention to use it, so it can be concluded that the results of this study indicate that the majority of users accept the Legal Analytics application and have a high interest in using the Legal application. Analytics in facilitating his daily work. The result of the implementation of the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) method in the Legal Analytics application is an improvement in several views of the application that has been recommended, namely improving the appearance of the Document Recap and Document Setting & Drafting menus.

articleTitle: Optimization of Ticket Handling Process through Helpdesk Application System Design
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Technology facilitates every company activity, including unifying device functionality. An information system built to help provide a checklist of tools, tasks, and procedures. PT Bach Multi Global (BMG) is a Manage Service provider company related to Indosat Ooredoo Hutchinson (IOH) electrical problems. BMG is responsible for handling electrical issues in each IOH Tower, which are spread across 30,000 towers nationwide. In one month, there are around more than 300,000 Trouble Tickets issued to be resolved. This study builds a system that can facilitate the completion of tickets. RAD (Rapid Application Development) used as System development method with UML (Unified Modeling Language) as a software development tool to help simplify the steps that must be carried out. PHP as the programming language & MySQL as the database. This research produces an information system that can be used to optimize progress, ticket status and minimize errors in recording issued tickets and facilitate reporting.

articleTitle: Contrast Parameter Estimation Based on Polynomial Regression for Amniotic Fluid Chromosome Image
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The problems of enhancement chromosome images for Amniotic Fluid are the low quality of the chromosomal image, such as the lack of contrast intensity and brightness of the different chromosomes. As a result, the chromosome images aren't used as the fixed value for enhancement chromosome images. Therefore, the chromosome image enhancement must follow the intensity and brightness of the chromosome image that are of different values. This research presents the Amniotic Fluid chromosome image enhancement based on the polynomial regression method that varies the enhancement value to follow the intensity and brightness of the chromosome image. The proposed method is developed based on polynomial and gamma correction regression analysis. The amniotic sac chromosome slide images were enhanced and compared in the experiment by DNCC, ACCIE, and ACIE methods. The ACIE method has the highest separation efficiency among the three methods because the method uses Gamma as a chromosome image enhancer instead of Histogram Equalization. If histogram equalization is used to enhance the image when the Otsu's Threshold process is performed, there will be a negative signal around the edge of the chromosome and the image will blend against the black background. This can cause errors in the process of chromosome separation. In addition, the estimation process was used to help find the appropriate Gamma value for each image. Since Gamma is constant when applying optimization, optimizing chromosome image sets with different brightness intensities will be erroneous. Therefore, this can lead to the ACIE's better performance than the other methods. As a result, the segmentation accuracy of the Amniotic Fluid chromosome image enhancement method is 94.23%.

articleTitle: Intelligence-based Serious Game for Environmental Awareness: System Model and Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The indiscriminate use of natural resources leads to the deterioration of the environment and the depletion of basic human necessities. This alarming concern entails improving environmental behavior to attain sustainability. By taking advantage of the recent technological advancement, this paper proposes the integration of serious games in developing a system model that enables environmental awareness by leveraging artificial intelligence and analytics. Initially, the serious game is evaluated in terms of usability and playability aspects. Results show that ease of use, learning opportunity, and immersion are significant for the end-users of the serious game, while feedback is considered the least significant among all constructs in the survey. In terms of the playability evaluation, effectiveness and immersion obtained higher ratings from computing and environmental science professionals. On the other side, this paper describes the core components of the proposed system model that may pave the way to improve the use of serious games for environmental awareness, through intelligence, and analytics. Further, this paper also presents the implications of the proposed model for education and practice.

articleTitle: User Experience Analysis of Customs for Land and Building Rights System
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The Customs and Excise information system for Land and Building Rights (BPHTB) which is managed by the Regional Tax and Retribution Management Agency (BPPRD) of South Lampung Regency is considered to still have shortcomings in terms of user experience design. The purpose of this study was to explore the user experience of the BPHTB application in terms of usability, ease of use, ease of learning, and user satisfaction through three stages. The first stage is interviewing users of the BPHTB application. The second stage used the Usability, Satisfaction, and Ease of Use Questionnaire (USE Questionnaire) with BPPRD employees as respondents. The third stage of analysis was carried out using the usability testing method with respondents from BPPRD employees who had never used the BPHTB application. From the results of the three analyzes, it can be concluded that the system has shortcomings in the comfort aspect. After the results of the user experience analysis are obtained, recommendations for information system improvements are given in the form of interface design. Recommendations for improving the user interface design are expected to provide more benefits for users in conducting BPHTB transactions in South Lampung.

articleTitle: Lookup Table Technique by using Irradiation Intensity and Duty Cycle for Faster MPPT Application
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This research shows how Lookup Table technique can track MPP. This method uses calculation to find the exact value of duty cycle that make PV panel reach MPP. Therefore, its speed is faster than classical techniques especially P&O because knowing the exact value of duty cycle can make the controller control the switching device that makes PV reach MPP directly. Moreover, the swing at MPP is less P&O. However, the Lookup Table technique still be relied P&O to track MPP in the first period for automatically recording data into the Table for the Lookup Table technique. Hence, this method is going to be combined by both of P&O and Lookup Table. It is relied on the condition which technique is going to be operated. Lookup Table technique will be operated instead of P&O when the recorded data are enough and under defined the conditions that will be explain in this paper.

articleTitle: Load Balancing in Multi Depot Pickup and Delivery Problem with Ant Colony Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The delivery services businesses are expanding as the need for these services grows. Consequently, one of the objectives is finding the carriers' shortest routes to increase the profit margins effectively. Additionally, working load balancing among carriers is considered a secondary objective of this problem to maintain employee satisfaction. The problem considers a pickup and delivery problem with multiple starting locations of the carriers due to the characteristics of non-full-time-employed drivers while also considering the limited capacity each carrier can hold. Therefore, this study proposes using Ant Colony Optimization (ACO) to balance the workload of each carrier in the Multi Depot Pickup and Delivery Problem while minimizing the total distance. This study also tested various objective functions with randomly generated 20, 50, and 100 customers to evaluate their performance. The results showed that the functions could reduce the variance of the solution and lower the overall distance. Moreover, the proposed algorithm can be used in practice.

Author Keywords: Multi Depot Pickup and Delivery Problem

articleTitle: Digital Transformation in Higher Education for Developing Countries: Systematic Literature Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This study aims to conduct a systematic analysis of the recent investigations on the process of higher education's digital transformation, particularly in developing nations. Publish or Perish v8 Software was used to conduct a systematic literature review. Initially, there were 40 papers selected, but after several search strategies as follows: Determination of search phrases based on research questions; Finding suitable search terms in titles, abstracts, and keywords; Identification of search term synonyms, other spellings, and antonyms, the number of articles to be examined has been decreased to 30. Through descriptive analysis, we try to respond to these two research questions: 1) the process of digital transformation in developing countries' higher education, and 2) what challenges do these developments present? Based on the analysis, the process of digital transformation lies in 4 processes which are planning, organizing, controlling, and evaluating. The process involved was the internal business process and the educational program. While the challenges come from the lack of expertise, lack of facilities, and uncertain economic condition. Several strategies are needed to support the digital transformation in developing countries' higher education.

articleTitle: P-Median Model for Locating Emergency Flood Shelters
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Nong Khai and Udon Thani provinces since these two provinces are on the south bank opposite Vientiane. However, Floods during the monsoon season caused problems, and the drainage infrastructure project is not complete. Therefore, the authority must prepare a response, mitigation, and recovery plan. So, the key element of this plan is to find suitable locations for emergency flood shelters while reducing transportation costs. In this paper, the scenario-based facility location model was used to locate emergency flood shelters. Historical data for detour routes and population size were also incorporated. Two scenarios were run. The optimization model was tested against data from the years 2017, 2018, and 2019. Numerical results show that Mueang Udon Thani and 3-Nong Han are the key districts for emergency flood shelters.

articleTitle: Understanding of Compendium Student Guidance Using Text Mining
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology (MEXT) published “Compendium Student Guidance - Seito Sidou Teiyou” in 2010. The compendium aims to activate student guidance and counseling in every primary and high school. However, reading and understanding this compendium is difficult for those unfamiliar with school teaching. Additionally, in December 2022, this text was substantially revised to reflect the increasingly complex and changing environment for students. This compendium is a frequent candidate for the teacher employment examination. Only seven months after the publication of the new edition, students will have to take a challenging exam. It takes time for university faculty to read complex documents and understand their moot points, and it is difficult to explain them in a way that is easy for students to understand. Therefore, this article analyzes the document using text-mining techniques with KH Coder software, SQL, and R language. In particular, it will discuss how to facilitate its understanding for university students taking the teacher employment selection examination.

articleTitle: The Use of Ecolearn Website as Learning Resources to Improve Economic Learning Outcomes
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Technology is a factor that influences all sectors, one of which is education. Technology has a direct effect on the progress of education in the world. One of the media used in implementing classroom learning is the use of Google sites packaged in EcoLearn. the population of this study is grade XI of social sciences in Senior High School Laboratorium Universitas Negeri Malang. Sample on this study is 2 classes what treatment with Ecolearn website and the printed book material. In this study, we will look at the effectiveness in applying Ecolearn learning resources compared to other printed teaching materials. The data collection method is to use pre-test and post-test. The results showed that learning outcomes using Ecolearn were higher than using printed teaching materials. The results showed that the average gain score for Ecolearn was 74.3983% and the use of printed books was 42.4850%. The use of printed books does not mean that they are ineffective, but other factors that influence students in learning to use ecolearn technology are greater than learning to use ordinary printed books.

articleTitle: QABot: Questions-and-Answer Application on Slack
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: In recent years, the influence of COVID-19 has led to online classes. If we use the workflow function in Slack for a question, we can collect all the question in a pre-prepared teacher channel. In this paper, QABot, a question-and-answer application that runs in Slack, is introduced. QABot can monitor the lecture channels, which is based up the Slack specification. This allows QABot to keep information such as questions posted by students, answers posted by teachers and TAs, and account information on teachers, TAs, and students. A home screen was introduced, which is different for teachers, and students. In addition, a ranking function and a function for display unanswered questions are added. The performance of the similar question detection system in QABot is evaluated by questions from a programming practice class, and furthermore, the map experiment is conducted to avoid the influence of subjects' knowledge differences. It was found that the similar question detection system enables efficient question-and-answer sessions.

articleTitle: Push-Based Information Distribution System for Efficient Cyber Patrolling
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Social networking services (SNSs) are major communication tools in today's society. The upside of SNSs is that people can communicate easily anytime and anywhere, whereas its downside is many harmful posts offering to illegally buy and sell bankbooks, cellular phones, etc., soliciting child prostitution, and so on. Cyber patrolling is an activity of finding harmful posts and reporting them to SNS providers or police organizations. Our university students have been participating in this activity as civilian volunteers. To make the activity more efficient, we have proposed a push-based information distribution system. This system searches for and retrieves potentially harmful posts from SNSs and then pushes the retrieved posts to volunteer members. Members can only focus on judging whether each post should be reported. The push-based approach is also effective in encouraging members to active participation. In this article, we present the system design and implementation. Three-month demonstration experiment results show the system's effectiveness by an increase in the number of reported posts.

articleTitle: Corpse Whisper: Indonesian Movie and YouTube Comments Interaction Navigating Sarcasm and Critics
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: In this study, there is an exploration of comments on the YouTube platform from a video that is currently viral in Indonesia, which are used by researchers to analyze attitudes and how viewers express their opinions. The YouTube video is one of the works a famous artist in Indonesia who has a lot of sensation. This video is a film titled Corpse Whisper (Bisikan Jenazah in Indonesian) which was uploaded on a YouTube channel called Bersahaja Entertainment with a duration of one hour and 25 minutes. The data then analyzed the types of comments on videos that are dominated by sarcasm comments by Indonesian. This study aims to understand how Indonesian netizens use the YouTube comment feature to express their thoughts and personal opinions on videos, actors, visualizations, and background music that are different from their expectations. Our study also takes a deeper look at how sarcasm comments influence getting more views on Corpse Whisper videos. The results of our research on sarcasm comments on Corpse Whisper videos have succeeded in increasing engagement on the Bersahaja YouTube account

articleTitle: How Does International Corporate Avoid Tax?
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This research aims to examine some of the concepts proposed as problems that describe the phenomenon and how international corporations avoid taxes. Are transfer pricing and thin capitalization schemes becoming choices for international corporations to avoid taxes, and how effective are tax regulations that address tax avoidance practices. This research was conducted on multinational non-financial companies listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange for the 2013–2020 period, totalling 64 companies with a total of 512 observations. The sampling technique used for purposive sampling. The analytical method used to test the hypothesis is multiple regression using the Eviews version 12 program with panel data estimation. The study findings show that transfer pricing and thin capitalization schemes are the options for international corporations to avoid taxes. As a result of the differences in tax rates between countries, international companies tend to divert profits to countries with relatively low tax rates or countries with tax haven jurisdictions. This study implies that differences in tax policies and regulations between countries increase the aggressiveness of tax avoidance.

articleTitle: Instagram and The House of Representative of Indonesia Republic
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This research came up with two studies where we analyze the difference in usage of Instagram between male and female members of the Republic of Indonesia House Representatives, then we describe the kind of image that the members mostly build to share with people on Instagram. The present study aims to describe the use of Instagram platform among the Republic of Indonesia House Representatives (DPR) members. We conducted content analysis on 132 out of 566 members of the Republic of Indonesia House Representatives posts between 01 January 2022 - 29 October 2022 on their own Instagram accounts. The result showed bothmale and female members of the Republic Indonesia House Representatives use Instagram as reporting media for professional purposes, although most members also share about their personal life. Generally, the Republic of Indonesia House Representative members are more likely show themselves as responsible figures of their duty. This study can contribute to the new media study. Not only for personal use, the findings show that social media nowadays also can beuseful for professional purposes. However, the use of social media as medium for disseminating professional information is dependent on interests, relevance, or wishes of each individual.

articleTitle: Server Type Comparison of A-txt System -Intranet with and without Internet-
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The Active Textbook System (A-txt) and Contents Maker (C-mkr) are applications that can be used by both teachers and students to improve the quality of education because anyone can easily add digital information to existing paper-based teaching materials using a general-purpose terminal and Augmented Reality (AR) technology. These applications need wireless network (Wi-fi) environment, but the Wi-fi doesn't need to connect to the Internet. This time, we have considered how to use those applications in the intranet environment and the Internet environment, and also improved the applications itself.

articleTitle: GIS-based Analysis of Solar Power Plant Suitability in Thailand: Minimizing Natural Disaster Risks
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Thailand, a member of the UN Framework on Climate Change, aims to be carbon-neutral by 2050 and have zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2065. To reach this goal, Thailand is promoting renewable energy, particularly solar power plants. The location for installing solar power plants is need considered due to avoid natural disasters and flooding. The study attempted to evaluate the suitability of various regions in Thailand for developing solar power plants. To minimize the risk of natural disasters such as floods and landslides, the analysis considered these variables by processing actual flood data, landslide susceptibility data, and land use/land cover images through ArcGIS Pro. There were 3 cases for determining the level of disasters. The results showed that if the rainfall is less than 1829 mm, there is a suitable area of 182,169.33 km<sup>2</sup>, representing 35.35% of the entire country's area. When all cases are considered, the Northeastern region has the biggest remaining area, while the Northern region has the least. In every region of Thailand, there is still a huge potential for establishing solar power plants. For solar power generation of 7,500 kWp, the installation area was used around 60 Km<sup>2</sup>, less than 1% of the remaining area for all cases. Utilizing clean energy, free energy source and reducing greenhouse gas emissions are all additional advantages of the solar power plant.

articleTitle: Comparison Among Machine Learning Algorithms for Predicting Shunt-Dependent Hydrocephalus
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Hydrocephalus is one of the leading causes of mortality and morbidity in neurosurgery. Extraventricular drain placement is a common first-line treatment for acute HCP patients. Approximately 6.5-25% of HCP is needed for the subsequential ventriculoperitoneal shunt. The primary objective of the present study was to compare classification performances among various supervised ML algorithms. Moreover, the secondary objective was to investigate factors associated with shunt-dependent HCP. The retrospective cohort study was conducted on 412 patients with hydrocephalus who underwent extraventricular drain placement. Clinical features and ventricular indexes were collected. Supervised ML algorithms were trained and tested for classification between the subsequential ventriculoperitoneal shunt group and the successful extraventricular drain removal group. As a result, the logistic regression algorithm had excellent performance, with an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.92. In summary, these ML algorithms are useful to predict shunt-dependent HCP and may be implemented in clinical settings as preliminary screening instruments to decrease unnecessary procedures.

articleTitle: Deployment of Preprint Servers and Online Journals as Campus Research Management System Using Open-Source Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Universities and Colleges’ worldwide functions are instruction, community extension, production, and research. One vital function is research, which is why a research management system is essential to a university. Continuing advancement in research standards and quality mechanisms with the aim of technology can be utilized. Preprints are initial versions of scientific papers that researchers share by posting to servers called preprints before peer review and publication in an academic journal, and this allows the readers and internal researchers to access early results. Preprint servers are freely accessible online archives that host preprints and their associated data. Post-prints are finished publication after the peer review. This study aims to design a research management system and process using Open-Source applications for Pangasinan State University, Lingayen Campus, by creating a process and adopting an open-source application system for preprint, post-print publication, and data repository which serves as the platform for research publication for students and faculty staff of the university. A result of usability is also presented as a basis for the proposed improvement of the process and system. The study shows that the utilized open-source application is usable, which helps the campus attain its goal of integrating the sustainable research management process.

articleTitle: User Experience Analysis On Fund Investment Application Using Heuristic Evaluation Method
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Bibit is one of the most widely used mutual fund investment applications in Indonesia. Many similar applications are available on the market encourages Bibit to keep developing its application to continue to meet user needs in investing in mutual funds. The purpose of this study is to design a new user interface and analyze user experience based on questionnaire distributed to Bibit user. Questionnaire based on 10 Heuristic Evaluation variables, namely Visibility of System Status, Match and between system and the real world, User Control and Freedom, Consistency and Standards, Error prevention, Recognition Rather Than Recall, Flexibility and Efficiency of Use, Aesthetic and Minimalist Design, Help Users Recognize, Diagnose and Recovers from Errors, and Help and Documentation. Then we designed a new user interface recommendation by applying the Heuristic Evaluation method and SEM PLS testing on Smart-PLS tools based on the results of questionnaire data distributed to users of the Bibit application. R Square shows the results of 0.797 (79.7<sup>%</sup>) for Flexibility and Efficiency of Use variable, meaning that it is significantly influenced by Recognition rather than recall and User control and freedom. Furthermore, F Square shows that the Error Prevention variable on Recognition rather than recall gets the smallest value compared to other variables, which is 0.256 (25.6<sup>%</sup>). It means that it is significantly influenced by Recognition rather than recall and User control and freedom. Proposed improvements to the new user interface design, namely the “Home”,”Switch Portfolio”, and “Nabung Rutin” pages.

articleTitle: The Effectiveness of “Mandarinstories” Mobile LMS in Supporting Online-Merge-Offline (OMO) Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Online-Merge-Offline (OMO) learning as a hybrid learning model can be the answer to post-pandemic learning. Sharing between online and offline learning requires a media platform that bridges between students and learning content. The research objectives in this study are: (1) designing “Mandarinstories”, a mobile learning management system (LMS) that can meet the needs according to a needs survey, (2) testing the effectiveness of the mobile LMS developed through classroom experiments, (3) comparing learning outcomes in the group that only uses the mobile LMS and the group that uses the LMS developed by the university. This mobile LMS was developed using the Waterfall Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) method. Through testing the results of pre-test and post-test in an experimental group, it is known that using “Mandarinstories” mobile LMS in learning Mandarin can improve learning performance, which is indicated by increased learning outcomes. The results also show that there is an increase in learning outcomes in the experimental group using this mobile LMS.

articleTitle: The Implementation of Genetic Algorithm to Solve Final Project Defense Scheduling Problem
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Scheduling of final project session is one of the problems that need to be handled in the Information Systems study program at Universitas Multimedia Nusantara (UMN). The problem arises because there are some differences in the available schedules of the prospective examiners. Besides that, another factor that is taken into consideration when the study program determines prospective examiners is the expertise of the examiners. Therefore, the topic of this research was raised to be able to solve the problem. The system development method used in this study is prototyping. The algorithm that will be used to create the scheduling system is a genetic algorithm to determine the final schedule for students' final project defense based on the availability and expertise of the examiners. The proposed system will handle two main processes, namely determining the appropriate examiner for each student based on the student's final project topic and determining a final defense schedule. The proposed system will be built on a web-based platform and have 3 access levels such as the head of the study program, lecturers, and students. The proposed system will provide the best recommendation scheduling results from all the possibilities. The recommended schedule will be used as the final schedule of the student's final project defense.

articleTitle: User Interface Design to Improve User Experience for the Super Hana Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Technology development is very rapid in today's modern era. Almost every company uses technology to support business processes, including companies providing access network installation services. One of the companies in the area of access network installation services is PT Telkom Akses. Super Hana is a mandatory application owned by PT Telkom Akses employees. However, from several reviews or user experiences that are discussed every day, there are still several things that still need to be improved in the application. These deficiencies include the need for more location features when employees take attendance, a dashboard of how many employee absences, and no reminders if employees have not taken attendance. Therefore, to analyze the user experience value of the Super Hana application and improve its user interface, user experience testing using the User Experience Questionaire (UEQ) method and in-depth interviews were carried out. User Experience and User Experience Questionaire (UEQ) measurements are based on attractiveness, perspicuity, efficiency, dependability, stimulation, and novelty. In addition, the assessment was also carried out on employees using in-depth interviews to find out directly the obstacles experienced by employees when using the Super Hana application. Based on the results of our questionnaires and interviews, the Super Hana application has met the level of satisfaction with the user interface and menu features in the application. However, some features still need to be added and improved to support users in monitoring employee attendance and creating a better user interface in terms of the experience of using the Super Hana application.

articleTitle: Financial Performance of Aviation Firms
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Financial performance measurement has a vital importance for companies since it demonstrates the companies' success in achieving their targeted goals. In this study, financial performance analysis was performed using the data of four large airlines with large market shares operating in the United States. In the study, multi-criteria decision-making methods were used. Multi-criteria decision-making methods are generally applied in two steps, the first is to determine the criteria weights, and the second is to determine the company's performance. The CRITIC method was used to determine the weights and the SAW method was used to evaluate the alternatives. According to the results of the CRITIC, the criterion with the highest weight is determined as revenue per seat mile. According to the SAW results, Southwest Airlines is the best performer. When the analysis results and financial data of the companies were examined, it was concluded that Southwest's business model, market and healthy load factors enable the airlines to be successful.

articleTitle: Users' Acceptance and Use of Video on Demand (VoD) and Its Effect on Chinese Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: VoD (Video on Demand) is growing rapidly in the Indonesian film industry and is having a big impact, especially during this pandemic. This study aims to determine what factors influence students’ motivation to use VoD services from China. This type of research is correlational research with qualitative methods. The data collection method used was a questionnaire presented in the form of a Likert scale, distributed to 26 students majoring in Chinese Literature. These respondents are users who like to watch Chinese-language content (drama/movies/variety shows) and have used Video on Demand services from China, such as iQIYI, WeTV, and Youku. The results of calculations with the Likert Scale obtained the percentage score in the “Strongly Agree” category for Performance Expectancy, Effort Expectancy, Facilitating Conditions, Hedonic Motivations, Price Value, and Habit factors. And the “Agree” category for the Social Influence factor. The Performance Expectancy, Hedonic Motivations, and Habit factors are directly related to the improvement of the respondents’ language skills. This shows that VoD can improve language skills and learning motivation. So that VoD with Chinese content can be used as a recommendation for learning languages.

articleTitle: Using Padlet as a Vocabulary Learning Platform on Chinese Lessons
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Padlet is an interactive media platform that allows collaboration between teachers and students. In learning Mandarin, especially grammar, the use of the Padlet media platform can have a positive impact on the progress of students' language skills. This research uses a qualitative method to explain the difference between mastery of grammar and new words to compose sentences before using Padlet and after using Padlet. The object of the research is 20 students, who consist of those who didn't use padlet and who have studied two-month Mandarin Grammar using Padlet 5 times. The test material is according to the topic that students have learned, and it's 40% to 60% of the learning material. The type of exam is divided into two kinds: completing the conversation and making sentences. Based on the results of student exams, The percentage change in the increase in student errors in students using padlet shows a significant difference. In the questions completing the conversation, the correct answers to questions increased by −10 to +45%. In contrast, in the questions making sentences, there is a decrease in the accuracy of student answers from −5 % to −15%. It was found that students using Padlet directly impact the memory of the new word but need to increase the ability to master Mandarin grammar, at first for the grammar usage section.

articleTitle: COBIT 5 Capability Level of Information Technology Governance at PT ABC
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: In Indonesia, PT ABC is an ICT business that specializes in network services, IT management, and system integrators. The company's IT governance mechanisms are still not working to their full potential. This is demonstrated by the inability of PT ABC to achieve its business objectives due to poor management of its IT resources, difficulties in addressing issues, and a failure to comply with external obligations. Utilizing the COBIT 5 framework and an IS audit phase, the capability level measurement and gap analysis for IT governance at PT ABC were conducted to address all of these issues. Purposive sampling and a qualitative research methodology were both used in this study. Interviews and observations served as the major and secondary data sources. As a result, capability level measurement and gap analysis at PT ABC stop at level 1 for the EDM04 process and have a gap value of 1, whereas they stop at level 3 for the DSS03 and MEA03 processes and have no gap value. Therefore, in order for the IT application to be more optimal and to prevent or reduce the recurrence of the same issues in the future, PT ABC needs to implement and follow up on the advice made.

articleTitle: PT Bottle Classification Function for Pfand Equipment
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Approximately 8.3 billion tons of waste plastics are produced on Earth, and waste plastics that are not properly processed and recycled threaten our ecosystem on land and at sea. Since 2003, Germany has been using the Pfand system, which refunds deposits when containers are returned to reduce plastic waste. As a result, the plastic recycling rate is 97.4%, shows a high recycling rate. The system proposed in this paper simplifies the existing upcycling method and minimizes the cost incurred in the circulation structure by adding a function to separate renewable materials from materials requiring additional work to the existing Pfand system. It is a system that recognizes the QR or barcode of the product, classifies the product, and compresses and shreds the classified plastic. The proposed equipment classifies products by QR or barcode, but in the future, it plans to apply AI to classify products. In addition, handrails and stairs will be installed on the product so that elderly and disabled people in wheelchairs can use it comfortably.

articleTitle: Development of Cyber Ranges for Operational Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Cyber attacks targeting factories and industrial infrastructure based on OT(Operational technology) have been increasing, and countermeasures are urgently needed. However, the suspension of infrastructure has a significant impact on social activities. In addition, there is a need for more security engineers who can protect industrial infrastructure from attacks, and there is a need for an environment where security education can be provided to train Industrial Control System (ICS) security engineers. Therefore, the purpose of this research is to develop teaching materials for ICS security. This paper introduces on training materials and scenarios in actual and virtual cyber ranges.

articleTitle: Boosting the Effect of Digital Mastery on Sustainability Management by Applying Prosocial Leadership
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Continuous and disruptive changes require SMEs owners and/or managers to consider long-term business sustainability. This article is interested in elaborating on the sustainability management of SMEs from the perspective of socio-technical theory. A conceptual framework composed of seven hypotheses is developed for examining statistically the effect of digital mastery as a technical aspect and prosocial leadership as a social aspect of sustainability management. An empirical study developed to support this article has invited 297 owners and/or managers of SMEs to participate as respondents. They were members of the Jakpreneur Association, a community of entrepreneurs in Jakarta, Indonesia. Sampling was carried out by a non-probabilistic method with a purposeful approach. The obtained data was structured using partial least squares SEM and computed using the Smart PLS application in version 4.0. The analysis results reveal that digital mastery, as a technical aspect, does affect sustainability management. However, prosocial leadership as a social aspect is effective in boosting the effect of digital mastery on sustainability management. The results confirm socio-technical theory in the context of digital transformation in SMEs.

articleTitle: Analysis of Factors Affecting Students Intention to Use Virtual Reality in Education
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to examine the factors influencing the intention to use virtual reality in education from students' perspectives. This study uses Technology-Acceptance Model (TAM) as its primary theoretical foundation, with perceived facilitating condition and perceived risk as its external variables. A total of 200 responses were gathered and analyzed using Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) in SMARTPLS 4.0. The study found that perceived usefulness, attitude toward using, and perceived facilitating condition are the three factors that mainly influence students' intention to use virtual reality. Perceived risk was found to have no significant impact on intention to use. Perceived usefulness and perceived ease of use significantly impacts attitude toward using. Additionally, perceived ease of use was found to positively impact perceived usefulness. Regardless of its limitations, this study adds to the body of knowledge on virtual reality and technology acceptance by suggesting an extended TAM model and provides managerial contributions through valuable insights for virtual reality implementation in Indonesia.

articleTitle: A study on Optimization of Combined load between Cartridge and Holder using a GBO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Recently, oriental medicine has been increased when the aging population is intensifying and medical expenses for the elderly are increasing. In the oriental medical device market, fine parts are mainly manufactured manually, and this technique is known as a technique that requires very high precision. In order to foster the oriental medicine industry, it is essential to develop complex mold technology for the mass production of oriental medical devices. Cartridges, cartridge holders, etc., which are parts of an automatic magnetic needle, are mass-produced through molds. However, there are cases in which the automatic magnetic needle does not work well during extraction because the cartridge and holder are not properly combined in the molding process. Therefore, the importance of cartridge and cartridge holder manufacturing technology affecting the specification of the automatic magnetic needle and related research is urgently required. Therefore, the purpose of this study is to perform FEM analysis based on the mold process variable conditions and predict the mold process by checking the total deformation, equivalent stress, and safety factor. In addition, the GBO algorithm, an optimization technique, was developed based on the result values derived from structural analysis, objective function and limit function were derived, and the optimal coupling load was selected.

articleTitle: Adoption of Financial Literacy in Entrepreneurial Intention: The Case of Generations Y and Z in Thailand
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: In Thailand, unemployment in generations Y and Z continue to be a scourge that is very challenging to overcome. Generations Y and Z desire to become more entrepreneurial, not be tied down to a permanent job, and pursue their own ambitions. Entrepreneurship now plays a significant role in economic growth and the development of new jobs. As a result of the current issues and phenomena, governments, institutions, and scholars are becoming more and more interested in helping young people start their own businesses. Generations Y and Z struggle to start their own businesses because of an absence of knowledge and business expertise, causing business failures. Many existing research studies focus on experienced entrepreneurs, but these are not appropriate in the context of generations Y and Z. Therefore, the objectives of this paper are to 1) determine the adoption of current financial literacy to influence entrepreneurial intention in generations Y and Z and 2) discover the need for financial literacy that supports generations Y and Z in becoming start-up entrepreneurs. The qualitative method is used in this study to perform in-depth interviews with fifteen individuals of generations Y and Z, diversified by demographics: age, business experiences, and type of business. The researchers have chosen a thematic analysis approach to analyze the interview transcripts. The results of this study indicate some interesting discoveries, as evidenced by the current financial literacy of generations Y and Z. The evidence also demonstrates that generations Y and Z need a substantial amount of financial literacy to become start-up entrepreneurs.

articleTitle: Addressing Data Scarcity in Thai Car Recognition Using Few-Shot Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This paper aims to address the issues of data scarcity and fine-grained classification in car recognition, specifically in the Thai context, using a few-shot learning model. To achieve this, we conduct experiments to compare several models and establish DN4 as a baseline model. We collect and analyze performance data from various training variables (N-way K-shot) and backbone architectures. Furthermore, we propose the hard task sampler module for few-shot training, which generates more difficult tasks based on the similarity matrix derived from the model's discriminative performance. We test our proposed model on the Comprehensive Cars (CompCars) dataset, which is split into CompCars (non-TH) and CompCars (TH) based on car model popularity in Thailand. By using the best settings from our experiments, our model significantly improves the accuracy of the DN4 baseline. Notably, the accuracy is increased from 85.7% to 92.70% on the CompCars (non-TH) dataset and from 82.44% to 90.28% on the CompCars (TH) dataset. Overall, our approach shows promising results in addressing the challenges of data scarcity and fine-grained classification in car recognition in the Thai context.

articleTitle: Sining Malaya: Designing a Platform to Support Local Artists in the Philippines
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: With the modern era of technology, where websites are increasing as a source of knowledge as well as an e-commerce tool, the researchers thought of a method to promote and assist local artists with their art passion. The researchers designed and constructed Sining Malaya, a platform for communication and networking among local artists in the Philippines, as well as to strengthen their artist identity and showcase their artworks to the public. This is for local artists to obtain more paid transactions online and paid commissions in exchange for their skills and aptitude. This will also serve as an opportunity to tell the public in the Philippines that an artist's work is not simply a pastime but also a viable means of earning a livelihood. The data gathered during the focus group discussion (FGD), which included seven (7) student artists, was narrowed down, and evaluated using thematic analysis to examine recurrent themes from the respondents' comments. This acted as a guide for the researchers in creating and developing Sining Malaya as a case study in terms of what user interface and features would make the website design easier and more useful for local artists to utilize.

articleTitle: The Future of Video on Demand (VoD) Services in Indonesia: An Empirical Study
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Video on Demand (VoD) services are growing significantly every year and have become a lifestyle for most individuals. This increase has brought competition among service providers (VoD). To survive the competition, service providers need to understand what drives users to subscribe to VoD. This study uses the concept of social identity theory to explain future usage behavior in VoD services with a focus on the dimensions of social value, emotional value, and identity salience. A total of 479 respondents who subscribed to VoD for at least one year were involved in the research. The survey data were then processed using covariate-based multivariate structural equation model statistics (CB-SEM). The hypothesis testing results prove that social and emotional values positively and significantly affect identity salience and future intention to use VoD services. Furthermore, identity salience has a positive and significant effect on future intention. The results of this study contribute to IT policy in implementing VoD service technology that suits user needs.

articleTitle: Factors Affecting Frugal Shopping Behavior of Online Fashion Consumption of Gen Z
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This research was aimed to study factors impacting frugal shopping behavior of online fashion consumption of Gen <tex>$\mathbf{Z}$</tex> in Thailand. This research paper focused on the students in Gen <tex>$\mathbf{Z}$</tex> in a private university which was located in Pathum Thani province, Thailand. The 313 valid survey questionnaires were utilized for data analysis. The females at the age of 20 years old were the main respondents. They normally used their monthly expenditures around 10,001 to 20,000 baht. Most of them preferred to buy items such as shoes online, dress, pants, and shirts. Additionally, they would purchase more than 601 baht or above per one purchase. Most of the respondents' favorite social networking sites were Facebook,. Multiple regression analysis was implemented. It was founded that economical orientations, self-expression, and time risk had positive effect towards frugal shopping behavior of online clothing consumption of Gen <tex>$\mathbf{Z}$</tex> in Thailand. The results of this research extended frugal shopping behavior theory with economical orientations, self-expression, and time risk theories of Gen <tex>$\mathbf{Z}$</tex> consumers in Thailand.

articleTitle: Feasibility Analysis of Investment Systems and Information Technology using New Information Economics method at KPN Plantation
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Changes in the company business environment alter the way management to makes decisions in assisting the formation of a corporate organization or made recovery from a crisis because of such global rapid changes. KPN Plantation, a plantation company, currently is facing issue since it is unknown whether there IS and IT are in line with the IT strategic alignment. Therefore, necessary to assess the feasibility of investing IS and IT KPN at this time, has it really contributed significant impact to the company. In this research, to analyzing this problem Value Shop, PESTLE, SWOT, EFAS, IFAS, IE matrix method is used, beside that New Information Economics method used as main analysis tool. NIE is a collection of principles-based practices and integrated activities that are effective in linking business and IT management processes. This method enables KPN to assess their performance of its IT Resources. From this assessment can help management on decisions-making process related to reallocation or abandonment IS and IT more effectively. Utilizing three NIE analytical practices especially Demand Supply Planning, Innovation, and Alignment on KPN application portfolio Lights-On, it is known which system is more important and appropriately supports along provides maximum benefits for IS and IT company investment to achieve and maintain the company's strategic direction and allocate investment funds held into sectors that require more improvement. The research's conclusion is that KPN Plantation's investment requires the development and improvement of the application sector, especially in several applications that indicated to have low level of dependency and alignment.

articleTitle: Does the Market React to Intellectual Capital, Capital Structure, Geopolitical Risk, and Cryptocurrency Impact?
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The banking sector is a sector that is sensitive to information that occurs in a country or the world. However, banking shares are a long-term investment choice because it is believed that institutions and the state have an important function for the whole community, and of course, the government is the supervisor to keep a bank from experiencing operational failure. By using advanced technology, it is a signal that banking improves intellectual capital factor with strong skills and infrastructure to face the digitalization era. However, in the era of banking digitalization, conditions of future uncertainty and the emergence of digital currencies existence can survive the development of the capital market. This study aims to analyze how far the influence of internal aspects such as intellectual capital and capital structure and external such as geopolitical events and digital currency has on banking stock returns in 2016–2020. The results of this study are that capital structure and cryptocurrencies affect stock returns. This shows that investors consider healthy bank conditions and good capital management and also investors tend to diversify their portfolios by including bitcoin in promising investments even though the risks are considered high.

articleTitle: Implementation and Familiarity Covid-19 Contact Tracing Application in Japan And Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: In December 2019, a local outbreak of pneumonia of initially unknown cause was detected in Wuhan City, China. It was quickly determined to be caused by a novel coronavirus, namely severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2). The outbreak has since spread worldwide, with over 582 million cases as of August 2022. To reduce this, in addition to establishing health protocols and getting vaccines, governments worldwide have developed digital contact tracing applications for smartphones. This study will focus on the differences in implementation and familiarity of the COVID-19 tracing application in Indonesia and Japan. This research aims to use tracing applications in Indonesia and Japan, namely PeduliLindungi and the COVID-19 Contact Tracing Application (COCOA). The objectives of this research are: 1) to study how the involvement of the PeduliLindungi and COCOA coronavirus tracking applications currently helps the community in the health sector, and 2) to find solutions to the problems they are experiencing and provide advice on PeduliLindungi and COCOA. The data collection method we used is questionnaires to students in universities in Japan dan Indonesia. We also did a literature review of some books and journals. The results of this study indicate that there are various advantages and disadvantages in tracing applications such as PeduliLindungi from Indonesia and COCOA from Japan among students. However, compared to the benefits, these two applications still have more disadvantages in using them. To help overcome these shortcomings, this study will provide some suggestions on how the application can help users during this pandemic.

articleTitle: Exploring Consumer Experience and Continuance Intentions Towards Food Delivery Applications in Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The Indonesian government's implementation of mobility restrictions due to the Covid-19 pandemic has led to an increase in the usage of food delivery applications (FDAs) as a means of fulfilling the citizens' food needs. This study examines consumer experiences and the continuance intentions of using FDAs, focusing on factors that contribute to their continued use based on the Technology Acceptance Model, such as ease of use, usefulness, and actual use. A qualitative research approach was employed through semi-structured interviews. The results show that ease of use, including the simplicity of installing the app and conducting transactions, as well as perceived benefits, such as the fulfillment of food needs and reducing exposure to Covid-19, play a crucial role in maintaining continuous FDA usage. The drivers' attitudes, communication skills, and credibility also influence consumer decisions to continue using FDAs. Promotions and discounts emerged as significant factors in increasing the frequency of FDA usage.

articleTitle: YouTube Search Engine: Most Popular Content between Myth and Horror in Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: YouTube is a video-audio based social platform that offers a variety of content. In Indonesia, entertainment content is one of the things that are in high demand. Popular entertainment content is horror and myth. This is related to the beliefs of the Indonesian people regarding myths. This article aims to analyze horror and myth content that ranks at the top of the YouTube search engine based on creators and content types. Online data retrieval in the form of YouTube content using keywords horror and myth taken from search engines. Search engine is a feature to search content based on certain keywords. This research found that the top-ranking content in the YouTube search engine is dominated by creators with verified accounts and most types of content such as storytelling and listicles.
