The results of this study provide recommendations for creators and the media industry in the field of horror and myth content production in making content optimally.

articleTitle: Strategies for Digital Innovation in Talent Management of Automotive Industry 4.0
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: As the automobile sector is experiencing a profound digital transformation, it may have a deep consequence on the way the industry restructures itself with regards to talent, technology and organizational climate. The development of emerging markets, the quickening adoption of new technology, environmental policies, and shifting consumer ownership preferences are all factors that are causing significant change in today's economic systems. Automobiles will experience a similar revolution to other industries that have already been impacted by digital transformation, increased automation, and innovative business models. The present study looks at the challenges of the automotive sector in India due to the changing landscape of the automotive sector, the transformation driven by digital innovation and the need for an agile workforce. 50 managers were selected and segregated into 5 groups for focused group discussions to collect the primary data for this research. Additionally, the study also proposes a ‘TEAMS’ model for digitized talent management that can bridge the widening technology-talent gap in the automobile industry 5.0.

articleTitle: ModVI: Design Modification of a Passive Vibration Isolator for Surveying Stability of an Underground Imaging Towed Trailer System
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The fundamental concept of towed underground imaging is the determination of the electrical resistivity of the ground to assess the composition and utilities present underneath. However, the challenge of using this technology is the establishment of the system's isolation from vibrations caused by antenna oscillation on uneven terrain. With that, this study modified a novel design of a passive-type isolator from a previous study and named it as the ModVI. This aims to attain a quasi-zero stiffness condition to shield the system from extremely low-frequency vibrations affecting data gathering. It is necessary that the passive or structural design of the employed vibration isolator be tailored for its identified function. Motion analysis simulation was used to prove the modification of the design in terms of its stability mechanism and isolation. An arch shape linkage and variation in spring position were employed as performed modifications and were compared with the straight linkage design of the reference. Based on the results, the arch-shaped link has the best performance in terms of stress, displacement, and factor of safety. Thus, the maximum top displacement of ModVI is 0.142 mm only compared to 0.27 mm of the reference design conveying more effective and efficient vibration isolation.

articleTitle: The Role of Social Media Influencer towards Fashion Brand Sales for Indonesia's Young Consumers
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: With the current ongoing pandemic in Indonesia where everything is forced to be online, consumers have started to forget brand names as there are no physical interaction. Social media becomes the main communication tool for Millennials to seek for social interactions that have been missing. This results in the boom of social media influencers (SMI) to represent brands when communicating to consumers, but how it would directly link to local brand sales is still ambiguous in the midst of fashion consumption disruption. The research looks into how Indonesian fashion brand could benefit from the rising SMIs with their contents towards leveraging leads. An exploratory descriptive research was done with multi method approach and non-probability sampling techniques combining online survey on 80 consumers, archival research on influencer, and interview on influencers. Today, SMIs are influential for local businesses to reach a wider market as the intermediary between brands and consumers. SMI indeed helps brands in achieving success but not a hundred percent it will improve brand sales instantly rather it is more about driving awareness. They induce awareness for brands that would eventually help in the creation of brand image and familiarity that lead to purchase intention and customer loyalty.

articleTitle: Forecasting of Outpatient Hospital Visits using A Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory Model
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Recently, accurate predicting outpatient visits is crucial in healthcare for optimizing service delivery and resource allocation. Time series models, particularly Deep Learning (DL) methods, have gained popularity in predicting demand and can potentially be used to predict demand for medical services, including outpatient hospital visits. This study aims to assess the potential of Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (Bi-LSTM) model in accurately predicting outpatient visits. The proposed model was tested with different set of parameters. Two important parameters adjusted in this study which are batch size and number of hidden nodes. The study also compares the performance of Bi-LSTM with other LSTM architectures, such as Vanilla LSTM and Stack LSTM. The results obtained show that Bi-LSTM performs best with batch size 64 and 10 hidden neurons. Besides, the results yielded indicate that the Bi-LSTM model performs exceptionally well with higher accuracy compared to other LSTM architectures. Overall, this study offers valuable insights into the use of Bi-LSTM models for predicting the number of outpatient visits.

articleTitle: Social Media Engagement as Mediator: Does Content Vividness Predict Purchase Intention?
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This study examines Instagram influencers' social media behavior and providing suggestions for increasing engagement and purchase intentions towards endorsed products via post-effectiveness. Several objectives will be raised in this study: (1) determining the effect of content vividness on social media engagement, (2) determining the impact of social media engagement on purchase intentions, (3) determining the effect of content vividness on purchase intentions. This quantitative study utilizes Partial Least Square (PLS) software as a tool to test validity and reliability and SPSS to test the hypothesis and regression model. With the total of 199 valid respondents participating into this study's survey, the result highlights the positive effects of content vividness in enhancing purchase intentions through mediating variable, namely social media engagement.

articleTitle: Print Magazine's Attributes and Relevancy in the Lens of Filipino K-pop fans in Metro Manila
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Numerous studies have been carried out to determine how K-pop fans decide to purchase products associated with their idol. However, as has been noted, the rise in sales and demand for print magazines with K-pop idols on the cover has yet to be explained. This study employed a mixed-methods approach to analyze and comprehend what characteristics K-pop fans look for in print magazines and how the Korean wave and their fandom influence their decision to purchase a K-pop magazine or not. The study used 385 K-pop fans as respondents using a purposive sampling technique because the researchers believed that these groups have their own unique decisions and experiences that will influence how they will purchase a specific product. The preferences of Filipino K-pop fans in Metro Manila on the attributes of the print magazine, their behavior as consumers, and its relevance in this digital age are the focus of this research study.

articleTitle: Factors Affecting The Intention to Sustainable Use of E-Wallet: Empirical Study of Outbreak Covid-19
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The purpose of the research is to find out what factors could influence the intention during the COVID-19 pandemic at DKI Jakarta, to use an E-wallet. using the Associative Approach Research Method and using data collection techniques with questionnaires to 100 respondents and using SEM data analysis techniques Smart PLS. The results achieved that there is no effect between Confirmation on Satisfaction. Confirmation influences the perceived usefulness of E-wallet. Perceived Usefulness in the use of Ewallet has an effect on Satisfaction, there is no effect between Perceived Usefulness of E-wallet and Continuous Intention of using E-wallet continuously, there is no influence between Perceived usefulness and Attitude, there is an influence between Perceived Ease of Use and Attitude, Perceived Ease of Use has an effect on Perceived Usefulness, Satisfaction has an effect on Continuous Intention, there is an influence between Satisfaction on Attitude, and there is no influence between Attitude and Continuous Intention.

articleTitle: Learning Extended Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency (TF-IDF++) for Depression Screening From Sentences in Thai Blog Post
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This paper proposed the method of depression screening from a sentence in Thai blog posts. Three classifiers based on a decision tree, linear SVC, and logistic regression were used to create classification models; each learned from extended term frequency-inverse document frequency (TF-IDF++) which is a feature vector created from a term frequency-inverse document frequency (TF-IDF), part-of-speech, and statistics of sentences such as word counts of selected terms. Our experiments showed that the model based on logistic regression achieves the top average score with a precision of 78.32%, a recall of 78.26%, and an f1-score of 78.27%. The proposed method outperforms the Thai BERT model by 0.75%, 0.77%, and 0.76%, respectively. Our investigation also showed that excessive confidence in the Thai BERT model tends to classify a sample with high probability. This also happens in case of an incorrect prediction; the error in such a case becomes noticeably higher than that of the wrong prediction in our proposed logistic regression-based model.

articleTitle: Tracking Input Devices to Detect Cheating Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The holding of examinations online has risen in recent years, especially with the Covid-19 pandemic. Cheating in online examinations has also become rampant, causing concerns among examiners and institutions. This study explored the usage of machine learning to detect cheating in online exams. The research used input device data collected from participants which were fed into 3 machine learning models: Logistic Regression, SVM, and Random Forest. These were then combined to form an Ensemble model. Two feature sets were also used for the models: the first set consisted of four (4) features used in a previous study, while the second set consisted of seven (7) features. The study found that incorporating more features into the models produced better performance than when the models had only four (4) features. After evaluation, the Logistic Regression with Standardization had the best performance, having a sensitivity of 65% and specificity of 87%. This model was integrated into a quizzing system developed by the researchers. The system records the input device data of examinees while taking an exam, which is then fed into the machine learning model. This allows the system to detect which examinees cheated and the specific questions where they did.

articleTitle: Comparison of Cloud Computing and TinyML Methods for Brain-Computer Interface in Motor Imagery Problems
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: In the modern day, several different innovations have been created with the sole purpose of improving existing models, products, and systems. One such innovation would be the improvement of brain-computer interfaces (BCI). BCIs tend to require high processing capabilities for the accurate gathering, processing, and classification of different biosignals such as the electroencephalography (EEG) signals. As such, cloud computing and TinyML methods are suggested as a means to solve this issue. In this study, the two methods are compared by simulating two cases, one for cloud computing and another for TinyML implementations. The latencies in which these two implementations can provide a classification for a data point is used as the main metric for comparison. It was observed that TinyML implementations had significantly lower latencies at an average of 0.0009 s, while cloud computing implementation had significantly higher latencies at an average of 1.5459 s. This difference can be attributed to the fact that cloud computing systems are reliant on connectivity between the local machine and the cloud computing services while TinyML implementations do not have the same restrictions and are instead capable of providing a classification as soon as it receives a data point.

articleTitle: Online Customer Intention to Purchase Local Brand Shoes: The Role of Website Quality
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Because consumer decisions to purchase a product are based on interest, which arises because of a favorable stimulus that provides motivation to allow consumers to purchase goods or services in the future, purchase intention is a significant factor in the business world. The study's goal was to ascertain how social media marketing, perceived risk, trust, and product design affected consumers' intention to make a purchase of local shoe brands Brodo and Geoff Max Footwear, either directly or through website quality e-commerce as an intervening variable. This study's research methodology takes a quantitative approach. A quantitative method is a research approach that uses quantitative and statistical data analysis to examine populations or samples, collect data using research instruments, and test established hypotheses. While associative research is the type of research data used. The research methodology used in this study relies on primary data, specifically data obtained through questionnaires given to pre-selected samples who will act as research respondents. In this study, probability sampling was used as the sampling method. The results of data analysis in this study concluded that social media marketing, perceived risk, trust, product design and website quality e-commerce had a noticeable favorable impact on consumer purchase intentions of local shoe brands Brodo and Geoff max footwear.

articleTitle: Thermal Imaging Dataset for Human Presence Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: In this paper, a created elevated thermal dataset that is designed for training deep learning models for human presence detection will be presented. The dataset consists of 7,101 elevated thermal images of humans captured in different scenarios while walking, running, and clustering. The recordings are captured using Seek Thermal Compact Pro camera under different environments and light conditions, different body positions, and distances from the camera and were preprocessed for the algorithm. The dataset was evaluated using YOLOv7-Tiny regarding performance in mAP scores and loss charts generated when training and testing the captured images. The robustness of the dataset was tested using cross-validation and reducing the number of datasets. The dataset was also combined with other publicly available datasets to compare the difference between the training of the created dataset alone. Combining the private dataset with other public datasets upon training significantly increased the mAP score in detecting the images belonging to the testing datasets that contained publicly available images.

articleTitle: Evaluation Factors of Continuous Use Intention to Online Subscription Services by Students during the Covid-19 Pandemic
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: During this Covid-19 pandemic, and also supported by technological developments in Indonesia, many companies are starting to adopt online subscription services into their business models. The main users of the digital currency are students who use it for everything from social media subscriptions, food and necessities to utility and medicine bills. Thus it is interesting to use students as research subjects. There are so many diverse online subscription services in Indonesia, including subscriptions to music, entertainment, news, and much more. Because the types of subscriptions in Indonesia are starting to increase and vary, we want to know what factors influence consumers to decide to continue use intention (CUI) subscription services. This study uses PLS-SEM to determine the relationship between the independent variable and the dependent variable. The results of this study indicate that willingness to subscribe for online content (WC) and service value (SV) have a significant effect and have a positive relationship to continuous use intention (CUI).

articleTitle: Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Regression of Coconut Inflorescence Texture Phenotypes Through Spectral Analysis Using Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The coconut inflorescence is one of the sources of various food products coconut palm trees (Cocos nucifera L.) have to offer. In line with the advancement of the production of coconut inflorescence by-products and derivatives, the characterization of their texture features through spectral analysis was given importance. It is vital to determine the texture information of the coconut inflorescence in order to identify its maturity, which is a significant factor in harvesting a larger amount of good-quality sap. Using the MATLAB programming language, this study developed five regression-based adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference systems (ANFIS) models that would predict five coconut inflorescence texture phenotypes through spectral feature analysis. A total of 100 images from the three inflorescence maturity level categories were utilized for image processing. With this, spectral and texture features were intelligently extracted. Twelve segment-based spectral features were then used as the input to a feature selection procedure, while five texture parameters were utilized as dependent variables. After running Principal Component Analysis and Neighborhood Component Analysis, the RGB color model was selected to be utilized as an independent variable in the regression system. In conclusion, five ANFIS were able to predict corresponding textures accurately. The model for predicting contrast was the most accurate, while the model for predicting entropy texture was the least accurate. However, system improvement is also recommended by having a more categorically balanced number of images in the dataset.

articleTitle: Disentangling Firms' Drivers on Big Data Strategy Adoption: The Case of Thai Firms
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: In the recent world, the fully-integrated manufacturing firms' facilities and information system architecture such as big data can enable them to be more competitive in the uncertain market. However, the research on firms motivating drivers of big data adoption in the Thailand context is in its infancy and inconclusive. This study thus investigates the driving force of contributing factors influencing Thai firms to adopt big data. The research data was obtained from the Thailand Business R&D and Innovation Survey conducted by the National Science and Technology Development Agency (NSTDA) in 2018. Over 3,931 manufacturing firms have been included in this study to validate four hypotheses by logistic regression with the significance level of 0.05. The results show that firm size (p-value < 0.001), firm openness (p-value < 0.001), and acquisition of expert technology (p-value < 0.001) are associated with big data adoption propensity. Research results shed a new laser light on Thai firms' drivers on their proneness to adopt innovative technology in industry 4.0, which provides implications for both academics and practitioners at large.

articleTitle: Adoption Of Artificial Intelligence In Talent Acquisition: The Need For The E-Business Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This study aims to explore the adoption of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in talent acquisition. It will give insight into comparing the traditional talent acquisition process and the AI-adopted talent acquisition process. To aid the endeavour of the study, we have reviewed the literature to put insight into the ease of the process after adopting AI in talent acquisition. We conducted an evidence-based literature review using an integrated approach synthesis of peer-reviewed published literature on the role of AI in talent acquisition. For this study, the primary data were collected through the Focused Group discussion. Recruiters from IT companies from India were selected for focus group interviews. This study describes the role of AI in talent acquisition. AI has made it easy to work on talent and skill-matching the job profile. Insights on an effective model for using AI in recruiting talent are provided in this study. The author discussed how AI boosts the effectiveness of hiring procedures of the company. This paper adds to the body of knowledge by examining various areas of talent acquisition where AI techniques can be successfully applied.

articleTitle: Hybrid-Vehicle Purchase Intention in Indonesia: Does Environmental Concerns or Knowledge Matters?
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Hybrid vehicle is one of the solutions to reduce the threats of environmental degradation. This study aims to analyze the effect of environmental concerns and hybrid vehicle's knowledge on purchase intention of hybrid vehicle in Indonesia. A sample of 211 car owners in Indonesia have been collected to predict the intention to purchase hybrid vehicle using the theory of Planned Behavior. The empirical results show that the environmental concern and hybrid vehicle knowledges have direct effect on purchase intention mediated by attitude, subjective norms, and perceived behavior control. The implication for purchase intention of hybrid vehicle is discussed.

articleTitle: The Impact of Information Technology and Social Network in Knowledge Sharing for Organization Performance (A Case Study Approach)
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The Ministry of State-Owned Enterprises' (SOE) Making Indonesia 4.0 program will assess Indonesia's SOE readiness to lead and compete in the industrial 4.0 era. LKBN Antara is one SOE that has implemented knowledge management in its operation. As one of the SOEs that has been implementing knowledge management, researcher trying to configure whether there's an impact in Information Technology (IT) and Social Network in Knowledge Sharing to LKBN Antara's performance. In this research, researcher using structural equation modelling (SEM-PLS) technique and expert evaluation with structured questionnaires. The result was generated from the LKBN Antara's employees. the results showed that social networks have a positive impact on knowledge sharing, and knowledge sharing has a positive impact on organizational performance. However, the impact of information technology on knowledge sharing showed weak relevance. The results showed that social networks have a positive impact on knowledge sharing, and knowledge sharing has a positive impact on organizational performance. However, the impact of information technology on knowledge sharing showed weak relevance.

articleTitle: Students' Satisfaction with the Use of Google Forms for the TOEIC Test to Evaluate English Proficiency
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The purposes of this study were to investigate students' satisfaction with the use of Google Forms for the TOEIC test to evaluate English proficiency, and to study additional suggestions in order to improve the methods of teaching and evaluating students. The population of this study was 621 second-year students who enrolled in the TOEIC preparation course in the second semester of the 2022 academic year. The samples of this study were 150 students derived through the Simple Random Sampling Technique. The research instrument used in this study was a rating scale and an open-ended questionnaire. Frequency, percentage, mean, standard deviation, and content analysis were used for data analysis. The research findings were 1): students had the highest level of satisfaction in Accessibility, followed by Benefits and Usability for the TOEIC Test; and 2) the additional opinions and suggestions were listed based on the benefits and drawbacks of Google forms. Overall, there were 37 students (25%) who possess positive comments about using Google Forms and 21 students (13.33%) who are not satisfied with it.

articleTitle: Consignment of Epidermoid Carcinoma using BPN, RBFN and Chebyshev Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Oral cancer is the most dangerous and fast-spreading cancer in the world with the least survival rate. Oral cancer appears in and around the mouth. Of the oral epithelial carcinoma, cancer that occurs in the lip has the lowest mortality rate and tongue cancer has the highest mortality rate. Early-stage identification and treatment of Oral Squamous Cell Carcinoma is the most important aspect to avoid or reduce the rate of mortality. For early detection, other than physical examinations, various imaging techniques are available such as histopathological imaging, biomedical imaging, Ultrasound, MRI, CT, and Confocal scanning techniques. Multiclass classification is a major role in a real-world application. Tumor, Node and Metastasis are the most important aspect in the staging of oral cancer. Artificial Neural Networks and Machine Learning Techniques work much more effectively to provide better accuracy in medical image classification. For the classification of Oral Squamous Cell Carcinoma images and non-cancerous images, it is tested with three different networks viz Backpropagation network (BPN), Radial Basis Function network (RBF) and Chebyshev neural network. Dimensionality reduction has been done using Principal Component Analysis and explained using a variance plot. The r-square coefficient, which gauges how well the data fit the regression line, shows that, when compared to raw data, the PCA components boost the data's dependability. Of these BPN works well in the Epithelial carcinoma histopathological image classification when compared with RBF and Chebyshev network.

articleTitle: Taspen Mobile Usability Measurement for Taspen Participants Using Usefulness, Satisfaction, And Ease Of Use Questionnaire (USE) Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The number of Taspen mobile application users seen from the Google Play Store is as many as 100 thousand. Thermal is considered very small, considering the number of potential users, around 6 million participants. The application usage rating, which is also one of the indicators of the participant satisfaction level, is also deficient, is 2.1 on a scale of 5. In addition, there are still many complaints about the use of the Taspen Mobile Application also requires attention, especially from the aspect of ease of use. This study aims to analyze the level of user experience by measuring usability in the Taspen Mobile application using the Usefulness, Satisfaction, and Ease of use Questionnaire (USE) method and recommend a new user interface design. The USE Questionnaire method has four measurement variables: usefulness, ease of use, learning, and user satisfaction. The variables of effectiveness, ease of use, and ease of learning significantly influence user satisfaction. The satisfaction indicator in the R Square table, which is controlled by the variable's usefulness, the comfort of use, and ease of learning, has a moderate or sufficient number of 0.70. Meanwhile, in table F Square, the ease of use variable has the lowest number against the satisfaction variable, which is 0.111. These results are then used as the basis for recommendations for user interface improvements, which include the appearance of the main page, account page, and product page.

articleTitle: The Role of Social Media Analytics at Indonesian Schools (A Case Study Approach)
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: In today's era, the use of social media is massive, which encourages research on social media. Social media can be defined as a platform for communicating and sharing information. The massive use of social media encourages many institutions to use it as a platform to market and promote their products. The organizations discussed in this research is the schools, where schools are starting to use social media to help promote the school in recruitment. This research aims to find out what content can make social media users interested in content based on its engagement. In this context, social media users are prospective students and parents of students. The research method used is the correlation method, which helps know the magnitude of the influence of video content on the channel of school institutions with their marketing and recruitment. The social media platform used in this research is Instagram. Instagram is a platform for sharing photos and videos online, and the analytical tool used in helping this research is analisa.io. This research is intended for school institutions that use Instagram as a marketing tool. This research goal is to provide information about what factors make the content look attractive.

articleTitle: Web and Data Analytics of the Official Public Information Website of one Premier State University in the Philippines
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The Pangasinan State University website was redesigned last 2016 and continuously being improved up to the present. The purpose of this study is to understand and interpret the website's web analytics, which contribute to better decision making in writing personalized content. This more than 5 year data focuses on the acquisition and behavior of audiences on the institutional website of Pangasinan State University which can be accessed at psu.edu.ph. The data scope is from January 1, 2017 to September 30, 2022 where the year of the website was redesigned to meet to ongoing innovations. The methodology of the study includes the installation of Analytical code which tracks the audience from the website which generates reports and monitors the website's performance for future reference. The study shows the behavior of visitors and other information that could help the information officer of the University to provide personalized content for the year.

articleTitle: Consideration of Language Learning Service with Visualized Vocabulary Map Derived from WordNet
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The authors aim to propose highly effective, efficient and satisfactory service of language teaching and learning by means of educational technology from the viewpoint of usability engineering. In the field of computational/quantitative linguistics based on corpora data, many linguists have been numerically analyzing lexical characteristics for each English vocabulary and compiled them as a vocabulary list which is machine-readable since 1960s. On the other hand, a lexical database of semantic relations called WordNet has also been developed in the field of computing science. This study consists of three components. One is to enrich, refine and integrate already-existing vocabulary information in terms of “frequency”, “difficulty”, and “relativeness”. Another is to develop the system of language learning and teaching service with the integrated vocabulary information. And the other is to evaluate the system from usability engineering point of view. So far, the authors reached and conducted the first two kinds of studies, succeeded in deriving the newly-integrated vocabulary list and visualizing the word relations in each experiment.

articleTitle: The Antecedents of Online Impulsive Buying
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Consumer behavior to do shopping are changing. Impulsive buying via online platform is increasing. This study aims to examine whether shopping motivation and visual merchandising can be proven to be factors that affect online impulsive buying in consumers who shop online in the pastry and bakery business. Sample selection is carried out using non-probability sampling techniques, and purposive sampling techniques Primary data was obtained from a questionnaire that was filled out online by 120 respondents domiciled in Jabodetabek who met the requirements, and shopping between July-November 2022. The data were analyzed using the Coefficient and Annova test to determine the influence of each aspect. Multiple Linier Regression analysis were used, and the test results show that four dimensions of shopping motivation are directly influenced by online impulsive buying. Namely hedonic motivation, utilitarian motivation, peer influence, and social comparison. The Four dimensions of visualmerchandising are influenced by online impulsive buying, namely display, color, lighting, and assortment.

articleTitle: Adoption of TAM on Assessing the Behavior of Mutual Fund Investors in Using the Digital Financial
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Currently, the use of technology is almost comprehensive in the economic and business sectors. One of the current uses of technology has been adopted in mutual fund investment activities. Mutual fund investments can be made through a digital financial. Mutual funds are containers used to invest in a collection of instruments in the financial market. Mutual fund investment is currently made as easy as a transaction like online shopping. This study was conducted to determine whether technology adoption has an influence on investor behavior in investing in mutual funds. The independent variables used are perceived ease of use, perceived usefulness, and intention of use. This study uses a sample of 1000 investors who have invested in mutual funds in one of the digital financial. This research model uses a structural equation model (SEM) with SmartPLS 3.0 as a statistical analysis tool. SEM is used to determine the linear relationship between the independent variable and the dependent variable. The results show that the variables perceived ease of use, perceived usefulness, and intention of use partially have a positive influence on investor behavior. Variables perceived ease of use, perceived usefulness, and intention of use simultaneously influence investor behavior.

articleTitle: Towards Good Promotion Preparation with SIDODO (Catur Dharma Lecturer e-Documentation Application)
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: BINUS University is a leading university in Indonesia and a private university that has obtained a distance learning permit (PJJ) known as BINUS Online Learning. According to Law No. 12 of 2012 Article 1 paragraph 9 concerning Higher Education contains “Tridharma of higher education, hereinafter referred to as Tridharma, is the obligation of Higher Education to organize Education, Research and Community Service”. Binus University, which is one of the universities in Indonesia, needs to carry out the mandate of Law No. 12 of 2012 which is called Catur Dharma Faculty member. The obligation to carry out Catur Dharma Faculty members at Binus Online Learning determines the calculation of KPI FM and the realization of KPI departments. The unavailability of an information system that supports the activities of Catur Dharma Faculty members at Binus Online Learning makes every activity that has been carried out not properly documented and monitored, to answer the need for the required information system, it is necessary to develop an E-Documentation information system for chess dharma faculty members in online learning based on web applications. The development of this information system uses the system development life cycle with the Agile Scrum methodology. At the testing stage, UAT will be used with a Black Box Test combined with a Likert scale to assess user satisfaction with features that meet the needs of the user using the SERVQUAL method.

articleTitle: Development of a Quality Grading Model for Processed Milk through Sensor Data and Symbolic Genetic Programming
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Milk and other dairy products continue to be important components to the human diet. Large quantities of milk are produced globally for consumption and processing into other products. In the interest of food safety, quality inspection of milk becomes a necessity to ensure that only milk with favorable attributes is released for consumption. For this task, a mathematical model was developed with multigene symbolic regression genetic programming (MSRGP) that grades milk based on seven key input traits: pH level, temperature, taste, odor, fat content, turbidity, and color. By integrating the results of these attributes, the model can give an overall grade to milk samples. An online dataset was used to train and test the model. The developed model had an R<sup>2</sup> of 0.95441, highlighting its accuracy in predicting milk sample quality. Sensitivity analysis was also performed on the model to check how certain inputs affect the outputs. While there were outputs that went beyond the expected range, this was attributed to input combinations that were improbable in real life and thus, was not accounted for in the dataset. Overall, the model was able to create an accurate assessment of milk based on the dataset.

articleTitle: Japan and Indonesia Comparative Study: Do Gender Discriminatory Expressions Affect Consumer Behaviour?
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Since its inception, advertising reflected not only products for consumers to buy, but the everyday situations in which consumers use them. Although it has been useful to businesses, decades of advertising transmission continued to have a clear impact on how society perceived men and women. As a result, whether it be direct or indirect, outside of advertising and the media, men and women who were not “the way they should be” were frowned upon, which is unfortunately reflected in both countries, Japan, and Indonesia. This research was held to find out what role does gender discrimination words have in marketing. This research also aims to find the similarities and differences in consumer behavior between Japan and Indonesia, and if Advertisements that use gender-targeting words such as “Popular among males/Popular among Females” can affect consumer behavior, using Descriptive Statistical approach to analyze Data. Based on the research results, this research has found that consumer behavior in both countries, Japan, and Indonesia, were not affected by advertisements that are using gender specific wording, colors and/or pictures. There was a small variation in the data we received from the Japanese Survey, stating that they were “affected” by the advertisements, but they are but a small minority (10%).

articleTitle: Syllabus Management System and Coordinator Recommendation System on Universitas Multimedia Nusantara
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This research project aims to improve the quality of created Syllabus by maintaining format consistency and addressing the need for competent course coordinators. To accomplish this, the study employs a range of methods, including quantitative research, prototyping, and the use of profile-matching algorithms to develop a website containing a comprehensive Syllabus management system and a course coordinator recommendation system. There are 8 phases: Initial Requirements, Design, Prototyping, Evaluation, Review & Update, Coding, Testing, and Maintenance. The unique aspect of this research is its focus on the Syllabus documents of the UMN information systems major, the integration of a document management system and a decision support system, as well as the implementation of ReactJS programming languages and YII2 frameworks. Data for the study was gathered through a combination of literature review, observation, and interviews and analyzed using content and descriptive analysis techniques. The Syllabus management system successfully standardized the format and arrangement of the Syllabus by providing a consistent template and streamlining the input process. The recommendation system offers valuable insights for determining subject coordinators by ranking candidates based on specified evaluation criteria. However, many areas can still be explored and developed to expand the knowledge base of information systems and enhance the quality of education.

articleTitle: Intelligent Water Quality Management in Maturation Tanks for Penaeus Monodon Using Fuzzy Logic
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: With the global population expected to grow considerably in the upcoming years, global food production should also keep up with the growing demand. Rapid and uncontrolled food production can potentially affect aquaculture methods. Such impact leads to the destruction of habitats and neglect of maintaining tanks, ponds, water, and feed. Thus, the health status of stocks has been reported as causing bacteria and viral infections to exploit poor water maintenance. This study developed and examined the efficacy of using Mamdani fuzzy logic controllers on water quality management for aquaculture, specifically in Penaeus monodon cultivation. MATLAB was used to model the Fuzzy Inference Systems (FIS) consisting of x rules based on the combinations of highly significant water parameters, particularly temperature, dissolved oxygen, salinity, and pH level. The FIS was then simulated in Simulink, wherein the fuzzy controllers were capable of sending a signal to different pumps that would optimize the said water parameters. Overall, this study provides strong support for the effectiveness of fuzzy logic to automatically adjust water parameters and reducing the need for human inputs.

articleTitle: Forecasting the Maize Export Using Time Series Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This research aims to study the suitable time series analysis to forecast Maize exports over the next twelve months. The time series data source was gathered from the Office of SMEs Promotion monthly from January 2013 to December 2022 (120 months). We selected Thailand's maize export value to Myanmar, which continuously exports maize. The experiment begins with preparation, selection, and verification. Time series analysis was considered by two methods: Decomposition and Box-Jenkin's (SARIMA) method. We used Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) to compare and select the lowest value. The results showed that the maize exports value from January 2013 to December 2022 has been increasing. The highest period of maize export value was in March, and the lowest was in July. The Decomposition method has the lowest mean absolute percentage error (MAPE), equal to 2.6372. Decomposition is a suitable technique. It can forecast the maize exporting over the next twelve months. In the next twelve months, the forecast maize export value will decrease from 2022.

articleTitle: Scrum-based development model:Improve the engineering quality and testing method of blockchain projects
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: In order to improve software development efficiency, ensure software quality, and provide efficient project management O&M services, this paper explores the blockchain software engineering process based on Scrum agile development models and its various testing methods, such as CITA and DevOps, to improve the quality of software engineering in the blockchain domain. We outline the application of the Scrum-oriented development model in blockchain projects and introduce various methods and frameworks to improve blockchain software engineering, describing that the combination of Scrum, blockchain and DevOps can be used to create a robust and efficient software development process. By practicing agile development in development management, automating operations and maintenance with DevOps, and implementing continuous automated testing, the goal is to provide a solid, efficient, flexible, and future-proof operating platform for enterprise-level blockchain applications. By combining multiple approaches, organizations can create powerful and efficient software development processes that are being adopted by other industries and explored for potential applications in healthcare, government, and other sectors. That is, agile, secure and responsive to customer needs.

articleTitle: Factors of Using E-Wallet on Student Online Shopping Transactions in Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: According to Good Stats, e-wallet users will increase by 300% in early 2021. The use of e-wallets is very popular with the public, especially millennials and Gen Z at this time. Convenience, efficiency, and effectiveness are added values in using e-wallets. The existence of consumptive behavior driven by the development of e-commerce has also affected the increase in the number of e-wallet users. Based on the results of previous research, various insights can be taken as references in this study. However, the authors found gaps in several previous studies which became the reason for the authors to look for what factors influence students in choosing and using certain e-wallet platforms. This research was conducted using a qualitative method where the Google Form questionnaire was distributed using the snowball sampling technique. There are 6 variables in this study with 4 indicators on each variable. 101 students filled out the research questionnaire. Based on this data, it is known that 98% of them are e-wallet users. The results of the study state that security and trend have the greatest influence on e-wallet interest and e-wallet platform awareness. The results of our research are useful for companies engaged in digital payments or e-wallets to increase profits.

articleTitle: The Systematic Mapping of Inter-organizational Strategic Relationship Studies: A Modern Business Administration Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Despite the importance of inter-organizational strategic relationships in reaching new sources of innovation and knowledge in modern business administration, this concept was unknown up to the 1980s and has become far more dominant in the last twenty years. The primary purpose of the present research is to provide a summation of the current literature that has studied the process and role of strategic relationships among organizations. This study used a systematic mapping review; and analyzed 93 high-quality peer-reviewed scholarly papers from several aspects. To analyze the articles, a categorized scheme was developed. The papers have been analyzed based on their type of relation, publication features, and research methodology. These aspects can help future readers comprehensively understand the nature of inter-organizational strategic relationships. Managerial implications have been provided besides a discussion of the study's findings.

articleTitle: ICFY (I Care For You): An IOT Based Fall Detection and Monitoring Device using ESP32-CAM and MPU 6050 Sensors
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Elderly people's safety and health are seriously threatened by falls. The elderly is vulnerable to fall injuries, which can occasionally result in death. Due to their physical makeup and advanced age, elderly people require greater care. The goal of this study is to develop a fall detection and monitoring system called ICFY (I Care For You) that can tell whether an elderly person has sustained an injury as well as to provide quick assistance to the elderly and reduce self-reported injuries. The rechargeable wrist wearable device has an ESP32-CAM module and MPU 6050 sensor that detect falls and take pictures, respectively. The project was created using the prototyping technique. The study involved on-site surveys and show the elderly demonstrations to provide them more information about the project. The criteria with the highest rank were determined using the ISO 25010 Quality Model survey. The top three (3) criteria following implementation were portability, functional stability, and usability. Overall, the project was rated “Very Good”. As a result, it is claimed that the wrist wearable device project is useful and effective for the elderly in preventing and monitoring falls.

articleTitle: Factors Affecting Structural Leadership of Young Leaders in Thailand
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The researcher investigated factors impacting structural leadership in terms of the pressure on young leaders in Thailand. The young leaders studying in a leadership course at a large private university located in Pathum Thani province where the population of this research is. The 356 valid samples were gathered using the survey method. Most of the respondents were females around 20 years old. They were sophomore students at the university. They were from the School of Business Administration and the School of Accounting. Descriptive statistics and multiple regression analysis were utilized. The researcher found that entrepreneurial leadership, interpersonal relationships in terms of accessibility, managerial competency, and transformational leadership had a positive impact towards structural leadership in terms of pressure on young leaders in Thailand respectively. The result of this study could be useful for university business faculties, business organizations, and future research in the management field. This research extended structural leadership with entrepreneurial leadership, interpersonal relationships in terms of accessibility, managerial competency, and transformational leadership.

articleTitle: Business Intelligence Dashboard for Asset Inventory Management Monitoring at PT Indonesia Power Head Office
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Currently the development of information technology is so fast, the use of information technology is absolutely necessary to support business processes and increase the productivity of the company. Likewise with PT. Indonesia Power where the company's business development is currently technology-based. This causes the number of software and laptops to increase so that the recording and management of software, licenses and devices are still not going well because currently recording software licenses still use document files. This is felt to be less effective because tracing a license takes longer and licenses that have expired are still installed on employee laptops because of not being properly monitored. In addition to poor record keeping, several users use software that is not officially licensed within PT. Indonesia Power so that it can harm the company. Therefore, a Business Intelligence (BI) Dashboard is needed using the Prototype method which provides monitoring information related to IT software asset inventory with the aim that the monitoring process can be carried out more effectively and efficiently. It is hoped that this research will produce a BI dashboard to assist the IT sector in monitoring IT software asset inventory.

articleTitle: Assessing the UAVs' Requirements and Capabilities For Humanitarian Logistics Operations in Thailand
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This article aims to identify and assess the design requirements and capabilities of unmanned aerial vehicles used in the area of humanitarian logistics, particularly for the delivery of aid packages, to alleviate the impact and casualties from natural disaster's victims in Thailand. Designed restrictions and sub-restrictions were identified from past literature and an expert interview. By applying a multi-criteria decision-making analysis tool, which is the analytical hierarchy process, design restrictions and sub-restrictions was quantified and prioritized. Primary data was collected through private, face-to-face interviews. Respondents are UAV pilots, UAV developers from associated industries, and UAV researcher. The computed outputs revealed that the payload capacity of the UAVs, the weight of aid packages, the flight range, and the battery power capacity were among the sub-restrictions with the highest relative importance, while flight performance is the most important restrictions in the drones' design requirements. On the contrary, the speed of UAV and the operating cost were the sub-restrictions with the smallest effect.

articleTitle: Does the Form of University Classes Relate to Academic Performance
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: In early 2020, the world was shocked by the spread of a disease caused by a virus known as COVID-19, which is a disease caused by a corona virus that infects the respiratory system and causes respiratory failure (Abdilah 2020). COVID-19 is a new virus that is related to the SARS (Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome) virus and several types of viruses that cause the common flu (WHO 2020). The impact of the new Covid-19 infections has changed the format of university classes, with online classes now being offered. This change in class format is also expected to have an impact on student performance. In this research, we need to see the changes especially on Bunpou (grammar) classes in 3rd and 4th grade on Binus University Student.

articleTitle: Degradation of InGaN LEDs by Proton Radiation
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Light-emitting diodes (LEDs) made of nitride are appealing because they can withstand high temperatures and be used in harsh environments. The degradation behaviour of the device performance on Indium Gallium Nitride (InGaN) LEDs (light emitting diodes) irradiated by 2-MeV protons with the fluence of 1×10<sup>13</sup> cm<sup>−2</sup> is studied. The electrical and optical characteristics of three commercially available LEDs, VLHW4100, OVLAW4CB7 and VAOL-3GWY4, were compared before and after radiation. The results show a considerable degradation in the LED electrical performance. After irradiation, the reverse leakage current increases in all three devices. The degradation in OVLAW4CB7 is for the entire reverse bias voltage range, while the degradation is prominent at lower reverse bias voltages for the other two devices. However, while calculating the increase in dark current at a reverse bias voltage of 5 volts, it is found that the dark current increases the most in VAOL-3GWY4, which is around 22 times. The traps and the bulk defect are believed to contribute to the increased leakage current. The forward Current-Voltage and the Capacitance-Voltage characteristics do not change much after radiation. The optical intensity corresponding to different wavelengths is obtained for the device's optical characterization. The results show that the optical intensity of the devices increased after radiation. This increase is because of the increase in carrier lifetime in the active region after radiation and radiation-induced annealing of defects. In this research quantum well LEDs are used. When using these devices based on InGaN in harsh conditions or open spaces, the degradation characteristics described in the present study can assist scientists and engineers in making well-informed decisions, as little is known about the degradation of InGaN LEDs after proton radiation.

articleTitle: A Novel end-to-end Framework for Occluded Pixel Reconstruction with Spatio-temporal Features for Improved Person Re-identification
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Person re-identification is vital for monitoring and tracking crowd movement to enhance public security. However, re-identification in the presence of occlusion substantially reduces the performance of existing systems and is a challenging area. In this work, we propose a plausible solution to this problem by developing effective occlusion detection and reconstruction framework for RGB images/videos consisting of Deep Neural Networks. Specifically, a CNN-based occlusion detection model classifies individual input frames, followed by a Conv-LSTM and Autoencoder to reconstruct the occluded pixels corresponding to the occluded frames for sequential (video) and non-sequential (image) data, respectively. The quality of the reconstructed RGB frames is further refined and fine-tuned using a Conditional Generative Adversarial Network (cGAN). Our method is evaluated on four well-known public data sets of the domain, and the qualitative reconstruction results are indeed appealing. Quantitative evaluation in terms of re-identification accuracy of the Siamese network showed an exceptional Rank-1 accuracy after occluded pixel reconstruction on various datasets. A comparative analysis with state-of-the-art approaches also demonstrates the robustness of our work for use in real-life surveillance systems.

articleTitle: Evaluation and Recommendation of Odoo Enterprise Resource Planning System Operation & Maintenance Module
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This study aims to evaluate and provide recommendations by testing the usability level of the Odoo Operation & Maintenance ERP Module application. Using the SUS Questionnaire method, the results of usability testing were analyzed into each parameter of the SUS Questionnaire. The SUS questionnaire has an assessment criteria of “Unacceptable category” with a value range of 0–50 class F and has an adjective rating of “Worst Imaginable to Poor”, the category “Low Marginal” with a score range of 51-62.5 class F and has a word rating OK trait, Marginal High Category with a range of 62.6–70 grade D and adjective rating OK, and Acceptable Category with a score range of 70–100 grade C to A and adjective rating good, very good to best. The test results get a value of 53.25 including the OK Marginal Low category, meaning that it needs improvement so that the system can be well received by users. Further interviews were also conducted with ten informants to obtain a specific description of the complaints of system users. From the results of the interview, an analysis was carried out to provide evaluations and recommendations for improvement of the Odoo ERP Operation & Maintenance Module.

articleTitle: Intrinsic Motivation of Thai Students Taking Japanese at Thai-Nichi Institute of Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The aims of this study were to identify 1) differences in intrinsic motivation between grades; 2) the factors that make a difference in intrinsic motivation. The sample for this study consists of 742 randomly selected participants. These 742 students were from the Faculty of Engineering, the Faculty of Information Technology, and the Faculty of Business Administration, who took Business Japanese1, Business Japanese3, and Business Japanese5 courses offered in the first semester of academic year 2022 at Thai-Nichi Institute of Technology. A questionnaire consisting of 30 questions measuring intrinsic motivation was used in this study. Survey was distributed to students using Google Forms. ANOVA was used for analysis across the grades of study. Furthermore, factor analysis was conducted on the 30 questions. Factor analysis revealed four factors: Causality, Challenge, Curiosity, and Mastery. Differences were found among grades in Challenge, Curiosity, and Mastery, with first-grade students having higher average values for Challenge and Mastery, and second-grade and third-grade students having higher average values for Curiosity.

articleTitle: Development of an Institutional Digital Research Archive for Adamson University
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Replication and a lack of departmental collaboration are two issues with institutional research that are generally recognized. Institutions are creating innovation silos across offices and departments without access to pooled research information. It hinders innovation and evades the institution's research mission. The research intends to develop a digital archive for scholarly works of Adamson University to facilitate the storage and information sharing of research data across the school. User Management, Research Repository, Data Visualization, Creation of User Interfaces, and System Testing are the research's five main scopes. Respondents were surveyed by the researchers and grouped into three groups: students, academic staff, and research staff. Using a user acceptance survey based on ISO 25010 standard on software quality, it was determined that features of the developed system were acceptable for all user groups. Correlation analysis using Pearson and Spearman correlation was also done, to determine the consistency and relationship of the acceptance of each user group. The developed system and its user acceptance analysis show its acceptance of users on different levels and its effectivity on the current organization.

articleTitle: The Influence of Social Presence on Actual Purchase Mediated by Attitude toward the Product
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: People are currently experiencing a transition from a traditional (brick-and-mortar) market to an online market. However, despite the convenience of shopping online, online shopping has several drawbacks, including the inability to inspect or manage the product and low social interaction. This study examines how social presence in online reviews can help consumers make actual purchases. In addition, the Theory of Planned Behavior is used in this study to investigate consumer purchasing behavior. This study uses a quantitative approach using SmartPLS to test the hypotheses made. The study uses Shopee consumer data located in the JABODETABEK area (Jakarta, Bogor, Depok, Tangerang, and Bekasi). This study focuses on Shopee customers with an age range of 18–35. The researchers employed an online survey to collect respondent data. Data collection was distributed from April to May 2022, and collected 100 respondents. The results showed that social presence positively affected attitudes toward products and actual purchases. Several theoretical and managerial implications for online sellers and e-commerce platforms are discussed based on the findings.

articleTitle: The Effect of the Gaze Visualization Interface on the Learning Performance of Virtual Reality Medical Education
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Here we propose a virtual reality education system that applies an eye-tracking-based gaze visualization interface to prevent the user from experiencing cognitive overload, which may occur in existing virtual reality educational environments. Two gaze visualization interface types, Circle Marker and Highlight, are first used by the instructor to produce virtual reality medical educational content. An experiment is then conducted to analyze the difference in learning performance between these two interface types, with the degrees of concentration and learning flow selected as the learning performance indicators to be evaluated. The learning concentration is evaluated using the dwell time, and the learning flow is evaluated using a survey. A correlation analysis between the degrees of concentration and learning flow is performed, with a positive correlation determined for these two learning performance indicators. An independent samples t-test confirms that there is a statistically significant difference between the degrees of concentration and learning flow based on the type of gaze visualization interface, with the results obtained using the Circle Marker type having a more positive effect on both learning concentration and flow.

articleTitle: The Effect of Power Charging Station and Green Message on Purchase Intention of Electric Cars
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The growth of the electric car business in Indonesia continues to grow with many new brands getting involved in the industry. This support is also supported by energy source providers in Indonesia to provide power charging in several locations in the city center. From previous research, one of the inhibiting factors in adopting electric cars is the unavailability of adequate power charging to support the mobilization of electric vehicles. This study aims to see the impact of the spread of power charging stations and green messages on the purchase intention of electric cars from potential consumers. This research uses a quantitative-qualitative approach, in the first stage using PLS-SEM analysis to see the relationship between the constructs studied with the help of the SmartPLS application. The research uses an online survey by providing indicators for each construct. A Likert scale of 1–5 is used to assist in measurement. Then in the second stage, this research uses open-ended questions to see what factors are needed by consumers regarding power charging stations to strengthen and enrich quantitative data. Data is processed using 2 stages of coding to get themes or factors. The results of this study indicate the influence of power charging stations and green messages on electric car purchase intention. In addition, there are factors that become consumer aspirations for power charging stations to be able to provide power charging station facilities from the spread at various strategic points, charging process, in accordance with standards and procedures, and complementary facilities. The benefits of this study are to determine the effect of power charging stations and green messages on consumer desire to make purchases. It is also useful for producers to know the influencing factors related to electric charging facilities.

articleTitle: The Experimental Introduction of Moodle Online Quizzes in a C# Basic Programming Course
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Developing and keeping the students' motivation throughout the course seems to be key issues for teaching programming. In light of this viewpoint, we introduced Moodle online quizzes to our C# basic programming course for the first-year students. We found that gamification can motivate students easily at the beginning, but it is difficult to keep their motivation. For some students, online quizzes successfully developed their motivation and kept it throughout the course. We understand that they are motivated intrinsically. However, for some other students, online quizzes led to less motivation, because they felt the quizzes were too difficult. Additionally, we found that some students kept their motivation to some extent, and resulted in low scores. We understand that they are motivated only externally. When the difficulty of quizzes was adjusted to a student level, which means that he/she can find the answer with a little effort using the knowledge acquired so far, the quizzes can motivate the student intrinsically.

articleTitle: Customs Tariff Classification of Organic Chemicals with Data Mining Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Harmonized System (HS Code) is a widely used classification system for commodities and facilitating international trade with 97 chapters according to commodity types. Classifying some of the 97 chapters of the HS Code can be a time-consuming and demanding process. In particular, the classification of organic chemicals belonging to HS Code Chapter 29 is especially challenging and requires specialized knowledge. This research aims to examine the classification of the first four digits of HS Code Chapter 29 of organic chemicals (headings 29.01-29.35) using IUPAC names, a globally recognized chemical nomenclature and terminology. In this study, two machine learning models, K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN) and Support Vector Machines (SVMs), were employed and their parameters were optimized for maximum accuracy. Results showed that the SVM model with optimized parameters achieved the highest accuracy. The results of this study can be applied to improve the efficiency and accuracy of customs operations in the future.

articleTitle: Job Insecurity Dilemma, a Post-Pandemic Phenomenon
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Social interaction limits, economic ramifications, and widespread unemployment brought on by the global COVID-19 pandemic have all contributed to a cascade of impacts that have left workers feeling insecure and at risk for the future. Most of the previous studies discuss workers' insecurity of losing their jobs. However, there is also a phenomenon where companies, especially start-ups, lose their talented workers to another company or even to a competitor considered to have a more secure future. This study examines two sides of employee turnover by identifying between workers who fear losing their jobs and those considering moving to other companies for their careers. A quantitative method was chosen, targeting start-up workers in Jakarta metropolitan area, Indonesia. Two hundred valid questionnaires were collected and analyzed with Partial Least Squares-Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM). Only one hypothesis was rejected. Moreover, job insecurity had significant effects on Job engagement and Turnover Intention of start-up workers. Based on the findings, several practical and theoretical implications are discussed.

articleTitle: Design of an Optimized Second-order Soil-based Drip Fertigation Control System with Internet-of-Things Integration
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Fertigation, which makes use of fertilizer injection into irrigation systems, has shown better results in terms of crop yield and water efficiency. To further improve this method, as well as make this more viable for farming use, this study developed a fertigation control system for efficient water and fertilizer crop distribution with Internet of Things (IoT) integration. The developed IoT control system functions as the autonomous feedback mechanism, collecting the data via flow sensor and sending it to the motor through a cloud server whose power would then be adjusted automatically to maintain the desired flow. To create the system, a second order transfer function for fertigation systems was derived, after which was optimized in the MATLAB Simulink space. The simulations of the closed-loop, single input, single output system tested compensator conditions, along with proportional-integral-derivative (PID) controller tuning. The test results showed that the steady state error compensators were not sufficient in optimizing the system. For full optimization, the implementation of the tuned PID controller allowed for the minimal overshoot along with a relatively quick time before stabilization. This study reduced the imprecise control of water supply along with the concentration of fertilizer in inducing plant growth.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study on Satellite Image Analysis for Road Traffic Detection using YOLOv3-SPP, Keras RetinaNet and Full Convolutional Network
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Satellite imagery has wide ranging applications that enable different fields including transportation. The authors would like to leverage this technology in terms of collecting traffic data. Traffic data is vital information in calibrating volume-delay functions to forecast demand to ensure efficient route plan outputs. This study aims to assess the readiness level of heavily trained object detection models in detecting vehicles occupying small pixels on open source satellite images. The results of the study show that the Full Convolutional Network outperforms YOLOv3-SPP and RetinaNet models with an accuracy of 92%, 81%, and 48% respectively. Considering other factors, the proponents have concluded as well that the YOLOv3-SPP model has the potential to surpass FCN given certain preconditions indicated in the recommendation section of the paper. Despite the poor performance of RetinaNet in this study, its capability was not discounted completely. In fact, RetinaNet architecture can be seen as more strategic than the YOLO family because it pays close attention to regions, which is a good fit for satellite images. Although it falls short on detecting as many vehicles as possible, it has a very high confidence level in its detection, so misclassification is almost not an issue for this model.

articleTitle: Acceptance of Mobile Application on Disaster Preparedness: Towards Decision Intelligence in Disaster Management
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The goal of disaster management encompasses the implementation of strategies to minimize the hostile impact of disasters. With the recent technological advancements, the use of mobile applications and artificial intelligence (AI) are seen to play a pivotal role in disaster mitigation, preparation, response, and recovery. Thus, this paper proposes an architecture for smart disaster management for a developing country, the Philippines. On the other side, this paper evaluates the acceptance of the developed mobile application for disaster preparedness simulation. This study involved disaster management personnel in non-government organizations. Initial acceptance results of the survey and focus group discussion show high acceptance of the mobile application for disaster preparedness and found it useful and engaging. This study confirms the potential of system architecture on disaster preparedness, which can be useful in developing decision intelligence in disaster management. This is one of the few studies that attempts to demonstrate a smart disaster management architecture in a developing country to aid policy development and generated practices.

articleTitle: Hybrid Stochastic Genetic Evolution-Based Prediction Model of Received Input Voltage for Underground Imaging Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The capacitive resistivity technique in underground object detection comprises configured transmitter and receiver antennas that are capacitively coupled to the ground. However, underground imaging lacks a basis for determining the received voltage for precise data analysis. This study aimed to develop a prediction model of the received input voltage signal amplitude from the ground of a single-pair antenna underground imaging system. The receiver antenna circuit for this application is designed and simulated in Proteus Software. Genetic Programming (GP) is applied to predict the received input signal based on the shape of the received waveform signal, operating frequency, resistance of the waveform shaping circuit, and buffer amplifier output signal. The resulting fitness function of GP (4) is acceptable as it scored an R<sup>2</sup> of 99.38% with a negligible MSE of 0.0059 and an MAE of 12.3423. Then, the GP fitness function is optimized through Genetic Algorithm (GA), Differential Evolution (DE), and Evolutionary Strategy (ES) in which the GP-GA model outperformed the two hybrid models providing fast convergence and 2.49e<sup>−8</sup> best fitness value. This study proved that GP can be effectively combined with stochastic genetic evolution algorithms to avoid lengthy mathematical calculations and accurately estimate the natural voltage received from the ground.

articleTitle: Scenario-driven Technology Foresight for The Process Analytical Instrumentation Industry in The Philippines
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Industrial automation has allowed firms from key sectors in the Philippines to remain competitive such as agriculture, retail, manufacturing, transportation, and warehousing. While the IT and BPO sectors are the biggest in terms of export services, manufacturing industries such as electronics assemblers remain significant players through the adoption of fourth industrial revolution (4IR) technologies. In effect, local manufacturing firms should upskill their workforce and keep their operations efficient by automating key processes of their businesses through the 4IR.
