The industrial developments in the Philippines created a growing need for locally available automation solutions, and process analytical instrumentation applications present opportunities for new product development that can spur new technologies and services for the local manufacturing scene. Advanced process analyzers such as gas chromatographs and spectrometers are normally sourced abroad. This study examines variables that can guide firms venturing into the local automation sector to consider possible future scenarios for the process analyzers market. By performing technology foresight through the scenario-building approach, key predictable drivers are identified and ranked through insights from industry professionals, and future scenarios are developed.

articleTitle: Tuber Root Growth In Silico Phenotyping Using Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Capacitive Resistivity Imaging System
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The study of plant root growth monitoring is critical for ensuring the sustainability of food production, particularly for tuber and other agricultural crops. Although capacitive resistivity imaging has been researched for non-destructive root tomography, image characterization accuracy remains relatively low. Thus, this study developed an intelligent root radius prediction method by utilizing an adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS). The capacitive resistivity imaging (CRI) system and root specimen were modeled and simulated using CADFEKO. There were 100 data pairs employed that were divided for training, testing, and checking. From four input variables such as the voltage differences from electrode pairs C1, C2, D1, and D2, and a single output which is the root radius, 81 rules were constructed. Using grid partition method, different membership functions were applied to identify the one with the best performance in predicting the root radii based on the model evaluation metrics. The results shows that the triangular membership function (trimf) has the best performance with 0.9998, 8.85e-<sup>9</sup>, and 0.9999 values for the R2, MSE, and R, respectively. Furthermore, the comparison of the actual and predicted output shows a huge accuracy in result which proves that the developed root radius prediction approach is suitable for CRI system root size prediction.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence for Sustainability: Evidence from select Small and Medium Enterprises in the Philippines
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is an emerging technology in small and medium enterprises (SMEs). Recently, SMEs have growing interests in using artificial intelligence to improve business performance. However, SMEs are confronted with sustainability, which remains a research gap. This paper presents the first evidence of select SMEs using artificial intelligence in business for sustainability in the Philippines, through a qualitative study involving managers. Results show that a few SMEs have AI applications in business that contributes to sustainability. While there are on-going sustainability efforts, most SMEs are in the incremental and situational development levels. Also, this study confirms that insufficient physical and technological infrastructure, availability of data, customers privacy and security, insufficient legal frameworks, management support, and lack of AI adoption strategy are evident issues and challenges that limits the progress AI application in business for sustainability. This study presents some implications to SMEs, policy-making and future work to progress AI for sustainability.

articleTitle: FUNologo: An Android-based Mobile Virtual Reality Assisted Learning with Speech Recognition Using Diamond-Square Algorithm for Children with Phonological Dyslexia
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The study aims to provide a synergy of mobile development and virtual reality application into a fun and interactive speech-controlled game designed for children with phonological dyslexia. It also focuses on the approach conducted to specify, design, and implement the virtual reality application using Diamond-Square Algorithm. With the integration of a learning technique called the OrtonGillingham multisensory approach, the Android-based virtual reality assisted learning application will help these children establish their phonological awareness in terms of rhyming and syllabication as they immerse themselves into an audio-visual learning experience. The methodology used in this research are system storyboard, rapid application development, and testing and evaluation of the software using ISO 9126. The performance of the proposed system was evaluated by implementing an evaluation plan. When this stage was completed, it was guaranteed that all input from the tests generated throughout each iteration of the process were addressed, resulting in a more improved and satisfactory software product. The summary results from the data analysis supported the claim that the V.R. application had increased the results with an average percentage of 71% and has a potential as an alternative platform to traditional teaming.

articleTitle: An exploratory study: Customer experience in Government's mobile application
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The programmer designed the mobile application with a friendly version. Its application is planned for effortless usage and is easy to use, called User experience (UX). The mobile government application aimed to launch to facilitate people for their daily consumption and transaction. However, some functions and interfaces should be developed and customized to the specific user. The government's mobile application is suggested to explore the Customer experience (CX) to ease and convince people to take advantage of the government mobile application. Using a qualitative and exploratory approach, the interview was conducted with the customer experience to explore the perception and feedback of government applications. A semi-structured interview with 17 participants was conducted to examine the customer experience. These findings provide important implications and input for the government mobile application and user experience development.

articleTitle: Waste Minimization and Performance Improvement in Vegetable Supply Chains: A Case Study from a Developing Economy
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Unproductive upstream and downstream supply chains' operational performance in the developing economies have resulted large scale waste within vegetable supply chains. This resulted loss of return on investments. This has been further exacerbated by the lack of empowerment and bargaining ability as well as lack of a standard measurement and reporting system in the vegetable supply chains. A case study has been carried out in a developing economy to explore the currently existing vegetable supply chain eco-system and performance. A major vegetable distribution hub of Sri Lanka has been selected to collect data. Value chain analysis (VCA) combined with the cause-and-effect analysis was performed to visualize the currently existing supply chain network and to identify prevailing issues. The findings reveal that a marginally lower share has been passed to the micro and small scale producers after selling their harvest to intermediaries. The small and medium scale producers currently have no influence on product pricing and are heavily influenced by the market syndicates. The overall findings of this study provide a foundation for developing policies to uplift the current existing vegetable supply chain eco-system, and to minimize the food security risk, in developing economies by minimizing systemic waste in the vegetable supply chains.

articleTitle: MeterFTX: Shuffled Frog Leap-Optimized Feed Forward Neural Network Applied on Transmitter Monitoring System for Multi-array Antenna Subsurface Imaging
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Capacitive resistivity subsurface imaging utilizes a transceiver system for non-intrusive survey mapping of underground structures. To explore this technique more, a newly developed transmitter design was considered where electrical properties such as frequency, output voltage, power, and waveform could be altered. And to monitor its output for proper observation during experiments, a measuring circuit was designed to measure its operating frequency, current, and voltage simultaneously. MeterFTX was made possible by integrating a microcomputer into the measuring circuit. From the circuit, the microcomputer will have inputs of a DC signal and pulse signal for current amplitude and frequency measurement, respectively, which will be used for predicting the current with an artificial neural network (ANN) and a cascaded ANN for voltage prediction from the resulting current prediction. With feed forward (FFNN) and recurrent (RNN) neural networks for predictions, the FFNN models elicited a lower MSE. These FFNN models were optimized using Ant Lion Optimizer, Black-Hole-based Optimization, and Shuffled Frog Leap Algorithm (SFLA). SFLA-optimized FFNN produced the most acceptable accuracy with negligible MSE of 9.9971e-<sup>8</sup> and 2.7932e-<sup>5</sup> for current and voltage predictions, respectively. This makes MeterFTX a feasible monitoring device for its intended application avoiding multiple connections and bulky highvoltage components.

articleTitle: Multi-agent Traffic Light Controls with SUMO
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This study focuses on the optimization of Traffic Light System (TLS) control through the use of adaptive agents. The performance of adaptive cycle TLS was compared with fixed cycle TLS. Two different adaptive cycle TLS agents were investigated, reactive and Deep Q-Network (DQN) agents. The reactive agent adjusted its control signals based on traffic measures such as queue length, while the DQN agent employed a deep reinforcement learning algorithm to determine its control signals. Two sets of simulations were conducted to evaluate the performance of both approaches. The results showed that the adaptive cycle TLS was more effective in reducing waiting times and increasing traffic throughput than the fixed cycle TLS. Among the adaptive agents, the reactive agent outperformed the DQN agent, due to the difficulty in learning an optimal policy in the traffic control domain, which has a non-stationary and complex nature. This preliminary study showed the potential benefits of using adaptive agents for traffic light control, and further studies in various areas such as employing more advanced TLS control methods, expanding the scale of the study, and applying real-demand in the simulation, could be carried out in future work.

articleTitle: Indonesia State Electricity Company's Self-Service Technology Adoption: New PLN Mobile
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The purpose of this research is to analyze and prove the influence of Information Quality, System Quality, Perceived Convenience, Perceived Usefulness, and Perceived Ease of Use on the Intention to Use of the New PLN Mobile application. The research method used is a quantitative method with an associative approach. The data were collected using a cross-sectional survey with 400 respondents who are users of the New PLN Mobile application. Data were analyzed using the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) using SmartPLS software. The results showed that Perceived Convenience had an effect size on Perceived Usefulness. The Adjusted R-Square value also shows that the most influential dependent variable in the use of the New PLN Mobile Application is Perceived Usefulness. This means that the more efficient and effective the New PLN Mobile application felt by the users, the greater the perceived benefits of the ease of using the application. This study contributes to the research of the factors that influence user interest in using the New PLN Mobile application, either directly or indirectly. Research also shows that many PLN customers who are users of the application feel a more pleasant experience with the presence of the New PLN Mobile application.

articleTitle: Assessing Determinants of the Telemedicine Applications Continuance Usage Intention with TTF Theory
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: During the Covid-19 outbreak, the number of cases in Indonesia increased rapidly and the government encouraged patients to use e-health applications for accurate medical information and personal healthcare assistance. This study adopted the theory of Task Technology Fit (TTF) to examine the determinant factors that affect the continuance usage of e-health applications and what users concern the most when using this application among the people living in Jakarta, Indonesia. The survey was conducted using questionnaires via online platforms and social media. The collected data was analyzed using the SMART-PLS method on 137 respondents. The results indicated the significant contribution of technology characteristics in facilitating task-technology fit, and a positive relationship on Continuance Usage Intention of Telemedicine. Moreover, Self-Efficacy has positive and significant effects on the Continuance Usage Intention of Telemedicine applications. While Task Characteristics has an insignificant effect on Task Technology Fit, and Awareness has an insignificant effect on Continuance Usage Intention of Telemedicine applications. This research also reveals that technology characteristic has the most determinant on the continuance usage intention of telemedicine users. The study results provide both practical and theoretical insights to enrich the understanding of the future of Telemedicine applications and contribute to Telemedicine operators.

articleTitle: Classification Covid-19 Data Using XGBoost and SHAP(Shapley Additive exPlainations)
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This paper aims to demonstrate how to create interpretability machine learning model for Covid-19 data by combining SHAP (Shapley Additive exPlanations) value for feature selection with Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost). The classifier is used to calculate the magnitude of contribution of the SHAP values to the features. Then, the features with significant contribution in the classification task are selected and explained. These features have an impact on the model prediction in both global and local interpretation. SHAP values were useful for analyzing the complex relationship between the different features. According to the results, the number of features is reduced while the accuracy remained around 90%. In addition, the computational cost is decreased by 58.7<sup>%</sup> by using the top ten most important features. The proposed methodology enhances performance, reduces training time, and addresses the issue of high dimensionality in the Covid-19 dataset. It also provides greater insight into model prediction using a “glass-box” approach.

articleTitle: Towards Prediction of Bus Arrival Time using Multi-layer Perceptron (MLP) and MLP Regressor
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Intelligent transport systems have been in research and development in recent decades. However, not all countries can afford to deploy such systems for the public usage. Conventional public transport systems such as public buses are still the main mode of public transportation system in many developing countries. Due to the issue of public transportation's inaccurate bus arrival timing, the general public still prefers private transportation. The goal of this study is to investigate the use of machine learning to improve the prediction accuracy of bus arrival timing. Two machine learning models, a multi-layer perceptron (MLP) and a MLP regressor, were compared in terms of their performance on small datasets. The experiment data was collected from Kulai-Johor Bahru Sentral bus route in Malaysia and cleaned to negate errors that influenced the accuracy of the models. The performances of the models were analysed and discussed and we observed that the MLP outperforms the MLP regressor. A limitation of this study is the small dataset that only comprises bus location data collected on a single bus route.

articleTitle: It's Important Using Beauty Vloggers on Youtube to Create Brand Preference
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Using a beauty vlogger with characteristics that match the product being promoted is one of the company's strategies for utilizing social media to improve brand performance through promotion. This study aims to understand the characteristics of beauty vloggers (physical attractiveness, social and building relationships with the audience) in influencing parasocial interactions and their influence on preferences for local cosmetic brands. The research objects were five beauty vloggers for local cosmetic products with the highest number of subscribers in Indonesia, so 400 subscribers were taken as a purposive sample. Then, the questionnaire was distributed online through social media. The collected data were analyzed using Partial Least Square Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM). The study's results prove that physical attractiveness, social attractiveness, and the relationships built by vloggers with audiences influence parasocial interactions to increase preference for local cosmetic product brands. Companies can take advantage of beauty vloggers to improve brand performance by paying attention to the characteristics of beauty vloggers.

articleTitle: The Potentials of NFT Art and Its Rising Opportunities for Filipino-Creative Industry Artists
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Creative industry artists often receive little-to-no appreciation in their careers in the creative industry, until Non-Fungible Tokens (NFTs) Art arrived in the Philippines. Even though NFT Art is a new concept, Filipino creative artists quickly joined it, which appears to be opening doors for their careers. The development of the NFT ecosystem in the country is still in its early stage, and as such remains unexamined. With this, five creative industry artists were interviewed regarding their perspectives on participating in NFT Art in the country. This research uses a qualitative and exploratory design as its approach in gathering the perspectives of the creative industry artists on NFT Art in the country. The results indicated that creative industry artists partake in NFT because of its opportunities for career development, but they also revealed poor conditions in existing creative industry careers that need to be addressed. It is therefore recommended that NFT Art be explored more and to include participants from other countries and know their perspectives on the emerging phenomenon.

articleTitle: Optimized Fuzzy Logic and Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Inference Systems for Wound Healing Time Prediction Among the Diabetic Patients
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Compared with normal wounds, chronic diabetes wounds are considered more severe because healing takes a significant amount of time. Among the factors that affect the healing of chronic wounds, infection is a major factor that slows down wound healing. Until now, medical practitioners assess wound infection via visual observation, followed by a culture of wound tissue. However, this traditional type of wound assessment is complex and not readily accessible, so the utilization of fuzzy logic to solve the problem mentioned above is proposed. Systematic literature review and medical expert consultation were utilized in determining the various biomarkers that affect the healing period of a wound, constructing the ranges for membership functions and working rules of each of these biomarkers, and developing prediction healing time. Based on pH, oxygen level, c-reactive protein (CRP), and vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF), the fuzzy logic (FL) system and the adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) models were developed through MATLAB software. A system consisting of both models was constructed to verify of each model. Comparing the results, the model based on fuzzy logic showed a higher accuracy of 95%. This developed model can be applied in developing the smart wound monitoring system in the future.

articleTitle: Adoption of Digital Marketing Toward Digital Transformation in Indonesian Micro- and Small-Sized Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Digital transformation in various industries has led to considerable changes in organizational strategic behavior. Micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs) in the global sense, have been under pressure to adopt information and communication technology to increase their performance. Digital marketing has started to be recognized as one potential enabler of digital transformation. Managerial practices and academic literature provide limited guidance on how digital marketing can be used as an enabler of digital transformation across enterprises. This is especially in dearth among the study of MSMEs, particularly in emerging countries such as Indonesia where MSMEs have significant major roles in economic growth and workforce absorption. Besides, only a small portion of Indonesian MSMEs has embraced digital technology. Using the case study method, this paper finds that digital marketing adoption of the MSMEs may serve as the first-level enabler of digital transformation by allowing the MSMEs to enhance its dynamic capabilities. This paper contributes to the area of digital transformation through a marketing perspective, something that is novel in the context of MSMEs. For managers, the results of the study provide actionable guidelines for the MSMEs on how to drive digital transformation with digital marketing as the entry-level of adoption.

articleTitle: Developing Healthcare Chatbot: Migrant Workers' Study With Design Implication
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Migrant workers are often those with low income who are subject to a high risk of virus transmission due to environmental and occupational exposures. The COVID-19 pandemic is reported to exacerbate the existing vulnerabilities of these marginalized groups. This study aims to shed light on how the potential of a conversational agent (Chatbot) could help improve migrant workers' health information seeking and health literacy. The exploration extended to the existing barriers to seeking health information strategies to obtain the needed information during COVID-19. This study conducted an exploratory qualitative study using semi-structured interviews with a scenario-based approach to study the experiences of the migrant Thai low-income workers in Taiwan. A total of 12 Thai stakeholders and migrant workers participated in the study. Migrant Thai workers developed distinct health information behaviors and improved various types of health competencies amid the COVID-19 pandemic. However, the critical barriers to health literacy remain. As a result, this work found that the Chatbot posted several potential features that could improve health literacy on Access. Therefore, Apprise and Apply depend on the understanding, which can be enhanced if the understanding rate increases. This study addresses the need for the development of the potential of a conversational agent. The findings of this study would guide the authority and technological interventions to respond to migrant workers' health information needs with appropriate tools.

articleTitle: Intrusiveness of Display Ads versus Video Ads of Instagram Feeds Promotional Content of a Coffee Retail Brand
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Several major changes have occurred which have encouraged many business players globally to start using digital platform channels to maximize business output, which in recent times has been affected by limitations due to the COVID-19 outbreak. The purpose of this research is to investigate whether there are significant differences in intrusiveness levels as a result of different Instagram promotional content formats, i.e., display ads and video ads, that are used by coffee retail brands. To find the answer, this research uses a quantitative survey method with an experimental approach among 176 Indonesian coffee consumers that are part of the Instagram community members of a major Indonesian coffee retail brand. The results of the study show that there is a significant difference in terms of intrusiveness output between the two types of ad formats being compared. Further, the video ads type is perceived as more intrusive than the display one. The findings of this study can contribute to the coffee retail industry by giving insight into how to utilize different content and formats of social media ads to get the most effective result considering the rich options for creative content to be utilized as a promotional tool.

articleTitle: Advancing Education Through Metaverse Virtual Reality Simulation
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Metaverse refers to the next generation of the internet. Through the technology development, it allows users to interact with others by using 3D avatars. Education has been one of the highly compatible metaverse applications. Nowadays, the way of learning has also gradually changed and shifted to online with the collaboration of various tools. By using metaverse in the future, the learning process can be much more elevated with an immersive experience. Therefore, this study aimed to analyze user satisfaction using Mozilla Hub, an online tool that enables users to explore virtual worlds. We gathered the data by conducting a web-based simulation for 20 students to try the experiences and features. From the simulation, we asked some questions related to the experience of using it and analyzed the results by using a descriptive statistical method. The result showed that most participants gave a positive response toward the implementation of the metaverse. However, some improvement is still needed in developing the metaverse to be more optimally used.

articleTitle: Level of awareness of Digital Banking Users on Risk and Security in Greater Jakarta
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The development of technology in financial sector has change the monetary transaction system in the world. Currently, there are many banks provide services in digital banking because it is convenience to the users and, it has simplifies the movement and less time required compared to non-digital banking transaction. However, the side back of the digital banking to users are such as many frauds committed through digital banking, leaks or theft of users' data, when top-up balances are held up, interruptions when making transfers, and others. According to the OJK, with this digital transformation, cyber security attacks have increased by up to 86.70%. Therefore, it is important to seek and examine the awareness of digital banking users related to the risk and security of digital banking. 104 respondents participated in the self-administered questionnaire and we used a descriptive analysis to measure the level of awareness of risk and security of using digital banking. The descriptive results shows that more than 75% of respondents agree and are aware that digital banks have a fairly high-security risk, when doing top-ups there are frequent interruptions or pending, and the account is easy to access by anyone who knows our account. In addition, more than 15% of respondents feel that traditional banks have a higher risk, and fraud that occurs in digital banks does not occur often. The results of the study provides a preliminary information to the reader about the awareness of the digital banking in the context of Greater Jakarta.

articleTitle: Behavioral Intention to Invest Cryptocurrency in Indonesia: An Empirical Study
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The use of blockchain technology is increasing along with the need for an increase in financial value, one of which is cryptocurrency. This study analyzes behavioral intentions to invest using cryptocurrencies based on social effects, regulatory support, and trust factors. Quantitative procedures are applied to answer study hypotheses with data sources from distributing online questionnaires to respondents who invest in cryptocurrencies in Indonesia. Therefore, a purposive sampling technique was applied to 410 respondents. The data analysis used Partial Least Square - Structural Equation Modeling-(PLS-SEM). The study's results prove that social effects positively and significantly influence trust and behavioral intention. In addition, regulatory support positively and significantly affects trust, and trust has a positive and significant effect on behavioral intention to invest in cryptocurrency. This research contributes significantly to investor behavior by applying regulatory support for adopting the latest information technology.

articleTitle: Detecting Style of Processing and Understanding on Puzzle Game: HELLTAKER Use Case
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The current learning style analysis process uses questionnaires as a classification tool that cannot cause students to show instinctive behavior like playing video games. Therefore, we propose a method for analyzing learners' learning styles based on Felder & Silverman theory. This study presents a framework for developing an approach to assess learners' understanding and processing style through observing their behavior while playing the game HELLTAKER. This study analyzes the information gathered from learners using a statistical technique called “Correlation” to compare it with the information resulting from The index of learning style(ILS), which is questionable. We propose a framework for the test and hypothesis with a group of students in a classroom with no more than 30 members per room. For defined as the learning style analysis results, is divided into H1AA representing the Active Learning style based on the number of movements, H1AR representing the Reflective Learning style based on some reset decisions, H1BG represents a Global Learning style based on game progression. Furthermore, finally, H1BS represents a Sequential Learning style that relies on variations in the problem-solving order. The expected value of the statistical significance of the hypothesis is accepted at 0.15 or more than 85%.

articleTitle: Modification of YOLOv4 for Human Detection in Elevated Thermal Images
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Several deep learning networks have already been developed to detect objects given an input image. However, most of these networks are usually designed around detecting objects using a standard set of images or datasets such as MS COCO. Using these networks on a custom dataset already performs well but lacks context on the detected object. Furthermore, they can be improved upon by modifying the network depending on the simplicity or complexity of the dataset being used. With this, the paper presents two ways of modifying and improving a base network for detecting humans on the custom thermal elevated objects (TEO) human thermal dataset. The results show that TrimmedYOLO, the network created using the layer removal method, produced comparable results as the base YOLOv4 while being more lightweight regarding FPS and BFLOPS needed. On the other hand, TEO-EfficientYOLO-Mish and TEO-YOLO-ReT-Mish, the networks created using the backbone replacement method, can perform inference the fastest while still producing fairly high mAP results.

articleTitle: Dissolved Oxygen Management in Enhancing a First-order Closed-Loop Shrimp Aquaculture System Using an Adaptive PID and PI-based Controller
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Seafood has become one of the most important food sources in the Philippines. Specifically, shrimp farming provides an important source of seafood and, by extension, a source of income to coastal areas. As such, it has the potential to alleviate poverty in these communities. Furthermore, it is stated to be one of the most demanded businesses in the Philippines. To help shrimp farmers, this study proposes using adaptive PID and PI-based controllers to manage dissolved oxygen. These controllers use three methods namely: Zieglers-Nichols, Trial and Error, and MATLAB PID/PI Tuning. These algorithms were used to adaptively adjust the oxygen levels in the water to ensure optimal oxygen can be given to the shrimp. This can lead to improved shrimp health and growth rates, as well as increased production and profits for the farmer. By implementing adaptive PID and PI-based controllers for dissolved oxygen management, shrimp farmers can more effectively manage the oxygen levels in their farming operations and improve their business's overall efficiency and profitability.

articleTitle: The Influence of Social Media and EWOM on Generation Z's Trust and Purchase Intentions at Coffee Shops
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Generation Z has a lifestyle of enjoying daily activities at a coffee shop. This phenomenon affects the lifestyle of Generation Z. Several indicators can influence Generation Z's purchasing intentions (PI) for Coffee Shops, including social media usage (SMU) and electronic word of mouth (EWOM) can raise trust (TR) and influence PI to gain customer loyalty (CL). This study is to find out about PI and CL using non-probability sampling involving 150 coffee shop consumers from generation Z. This research uses a structural equation model (SEM) with SmartPLS software 3. This research provides proof that SMU does not influence PI in generation Z because the p-value of SMU on PI is 0.173 where the result is > 0.05 and is not by standardized measurement values, but for generation Z SMU is more significant in increasing consumer CON with a p-value of 0.010 which is by the standard measuring value criteria. The results of this research provide proof that generation Z can raise CL that is created because of the PI which is influenced by indicators other than SMU, that is EWOM.

articleTitle: Managing Talent in the e-commerce Industry: Case from Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: In early 2020, the COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia changed how people lived and worked, and customer demands and needs continue to change. including how people make transactions that increase digital transactions. E-commerce sales have increased by 25%, according to IdEA, which will affect employee workload and job satisfaction during the pandemic. This research examines how remote working affects job satisfaction in the Indonesian E-Commerce industry. 200 Indonesian remote workers were surveyed quantitatively and analyzed using Smart-PLS software. The study found that remote workers from e-commerce companies in Indonesia had a positive and significant impact on job satisfaction and work-life balance. Workload negatively impacts job satisfaction and work-life balance, while work-life balance positively impacts job satisfaction. This study shows that working remotely can help you balance work and life. This paper provides practical implications for increasing job satisfaction for organizations to be used by HR or leaders to make decisions and needs, such as communication facilities and remote worker discipline.

articleTitle: Analyzing Traffic-Complaint Tweets Based on Time-Location Context Analysis to Develop A Traffic Urgency Model
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Intelligent transportation systems in urban areas in developing countries are still being developed. In this process, there are plenteous reports from society that complain about traffic jams, accidents, and other conditions that require immediate handling. For instance, in Surabaya, one of the urban areas in Indonesia, there were 7,975 complaints via @e100ss Twitter's account, the transportation media in Surabaya, in December 2022. This research aims to find contexts from the traffic complaint text to determine the urgency factor from the text. Traffic urgency factors are used to determine the complaint's handling priority. Therefore, the main steps in this research are as follows. The first step is preprocessing and tokenizing the text data. The second step is calculating the term frequency (TF) from the tokenized word. Furthermore, the words with the highest TF values were categorized according to their context. In this context, a model to determine urgency was developed in this research. This research suggests that traffic urgency is moderated by the context of location, context of a group people that being reported, context of the object that mentioned in the complaint text, and context of the condition. This research also found that a specific location has the most frequent reported time.

articleTitle: Investigation and Analysis of Information Remaining on Used HDDs in Thailand
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: People rely on storing and processing their data and information on hard disks in this technological age. This paper investigated whether offered for sale on the second-hand market had been completely erased or not and whether the disks contained readable data. The research further analyzed if data retrieved was Personal Identifiable Information (PII) belonging to the previous owners. The disks that contained PII information were identified. The results of the study were compared with the results from studies conducted aboard in order to explore any shared trends or differences. It was revealed that Thailand's results were in line with other countries from earlier studies. The findings presented that the majority of used HDD in Thailand still contained PII data that was not properly sanitized by the previous owners and some of the data belongs to international entities. The research concluded that it was very important to have greater awareness of the risks of incomplete data erasure on second hand disks and the potential impact on previous owners if this information becomes available to third parties.

articleTitle: The Integration of Internet of Things (IoT) And Cloud Computing in Finance and Accounting: Systematic Literature Review
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The power of the internet enables users to easily access history, documents, and articles. This research focuses on the development of the widely-known and adaptable Internet of Things (IoT) and cloud computing in living environments, where user adoption has reached a significant level. IoT will continue to exist and grow due to its advanced technology and supporting factors. This study employs a systematic literature review approach, to achieve this, several keywords such as “Internet of Things”, “Cloud Storage”, “IoT in Finance and Accounting”, and “Cloud Storage in Finance and Accounting” were used to search for relevant articles. The result of this search yielded 37 articles that specifically addressed the topic. manual observation was performed, and each article was read and analyzed one by one, from this observation, it was found that only 16 articles were relevant to the adoption of IoT and cloud storage technology in Indonesia for finance and accounting purposes. This study's findings suggest that the integration of IoT and cloud computing technologies in Indonesia's finance and accounting sectors has immense potential for growth and development. However, addressing the associated risks and challenges and investing in the development of a skilled workforce are crucial steps that need to be taken to capitalize on these technologies to drive innovation, efficiency, and economic growth in the country. Moreover, the adoption of IoT and cloud computing in finance and accounting requires a skilled workforce with a deep understanding of these technologies.

articleTitle: Face Mask Detection using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The current development of artificial intelligence (AI) technology makes it possible to detect and classify objects, such as whether a person is wearing a mask or not, using deep learning technology. The system was built using the Python language for modeling and using the Flutter language. Classification of face masks using the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) method, and the MobileNetV2 architecture. This model use datasets in image format with Mask and Non-Mask classifications. From the test results, the mask detection model gives good results. Testing objects carried out at the furthest distance of one meter gave good results, while system notifications on mobile application also worked well by sending notifications to mobile application when an object was detected by the CCTV tool and displaying it on mobile application.

articleTitle: The effect of Financial Inclusion on the Sustainable Development Goals
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The study aims to evaluate the effective and successful implementation of Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). In order to help and liberate the residents with all types of financial services, our focus will be on expanding the financial services to the underdeveloped and rural areas of India. The relationship between financial inclusion (FI) and SDGs is examined in this paper. The Panel Data Model (PDM). was employed to produce this outcome. STATA version 15 is utilized in the study to run the correlation and linear regression analysis tool. The findings show a strong relationship between our proxies, or the number of IPPB branches and access points, and the SDGs. Our research can be used to create new financial regulations for sustainable growth. This may persuade the government to increase the number of IPPB access points. Researchers may use this study to look into other factors that can be used to advance the level of development. Future research may examine more financial inclusion proxies. Our findings might be outdated, given the ongoing emergence of new technologies. The federal government is working hard to promote equitable growth.

articleTitle: Genetic Termite Colony-Optimized Arbuscular Mycorrhizal Fungi Concentration for Glycophyte Plant Resilience to Saline Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Saline environments, such as coastal and agricultural areas with excessive fertigation that remained uncultivated, impede glycophyte growth. However, arbuscular mycorrhizal fungi (AMF) can help regulate plant water balance, but its overpopulation exhibits competition with roots. To address this challenge, this study developed three hybrid evolutionary and bio-inspired optimization models namely, genetic termite colony (GTC), genetic bacterial foraging, and genetic sperm swarm in determining the optimum concentration of Glomus spp. AMF inoculant to induce papaya var. Sinta F1 plant growth in terms of root and stem lengths, stem thickness, leaf count, and total leaf chlorophyll when exposed to a saline environment after 15 and 30 days of sowing. Four treatments were performed: control, and mycorrhizal with 5, 10, and 15 mg/L concentrations. Salinity was maintained at 6 dS/m using NaCl solution. Variance-based Factor Analysis confirmed stem length <tex>$(L_{s})$</tex> as the most significant phenotype with highest communality. A 4-gene Genetic Programming model was formulated for <tex>$L_{s}$</tex> fitness function. With most acceptable results, GTC recommended 11.149 mg/L which resulted in 1937.5%, 388.43%, 650%, 480%, and 238.889% improvement in root and stem lengths, stem thickness, leaf count, and total leaf chlorophyll respectively, than the non-mycorrhizal plant. This established protocol increased glycophyte resistance to high salinity.

articleTitle: Youth Digital Development Post-Pandemic in Indonesian Perspective based on Gender
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Youth are supposedly the most vulnerable age category in digital competency during the pandemic. Youth and digital technology are inextricably linked variables and the internet have become an essential element of youth. The goal of this study is to discover young people's digital literacy abilities and their ability to capitalize on internet possibilities following the pandemic emergency. This research examines disparities depending on gender in further detail. The research analysis techniques are descriptive analysis and T-test analysis. The data analysis technique for this research is descriptive analysis and <tex>$\boldsymbol{T}$</tex>- test analysis. A cross-sectional survey was used for online data collection <tex>$(N=247)$</tex>. The result showed that there are inequalities regarding social media account ownership, particularly female respondents owning greater social media accounts than male respondents. According to the research results, male and female respondents had different digital literacy skills in the Software Security and Communication Skill dimensions. There are disparities in the utilization of online opportunities between male and female respondents. This study contributes to the ability to improve digital literacy skills, especially by boosting fundamental device security capabilities. It is intended that the usage of online opportunities would provide a focus on utilization connected to the learning process based on gender.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Effect of Grit, Collaborative Learning, and Crisis Magnitude on Online Learning Satisfaction
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Online learning has become an available option for ensure the continuity of education during the COVID-19 pandemic. This paper aims to analyze the impact of personal perception on COVID-19 as a crisis and learning resources –either in personal and social context toward student satisfaction of online learning in higher education. Contextually, this paper is interested to examine the impact of crisis magnitude, personal perseverance or grit, and collaborative learning toward e-satisfaction of online learning in higher education. This paper is grounded on a survey-based study which involved 1,004 students from various universities in Indonesia. The collected data was structured in partial least square structural equation modelling and analyzed by using the SmartPLS version 3.9. Although, grit as personal resources does not impact significantly on e-satisfaction. E-satisfaction is affected positively, directly, and significantly by crisis magnitude and collaborative learning. This paper confirms that student perception on COVID-19 as a crisis that has forced them more accepting of online learning as the best available option for educational learning. For leveraging online learning satisfaction, lecturers are recommended to utilize a collaborative learning approach in higher education during pandemic.

articleTitle: The Deployment of Service Robots Powered by Artificial Intelligence in Five-Star Hotels: Does it Influence the Customer's Booking Intention?
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Service robots are becoming increasingly common in the hospitality sector as an innovative technology that can improve customers' overall experiences. Despite its significance, the impact of service robot deployment on customers' booking intention has received scant consideration. Since booking intention may lead to real purchase behavior, the purpose of this study was to evaluate how the deployment of service robots in five-star hotels influences potential hotel guests' booking intention. This study used the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) to predict the potential hotel guests' technology acceptance and booking intention. Using a quantitative approach, 198 research participants in the study are given questionnaires to fill out as part of the data collection procedure. A purposive sampling technique was used in this research. This study found that the perceived technological ease of use, customers' innovation self-efficacy, and perceived technological effectiveness have a positive influence on customers' intention to book a hotel room that employs service robots in their operation. This research result is consistent with the findings of previous studies on this topic. The outcome of the study is expected to give a better understanding of how implementing smart technology may influence customers' decisions to make hotel reservations, subsequently increasing the level of hotel occupancy rate.

articleTitle: Analyzing Programming Competency: A Student Perspective in Python Programming
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Computer programming is a skill that every information technology (IT) student must know and have. Computer programming is delivered using different programming languages. A programming language is a set of instructions to build computer programs. The College of Information and Communications Technology (CICT) of Bulacan State University (BulSU) offers different programming languages to its IT students from first- to fourth-year level. One of the languages students must take is Python programming. Python programming language is a scripting language used to develop web applications, data analytics, machine learning, and more. This study focuses on determining the students' programming competency in Python programming using a paired sample t-test. To deliver its objective, a concurrent triangulation design of mixed methods research was utilized to gather quantitative and qualitative data at the same time from fourth-year IT students of BulSU-CICT. Using paired sample ttests to calculate and interpret the quantitative data gathered, this study found that there is a significant difference between the before and after performance of the students in programming (P<0.00l), specifically in Python programming. Additionally, a manual analysis was delivered on the thoughts of the students upon completing the course. It is highlighted that students learned a lot, and their expectations were met after taking the course. From what this study discovered, course offerings of other programming languages may also be subjected to analyze the need for course syllabus revisions to fit what the student needs based on their performance and thoughts.

articleTitle: Determining the Effectiveness of Cloud Computing on the Payroll Management System
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The study explores the implications of cloud computing on managing the company's payroll system. This qualitative study aims to illuminate HR managers’ perceptions of the advantages of using cloud computing to manage payroll. The success of a firm depends on accurate and timely action. The primary source of information for this study is obtained through focused group discussion. Content and thematic analysis were done in 20 focused groups from the responses obtained from the HR managers working in the Payroll Department after switching from Traditional Computing to the Cloud. Each group had four to seven HR Managers. The data for this study was primarily collected from Indian Companies; however, it extensively emphasizes the widespread use of Cloud Computing in HR. After a thorough review of the literature and focus group discussion with HR managers in organisations using Cloud Computing in managing payroll for over a year, appropriate conclusions were drawn. The transition from traditional to Cloud Computing in Payroll has a favourable impact on the organisation's processes and structures. This study suggests a proposed model named 5A Model that will assist HR Managers to handle Payroll efficiently.

articleTitle: The Effect of Out-of-Home Promotion Media on Brand Awareness Impact on Kopi Tubruk Gadjah's Purchase Intention
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The factors influencing consumer behavior after seeing advertisements displayed in out-of-home promotion media impact consumer purchasing decisions. This study examines how the characteristics of out-of-home promotion media on brand awareness impact consumer buying intentions for Kopi Tubruk Gadjah products in the city of Bandung. Using purposive sampling, samples were taken from 249 respondents in the city and district of Bandung. Analyzed using Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) and tested empirically using Partial Least Square (PLS). By focusing on the factors of outdoor media promotion and consumer brand awareness, this research will encourage marketers and Kopi Tubruk Gadjah companies to gain consumer interest in making purchases in the future. It was found that the factors of outdoor media promotion (informativeness, credibility, entertainment, and irritation) affect consumer brand awareness. Consumer purchase intention is influenced by consumer brand awareness.

articleTitle: Corpus Development for Pronoun Substitute and Address Term Study
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The development of a corpus of pronoun substitute and address term annotations is aimed at exploring the actual use of these language elements in dialogue sentences. To create the corpus, dialogue sentences were extracted from a collection of popular TV drama scripts and novels, representing both genres in order to provide a comprehensive overview of conversation settings. One key feature of the corpus is the inclusion of a detailed definition of kinship relations. This was done to gain a better understanding of the usage and meaning of kinship terms in dialogue. To ensure the accuracy of the corpus annotations, each sentence is annotated by two annotators, and the results are compared. This approach helps to minimize errors and personal biases, leading to a high-quality corpus that accurately reflects the usage of pronoun substitutes and address terms in natural language conversations. The comparison of annotations can also highlight any discrepancies, which can then be resolved through further discussion and collaboration between the annotators. This rigorous process helps to ensure that the corpus is a reliable and trustworthy resource. The resulting corpus will provide a wealth of information about these language elements and the way they are used in real-life dialogues, making it a useful resource for researchers in this field.

articleTitle: Reviewing Presentation Slides Remotely and Nonverbally by Using SCORPION
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Online presentations have become more common as a result of the pandemic. However, no software or applications enable users to optimise the remote feedback of presentation slides. Social media applications and video conferencing software can be distracting as users might choose to do something else when working. Although software like PowerPoint has a function where users can add comments when pages have issues, that can cause users to repeat the same suggestions repeatedly. SCORPION (Slide Coordinator to Optimally Review Presentation Items Optimally and Nonverbally) has been proposed to fix these issues. The research objective is to determine if the proposed system is quicker and less distracting than an existing means, LINE, given a set of presumptions. It is also essential to determine if it is function-wise satisfactory. Upon completing the experiments <sup>1</sup><sup>1</sup>Conducted when the first author was a student at Ritsumeikan University, the researchers discovered that the proposed system has potential to make editing quicker and slightly less distracting than LINE. At the same time, they also discovered that the proposed system should have more features to give more user satisfaction than LINE.

articleTitle: Mitigating Imbalanced Data in Online Social Networks using Stratified K-Means Sampling
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The K-means clustering technique is widely used in many fields, such as anomaly detection, customer segmentation, cyber-physical system, medical diagnoses, sentiment analysis, fraud detection, and other similar tasks. We used this k-means technique in handling imbalanced datasets by preserving minority class structure using the stratified resampling technique. For this experimental study, we used a benchmark dataset from Kaggle. It is a labeled dataset collected from online social media regarding fake news. This proposed model, The Stratified k-means Sampling (SKMS), is compared with Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique (SMOTE) by empirically experimenting using different machine learning algorithms. Random Forest (RF) algorithm gives significant accuracy, and Support Vector Classification (SVC) produces a better F1-score than other algorithms. The SMOTE technique was compared with the same dataset using these same algorithms. While SKMS seeks to preserve the structure of the minority class, SMOTE aims to diversify the minority class by interpolating between existing samples. Depending on the dataset, one might be more relevant than the other.

articleTitle: Effectiveness of E-Learning Cloud Computing and The Current Issues In Education
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This paper aims to conclude the effectiveness of Limited Face-to-Face Meetings (PTM) by discussing the current problems in education associated with distance learning, e-learning cloud computing, as well as the solutions implemented in order to circumvent the negative risks that occur. This qualitative descriptive research is conducted by giving questionnaires to the respondents of college students, whose responses are then interpreted to the scale of 1,2, or 3 for negative, neutral, or positive opinion through collecting data using purposive sampling, then testing the validity and reliability. The results of the questionnaire values will be averaged to present the final results of this study. The average result for the preference of limited onsite courses is 2.38, indicating a positive opinion that proves the sample of college students respondents from Binus University feel a preference for Limited Face-to-Face Meetings (PTM). This concludes that the limited onsite courses provided by Binus University are sufficiently effective as a solution to the problems and risks associated with distance learning.

articleTitle: Discussion on Digital Marketing Strategy of Chinese Agricultural Enterprises in Mobile Internet Era
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Currently, the development of Internet technology and the popularity of mobile applications have changed how we work, live and study. On the consumption level, consumers often obtain information and make purchase decisions through Internet digital technology and network platforms in the purchase decision-making process, which fundamentally changes the consumer's consumption mode, thus prompting enterprises to start marketing using digital technology platforms to meet the needs of the mobile Internet era. With the advantages and technical power of the Internet and new media, agricultural enterprises innovate the digital marketing model of agricultural products, effectively enhance the brand value, product value and economic value of regional agriculture and improve market competitiveness, which is of great significance to promote regional economic and social development. Taking the new media and new technology based on the mobile internet era as a breakthrough, this paper analyzes the development trend and existing problems of digital marketing of agricultural enterprises in China, and then puts forward countermeasures and suggestions for digital marketing strategies of agricultural enterprises.

articleTitle: Destination Choice Through Social Media by Domestic Tourists in Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Similar to any other tourism products, destinations are experiential, making evaluating prior to experience quite challenging. Social medias such as Instagram nowadays performs as guide for prospective travelers when making decisions. This is because Instagram help tangibilize the intangibles through its shared photo and video contents. Moreover, Instagram also offers text-based information that could help tourists when choosing their destinations. Lastly, tourists find content posted on Instagram to be reliable and acceptable as a source of information. While there are several aspects of social media platforms, there has been no clear indications as to which of its aspects play the most significant role towards travelers' destination choice. The objective of this research is to investigate which aspects of social media significantly affect tourists' destination choice. Online questionnaires were distributed to 154 millennial respondents who live in Jakarta and have integrated Instagram into their destination selection process. Findings indicated photo attractiveness and trustworthiness of content have significant relationships while textual information did not have a significant relationship with the effect of Instagram on destination choice. Travel agencies, marketers and destinations' authorities can use the findings of this study for their marketing strategies.

articleTitle: Exploring the Dynamics of Father and Mother's Parental Mediation on Internet Usage among Elementary School-Aged Children
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This study aims to explore the dynamics of parental mediation between fathers and mothers and the factors that influence parental mediation in internet usage among primary school-aged children in Indonesia. Using a qualitative method, semi-structured interviews were conducted with three pairs of participating fathers and mothers who have children between the ages of six and twelve and are allowed to access the internet. The researcher created a measuring tool in the form of a structured interview guide that went through the expert judgment process. The results were then analyzed using content analysis techniques. Triangulation was also carried out with the children from each pair of participants to enhance data validity. Results of the study show that the dynamics of parental mediation are influenced by open communication in determining agreements and consistent implementation of rules between fathers and mothers. The results also showed that the dynamic was also influenced by two main factors of parental mediation practices which were: the parents' attitude towards their children's Internet usage and the parent's ability to use the internet. It was found that fathers and mothers who consistently practice parental mediation can maximize the positive benefits of the internet as a learning media and minimize the negative risks of the internet, such as content and internet addiction risks for their school-aged children.

articleTitle: Forecasting the Global and Diffuse Solar Irradiance of Bangkok's Tropical Climate using Long-Short Term Memory (LSTM) Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This paper presents the model development to forecast the one-hour ahead global and diffuse solar irradiance of Bangkok, Thailand, located in a tropical climate zone. Based on the measurement records during 2019–2021, the forecasting models were developed by the long-short-term memory (LSTM) technique in which the ambient temperature, solar elevation, and an insolation parameter namely normalized global solar radiation were selected as the model inputs. To assess the forecasting performance, the LSTM models were compared to the artificial neural network (ANN) model and the simple persistence (SP) model. Two statistical parameters of normalized mean bias error (nMBE) and normalized root mean square error (nRMSE) were used for the performance assessment. The results showed that the LSTM model was superior to the other two models (ANN and SP) for all weather conditions (both wet and dry periods). The LSTM model also forecasted the global irradiance more accurately than the diffuse irradiance.

articleTitle: Digital Investment Behavior: Insights from Gen-Y and Gen-Z
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Digital investment services have changed investor behavior from conventional to more practical and flexible. Investors use investment applications that feel safe and friendly to operate. This study aims to identify the UTAUT model in understanding the behavior of Generation Y and Z investors in using investment applications. An online survey was conducted among 294 investors from Y and Z generations in Indonesia to answer the research objectives. The collected data were analyzed using multivariate-Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) based on the covariate. The results of this study have proven that performance expectancy, effort expectancy, facilitating condition, and social influence have a positive and significant effect on behavioral intention. Likewise, facilitating conditions and behavioral intentions positively and significantly affect user behavior. The four factors in the UTAUT model become determinants for investors in making decisions on using investment applications. In conclusion, understanding consumer behavior in adopting technology is crucial for companies developing technology.

articleTitle: Factor Analysis of Customer Satisfaction Towards Repurchase Intentions In Online Shopping For Daily Necessities on E-Commerce Sites
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The aims of this study was to assess the factors that influence customer satisfaction on repurchase intentions in online shopping for groceries at e-commerce. This study uses a quantitative method with a cross-sectional time horizon. Samples were taken from 207 respondents in DKI Jakarta and East Java. The analytical method used is Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) with a conceptual model using Partial Least-Squares (PLS). The results show that the customer satisfaction felt by consumers when shopping online for groceries in e-commerce is significantly influenced by customer service, product experience, and delivery experience. Then repurchase intention is significantly influenced by customer satisfaction and price sensitivity. Our results reveal that groceries marketers and e-commerce have been able to provide good customer service, the products sold are in line with expectations and in a fresh condition (product experience), accuracy time (delivery experience) the product reaches the customer according to the estimate. Overall respondents get a good experience that affects customer satisfaction.

articleTitle: The Effect of Technology Readiness and Customers' Acceptance on Online Hotel Booking Intention
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The introduction of sophisticated website features and attributes in the development of hotel booking websites has led to an increase in the site's complexity, making it more difficult to use for customers who are not particularly tech-savvy. Therefore, the purpose of the study is to examine the effect of customers' technology readiness on customers' acceptance of the online reservation system through the hotel website. Subsequently, the study evaluated the connection between customers' acceptance of online booking via hotel websites and their booking intention. The online survey was distributed to 190 respondents in Jakarta. Using a technique known as snowball sampling, the questionnaire was distributed across a variety of online platforms, and users were given the option to share it with other people at any time. The collected data were analyzed using Partial Least Squares - Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM) techniques. The result of the study found that customers' technology readiness positively influences perceived usefulness, perceived ease of use, and perceived enjoyment of hotel reservation websites. This study also revealed that customers' acceptance of online reservation systems through hotel websites positively influences their intention to book a hotel room. The findings of this study imply that customers are drawn to hotel websites mostly because they are simple to navigate. This is because consumers do not require any prior knowledge of these websites to effectively use them.

articleTitle: Financial Inclusion and Net Value Added by Agricultural Activity
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Since the beginning, agriculture has been the backbone of the Indian economy. The farmers have always received help from the Indian financial system to help them effectively complete their jobs. The use of financial services significantly impacts agriculture in the short and long term. The study's main objective is to promote inclusive growth while strengthening the agricultural industry. The study uses the number of Indian post-payment bank branches and their access points as proxies for financial inclusion because it seeks to assess the effect of financial inclusion on the net value provided by agricultural activities to the development of the nation. According to the results, there is a remarkable relation between the net value added by agricultural activity and our proxies or the number of IPPB branches and access points. Our study can be utilized to develop new financial policies for agriculture. Only 3–4 years of data are taken into account in the study. The trial can go on for a while longer. As new innovations take place constantly, our results could become obsolete. The government is making every effort to encourage inclusive growth; therefore, the numbers can increase in the near future.

articleTitle: How Do Transformational Leadership and The Work Environment Affects Employee Retention?
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The hotel property business is projected to be more prospective in the coming years compared to last year. This is in line with the recovery of the tourism business and the increasingly controlled Covid-19 pandemic. This study examines the impact of a transformational leadership style of work and environment on employee retention in the hospitality sector. Cross-sectional survey data are gathered in this quantitative study. Data was collected using a simple random sampling from 40 low-level managerial employees and non-managerial employees of Ocean View Residence Hotel in Jepara. The questionnaire was given to the selected sample to get the needed data, and SPSS was used to analyze the data. This study demonstrates that a transformational leadership approach and work environment positively and significantly affect employee retention. Positive employee perceptions of the workplace and effective leadership can lessen turnover plans. According to the results of the current study, hotels need to identify the best leadership style to create environments that encourage employees to stay committed and focused on maintaining high morale and lowering staff turnover.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning Approach to Identifying Suspicious Tax Evasion Behavior in Public Financial Data
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The protection of sensitive tax data poses a challenge for data processors seeking to use it freely, particularly in the realm of financial and tax data. Detecting suspicious behavior related to tax evasion in this area requires sophisticated techniques. This paper presents a study on detecting tax evasion behavior using publicly available financial data. The data was obtained from a public source, and machine learning was applied to identify suspicious behavior based on criteria derived from a literature review. Our study yielded a precision of over 97 % using selected supervised models. Future work involves exploring behavior using unsupervised methods, increasing the number of instances using data synthesis techniques, and comparing results with enterprises that are not registered in a stock market as long as the data is legally available. This research provides valuable insights into identifying suspicious tax evasion behavior and can inform the development of improved tax evasion detection systems in the future.

articleTitle: Managing Talent in Digital Marketing Industry: The Case of Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Gen Z is very attached to technology since the people who were born in the 1990s and over are mostly digital natives. Thus, it also revealed that this generation has unique characteristics compared to previous generations, then, they are also likely to have self-awareness, realism, persistence, innovativeness, and self-reliance as well. The current data and studies lead to several questions that are still unclear, such as how workload, job satisfaction, and psychological condition affect turnover Intention among Gen Z employees. This study intended to examine the relationship between workload, job satisfaction, psychological condition, and turnover intention among Gen Z in a digital industry work setting. In regards to the digital industry, internet companies could be representing the talents of Gen Z since job satisfaction in this industry is higher than in the industry in general. The number of samples in this study is 200 respondents and the sampling areas that are selected for this research are from the Greater Jakarta area (Jakarta, Bogor, Depok, Tangerang, and Bekasi). The result indicates that psychological distress and job satisfaction have a significant effect on turnover intention among Gen Z.

articleTitle: Optical Detection of Winged Insects Utilizing Wireless Sensor Network with Ant Colony Optimizer
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Flies and mosquitos are vectors of infectious diseases such as typhoid fever, leprosy, dengue, and malaria. Mapping of the geographical distribution and population density of these insect pests may help in drafting of an efficient insect pest management strategy to prevent the spread of diseases to humans and animals. The task requires sampling of insect species in different locations repeatedly. Hence, manual approach using an insect net is impractical. Camera-based monitoring is an option. However, cameras are expensive, consume a considerable amount of power, and the data acquired require wide bandwidth to transmit. In this study, a low-power optical sensor using photodiodes and an IR emitter was developed to capture the wingbeat pattern of winged insects. To transmit data, a wireless sensor network (WSN) with an Ant Colony Optimizer (ACO) is proposed. The ACO utilized the path distance and residual energy to determine the optimal path for transmission. The aim is to improve communication efficiency, thus, extends the operation lifespan of the network. Without ACO, the network collapsed after sending 12,075 and 33,357 packets for scenarios 1 and 2, respectively. With ACO, the network remained operational even after sending 20,000 and 40,000 packets for scenarios 1 and 2, respectively.

articleTitle: User Experience and Service Quality (SERVQUAL) Influence on Customer Loyalty of Video Streaming Sites Visitors
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This paper examines the dimensions of User Experience and Service Quality of LLV Sites to see their effect on visitor satisfaction and loyalty to streaming video sites. This study includes a quantitative method with website data analysis, a survey to measure the User Experience Questionnaire (UEQ), and the SERVQUAL dimension, followed by a qualitative method with stakeholder interviews. Questionnaires have been distributed to 106 respondents who have used the site to watch funny and viral videos. The use of PLS-SEM in research relates to the hierarchical component model and explains the importance of path relationships between variables. This study found a significant positive effect between User Experience and Service Quality through LLV's Satisfaction on their Loyalty. Service Quality and User Experience towards Customer Satisfaction LLV get the highest path coefficient values of 4.312 and 3.753, respectively. While the effect of Service Quality on LLV's Customer Loyalty obtained the lowest path coefficient value of 2.041 which shows that Service Quality only has a small effect on visitor loyalty. Thus, Quality of Service and User Experience have the greatest influence on Customer Satisfaction but have little effect on return visits or Customer Loyalty on video streaming sites.

articleTitle: Social Media Analytics Overview on Employer Branding of Banking Company in Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
